_**Agent (qwen3.6-plus 2026-04-10 10:22:10Z)**_

找到了。流量日志存储在 **SQLite 数据库**中：

**数据库文件路径：**
```
~/.antigravity_tools/proxy_logs.db
```

**表结构：** `request_logs`，字段包括：
- `id`, `timestamp`, `method`, `url`, `status`, `duration`
- `model`, `error`, `request_body`, `response_body`
- `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`
- `account_email`, `mapped_model`, `protocol`
- `client_ip`, `username`

**相关代码：**
- 数据库路径：`src-tauri/src/modules/proxy_db.rs:5-7`
- 写入日志：`src-tauri/src/modules/proxy_db.rs:69`（`save_log` 函数）
- 读取日志：`src-tauri/src/modules/proxy_db.rs:107+`（`get_logs` 等查询函数）

**注意：** 如果通过环境变量 `ANTIGRAVITY_DATA_DIR` 设置了自定义数据目录，则数据库路径为 `$ANTIGRAVITY_DATA_DIR/proxy_logs.db`。

10	fn connect_db() -> Result<Connection, String> {
11	    let db_path = get_proxy_db_path()?;
12	    let conn = Connection::open(db_path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
13	    
14	    // Enable WAL mode for better concurrency
15	    conn.pragma_update(None, "journal_mode", "WAL").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
16	    
17	    // Set busy timeout to 5000ms to avoid "database is locked" errors
18	    conn.pragma_update(None, "busy_timeout", 5000).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
19	    
20	    // Synchronous NORMAL is faster and safe enough for WAL
21	    conn.pragma_update(None, "synchronous", "NORMAL").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
22	    
23	    Ok(conn)
24	}
25	
26	pub fn init_db() -> Result<(), String> {
27	    // connect_db will initialize WAL mode and other pragmas
28	    let conn = connect_db()?;
29	    
30	    conn.execute(
31	        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS request_logs (
32	            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
33	            timestamp INTEGER,
34	            method TEXT,
35	            url TEXT,
36	            status INTEGER,
37	            duration INTEGER,
38	            model TEXT,
39	            error TEXT
40	        )",
41	        [],
42	    ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
43	
44	    // Try to add new columns (ignore errors if they exist)
45	    let _ = conn.execute("ALTER TABLE request_logs ADD COLUMN request_body TEXT", []);
46	    let _ = conn.execute("ALTER TABLE request_logs ADD COLUMN response_body TEXT", []);
47	    let _ = conn.execute("ALTER TABLE request_logs ADD COLUMN input_tokens INTEGER", []);
48	    let _ = conn.execute("ALTER TABLE request_logs ADD COLUMN output_tokens INTEGER", []);
49	    let _ = conn.execute("ALTER TABLE request_logs ADD COLUMN account_email TEXT", []);
50	    let _ = conn.execute("ALTER TABLE request_logs ADD COLUMN mapped_model TEXT", []);
51	    let _ = conn.execute("ALTER TABLE request_logs ADD COLUMN protocol TEXT", []);
52	    let _ = conn.execute("ALTER TABLE request_logs ADD COLUMN client_ip TEXT", []);
53	    let _ = conn.execute("ALTER TABLE request_logs ADD COLUMN username TEXT", []);
54	
55	    conn.execute(
56	        "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_timestamp ON request_logs (timestamp DESC)",
57	        [],
58	    ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
59	
60	    // Add status index for faster stats queries
61	    conn.execute(
62	        "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_status ON request_logs (status)",
63	        [],
64	    ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
65	
66	    Ok(())
67	}

147	pub fn get_stats() -> Result<crate::proxy::monitor::ProxyStats, String> {
148	    let conn = connect_db()?;
149	
150	    // Optimized: Use single query instead of three separate queries
151	    // Use COALESCE to handle NULL values when table is empty (SUM returns NULL for empty set)
152	    let (total_requests, success_count, error_count): (u64, u64, u64) = conn.query_row(
153	        "SELECT 
154	            COUNT(*) as total,
155	            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status >= 200 AND status < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as success,
156	            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status < 200 OR status >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as error
157	         FROM request_logs",
158	        [],
159	        |row| Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?, row.get(2)?)),
160	    ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
161	
162	    Ok(crate::proxy::monitor::ProxyStats {
163	        total_requests,
164	        success_count,
165	        error_count,
166	    })
167	}

204	/// Cleanup old logs (keep last N days)
205	pub fn cleanup_old_logs(days: i64) -> Result<usize, String> {
206	    let conn = connect_db()?;
207	    
208	    let cutoff_timestamp = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp() - (days * 24 * 3600);
209	    
210	    let deleted = conn.execute(
211	        "DELETE FROM request_logs WHERE timestamp < ?1",
212	        [cutoff_timestamp],
213	    ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
214	    
215	    // Execute VACUUM to reclaim disk space
216	    conn.execute("VACUUM", []).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
217	    
218	    Ok(deleted)
219	}

257	/// Get count of logs matching search filter
258	/// filter: search text to match in url, method, model, or status
259	/// errors_only: if true, only count logs with status < 200 or >= 400
260	pub fn get_logs_count_filtered(filter: &str, errors_only: bool) -> Result<u64, String> {
261	    let conn = connect_db()?;
262	    
263	    let filter_pattern = format!("%{}%", filter);
264	    
265	    let sql = if errors_only {
266	        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM request_logs WHERE (status < 200 OR status >= 400)"
267	    } else if filter.is_empty() {
268	        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM request_logs"
269	    } else {
270	        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM request_logs WHERE
271	            (url LIKE ?1 OR method LIKE ?1 OR model LIKE ?1 OR CAST(status AS TEXT) LIKE ?1 OR account_email LIKE ?1)"
272	    };
273	    
274	    let count: u64 = if filter.is_empty() && !errors_only {
275	        conn.query_row(sql, [], |row| row.get(0))
276	    } else if errors_only {
277	        conn.query_row(sql, [], |row| row.get(0))
278	    } else {
279	        conn.query_row(sql, [&filter_pattern], |row| row.get(0))
280	    }.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
281	    
282	    Ok(count)
283	}

452	/// Get token usage grouped by IP
453	pub fn get_token_usage_by_ip(limit: usize, hours: i64) -> Result<Vec<IpTokenStats>, String> {
454	    let conn = connect_db()?;
455	
456	    // Fix: Database stores timestamp in milliseconds, but we were calculating 'since' in seconds
457	    // Convert 'hours' to milliseconds
458	    let since = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_millis() - (hours * 3600 * 1000);
459	
460	    // [FIX] 不再从 request_logs 表获取 username，因为该字段可能为空
461	    // 先获取 IP 统计数据，然后再单独查询每个 IP 的用户名
462	    let mut stmt = conn.prepare(
463	        "SELECT
464	            client_ip,
465	            COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) as total,
466	            COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) as input,
467	            COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) as output,
468	            COUNT(*) as cnt
469	         FROM request_logs
470	         WHERE timestamp >= ?1 AND client_ip IS NOT NULL AND client_ip != ''
471	         GROUP BY client_ip
472	         ORDER BY total DESC
473	         LIMIT ?2"
474	    ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
475	
476	    let rows = stmt.query_map(params![since, limit], |row| {
477	        Ok((
478	            row.get::<_, String>(0)?,
479	            row.get::<_, i64>(1)?,
480	            row.get::<_, i64>(2)?,
481	            row.get::<_, i64>(3)?,
482	            row.get::<_, i64>(4)?,
483	        ))
484	    }).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
485	
486	    let mut stats = Vec::new();
487	    for row in rows {
488	        let (client_ip, total_tokens, input_tokens, output_tokens, request_count) = row.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
489	        
490	        // 从 user_token_db 获取该 IP 关联的用户名
491	        // 这比从 request_logs 获取更可靠，因为 token_ip_bindings 表在每次 User Token 使用时都会更新
492	        let username = crate::modules::user_token_db::get_username_for_ip(&client_ip).unwrap_or(None);
493	        
494	        stats.push(IpTokenStats {
495	            client_ip,
496	            total_tokens,
497	            input_tokens,
498	            output_tokens,
499	            request_count,
500	            username,
501	        });
502	    }

504	    Ok(stats)

_**Agent (qwen3.6-plus 2026-04-10 10:24:58Z)**_

Now I have a complete picture. Here's the answer:

**不会自动重建。**

原因如下：

1. `proxy_db::init_db()` 仅在 `ProxyMonitor::new()` 中调用（`src-tauri/src/proxy/monitor.rs:46`）
2. `ProxyMonitor` 仅在 **启动代理服务时** 创建（`commands/proxy.rs:115` 或 `232`）
3. 如果删除了 `proxy_logs.db` 但代理服务仍在运行，下一次写日志时会报 `no such table: request_logs` 错误

**建议做法：**

先停止代理服务，再删除数据库，然后重新启动代理：

```bash
# 停止代理后删除
rm ~/.antigravity_tools/proxy_logs.db

# 重启代理服务（或通过 UI 点击重启）
# 此时 ProxyMonitor::new() 会调用 init_db()，自动重建表结构
```

或者直接在前端点击停止/重新启动代理，`init_db()` 会在 `ProxyMonitor::new()` 中执行 `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS request_logs`，自动重建空数据库。

13	fn map_model_for_zai(original: &str, state: &crate::proxy::ZaiConfig) -> String {
14	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
15	    if let Some(mapped) = state.model_mapping.get(original) {
16	        return mapped.clone();
17	    }
18	    if let Some(mapped) = state.model_mapping.get(&m) {
19	        return mapped.clone();
20	    }
21	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
22	        return original[4..].to_string();
23	    }
24	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
25	        return original.to_string();
26	    }
27	    if !m.starts_with("claude-") {
28	        return original.to_string();
29	    }
30	    if m.contains("opus") {
31	        return state.models.opus.clone();
32	    }
33	    if m.contains("haiku") {
34	        return state.models.haiku.clone();
35	    }
36	    state.models.sonnet.clone()
37	}

39	fn join_base_url(base: &str, path: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
40	    let base = base.trim_end_matches('/');
41	    let path = if path.starts_with('/') {
42	        path.to_string()
43	    } else {
44	        format!("/{}", path)
45	    };
46	    Ok(format!("{}{}", base, path))
47	}
48	
49	fn build_client(
50	    upstream_proxy: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
51	    timeout_secs: u64,
52	) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
53	    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
54	        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));
55	
56	    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
57	        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
58	            let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
59	            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
60	                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
61	            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
62	        }
63	    }
64	
65	    builder
66	        .tcp_nodelay(true) // [FIX #307] Disable Nagle's algorithm to improve latency for small requests
67	        .build()
68	        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))
69	}
70	
71	fn copy_passthrough_headers(incoming: &HeaderMap) -> HeaderMap {
72	    // Only forward a conservative set of headers to avoid leaking the local proxy key or cookies.
73	    let mut out = HeaderMap::new();
74	
75	    for (k, v) in incoming.iter() {
76	        let key = k.as_str().to_ascii_lowercase();
77	        match key.as_str() {
78	            "content-type" | "accept" | "anthropic-version" | "user-agent" => {
79	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
80	            }
81	            // Some clients use these for streaming; safe to pass through.
82	            "accept-encoding" | "cache-control" => {
83	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
84	            }
85	            _ => {}
86	        }
87	    }
88	
89	    out
90	}
91	
92	fn set_zai_auth(headers: &mut HeaderMap, incoming: &HeaderMap, api_key: &str) {
93	    // Prefer to keep the same auth scheme as the incoming request:
94	    // - If the client used x-api-key (Anthropic style), replace it.
95	    // - Else if it used Authorization, replace it with Bearer.
96	    // - Else default to x-api-key.
97	    let has_x_api_key = incoming.contains_key("x-api-key");
98	    let has_auth = incoming.contains_key(header::AUTHORIZATION);
99	
100	    if has_x_api_key || !has_auth {
101	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(api_key) {
102	            headers.insert("x-api-key", v);
103	        }
104	    }
105	
106	    if has_auth {
107	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", api_key)) {
108	            headers.insert(header::AUTHORIZATION, v);
109	        }
110	    }
111	}
112	
113	/// Recursively remove cache_control from all nested objects/arrays
114	/// [FIX #290] This is a defensive fix that works regardless of serde annotations
115	pub fn deep_remove_cache_control(value: &mut Value) {
116	    match value {
117	        Value::Object(map) => {
118	            if let Some(v) = map.remove("cache_control") {
119	                tracing::info!("[ISSUE-744] Deep Cleaning found nested cache_control: {:?}", v);
120	            }
121	            for v in map.values_mut() {
122	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
123	            }
124	        }
125	        Value::Array(arr) => {
126	            for v in arr {
127	                deep_remove_cache_control(v);
128	            }
129	        }
130	        _ => {}
131	    }
132	}

136	    method: Method,
137	    path: &str,
138	    incoming_headers: &HeaderMap,
139	    mut body: Value,
140	    message_count: usize, // [NEW v4.0.0] Pass message count for rewind detection
141	) -> Response {

143	    if !zai.enabled || zai.dispatch_mode == crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
144	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "z.ai is disabled").into_response();
145	    }
146	
147	    if zai.api_key.trim().is_empty() {

149	    }

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>

The Claude handler works because the incoming request has `max_tokens: 1024`, which gets preserved. But the OpenAI handler doesn't set `max_tokens` by default (since the OpenAI request doesn't include it).

The fix should be to set a default `max_tokens` in the `to_claude_body` function when it's not provided by the client.
</details></think>

_**Agent (qwen3.6-plus 2026-04-10 11:43:00Z)**_

37	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Exclusive => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
38	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Pooled => ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled,
39	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback => ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback,
40	        };

66	    /// Find enabled providers that can handle the given model.
67	    pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider> {
68	        let m = model.to_lowercase();
69	        self.providers
70	            .iter()
71	            .filter(|p| {
72	                p.model_prefixes.is_empty()
73	                    || p.model_prefixes.iter().any(|prefix| m.starts_with(prefix))
74	            })
75	            .collect()
76	    }
77	
78	    /// Select the next provider for the given model.
79	    /// `prev_failed` excludes a provider that just failed, triggering fallback.
80	    pub fn select(
81	        &self,
82	        model: &str,
83	        prev_failed: Option<&str>,
84	    ) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> {
85	        let candidates: Vec<_> = self
86	            .candidates_for_model(model)
87	            .into_iter()
88	            .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
89	            .collect();
90	
91	        if candidates.is_empty() {
92	            return None;
93	        }
94	
95	        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority)
96	        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates
97	            .iter()
98	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
99	            .copied()
100	            .collect();
101	        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
102	        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
103	            return Some(*p);
104	        }
105	
106	        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
107	        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates
108	            .iter()
109	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
110	            .copied()
111	            .collect();
112	        if !pooled.is_empty() {
113	            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
114	            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % pooled.len();
115	            return Some(pooled[idx]);
116	        }
117	
118	        // 3. Fallback providers
119	        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates
120	            .iter()
121	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
122	            .copied()
123	            .collect();
124	        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
125	        fallback.first().copied()
126	    }

128	    /// Map incoming model name to the provider's native model ID.
129	    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String {
130	        // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
131	        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.get(incoming) {
132	            return mapped.clone();
133	        }
134	        // 2. Prefix match in model_mapping
135	        let m = incoming.to_lowercase();
136	        if let Some((_, mapped)) = provider
137	            .model_mapping
138	            .iter()
139	            .find(|(k, _)| m.starts_with(k.as_str()))
140	        {
141	            return mapped.clone();
142	        }
143	        // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
144	        if m.starts_with("zai:") {
145	            return incoming[4..].to_string();
146	        }
147	        // 4. Pass through glm-* models
148	        if m.starts_with("glm-") {
149	            return incoming.to_string();
150	        }
151	        // 5. Family defaults for Claude models
152	        if m.starts_with("claude-") {
153	            if m.contains("opus") {
154	                return provider.default_models.opus.clone();
155	            }
156	            if m.contains("haiku") {
157	                return provider.default_models.haiku.clone();
158	            }
159	            return provider.default_models.sonnet.clone();
160	        }
161	        // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
162	        incoming.to_string()
163	    }

3	/// 分类流式响应错误并返回错误类型、英文消息和 i18n key
4	///

9	/// 分类流式响应错误并返回错误类型、英文消息和 i18n key
10	/// 
11	/// 返回值: (错误类型, 英文错误消息, i18n_key)
12	pub fn classify_stream_error<E: std::fmt::Display>(error: &E) -> (&'static str, &'static str, &'static str) {
13	    let error_str = error.to_string().to_lowercase();
14	    
15	    if error_str.contains("timeout") || error_str.contains("deadline") {
16	        (
17	            "timeout_error",
18	            "Request timeout, please check your network connection",
19	            "errors.stream.timeout_error"
20	        )
21	    } else if error_str.contains("connection") || error_str.contains("connect") || error_str.contains("dns") {
22	        (
23	            "connection_error",
24	            "Connection failed, please check your network or proxy settings",
25	            "errors.stream.connection_error"
26	        )
27	    } else if error_str.contains("decode") || error_str.contains("parse") {
28	        (
29	            "decode_error",
30	            "Network unstable, data transmission interrupted. Try: 1) Check network 2) Switch proxy 3) Retry",
31	            "errors.stream.decode_error"
32	        )
33	    } else if error_str.contains("stream") || error_str.contains("body") {
34	        (
35	            "stream_error",
36	            "Stream transmission error, please retry later",
37	            "errors.stream.stream_error"
38	        )
39	    } else {
40	        (
41	            "unknown_error",
42	            "Unknown error occurred",
43	            "errors.stream.unknown_error"
44	        )
45	    }
46	}
47

28	    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
29	        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));

31	    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {

36	            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);

38	    }
39	
40	    builder
41	        .tcp_nodelay(true)

43	        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
I found the root cause. In `forward_gemini_via_anthropic` at line 251-257:

```rust
let mapped_model = crate::proxy::providers::router::map_model_for_provider(
    body.get("model")

```

**Gemini native requests do NOT have a `model` field in the body.** The model name is in the URL path (`/v1beta/models/gemini-3-flash:generateContent`), not in the JSON body. 

So `body.get("model")` returns `None`, and `unwrap_or("unknown")` produces the literal string `"unknown"`. This gets passed to `map_model_for_provider`, which just returns it as-is since nothing matches, then the Anthropic API receives a malformed request with `"model": "unknown"` and rejects it. The fix requires passing the actual model name from the URL path to `forward_gemini_via_anthropic` and using it instead of trying to extract it from the request body.
</details></think>

_**Agent (qwen3.6-plus 2026-04-10 12:13:07Z)**_

修复完成。总结一下发现的问题和修改：

## 问题根因

Gemini 原生协议的请求 **body 中没有 `model` 字段**，模型名称在 URL 路径中（如 `/v1beta/models/gemini-3-flash:generateContent`）。

但 `forward_gemini_via_anthropic` 和 `forward_gemini_via_openai_compat` 两个函数都从 body 中提取 model：
```rust
body.get("model")
    .and_then(|m| m.as_str())
    .unwrap_or("unknown"),  // <-- 永远是 "unknown"
```

导致发送给上游 Anthropic/OpenAI 的请求中 `model` 字段为 `"unknown"`，上游拒绝响应。

## 修改内容

**`src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/zai_gemini.rs`**：
- `forward_gemini_via_anthropic` 和 `forward_gemini_via_openai_compat` 新增 `model_name: &str` 参数，直接使用传入的模型名而非从 body 中提取

**`src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/gemini.rs`**：
- 调用上述两个函数时传入 `&model_name`（从 URL 路径解析的真实模型名）

## 架构说明

即使没有配置 Gemini 类型的供应商，Gemini 协议请求仍然可以通过 ProviderRouter 路由到 AnthropicPassthrough 或 OpenAICompatible 协议的供应商（因为空 `model_prefixes` 表示通配所有模型），然后通过协议转换桥接返回 Gemini 格式的响应。

---

9	// useClickOutside Hook
10	export function useClickOutside(
11	    ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
12	    handler: () => void
13	) {
14	    useEffect(() => {
15	        const listener = (event: MouseEvent) => {
16	            if (!ref.current || ref.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
17	                return;
18	            }
19	            handler();
20	        };
21	
22	        document.addEventListener('mousedown', listener);
23	        return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', listener);
24	    }, [ref, handler]);
25	}
26	
27	// 语言下拉菜单组件
28	interface LanguageDropdownProps {
29	    currentLanguage: string;
30	    languages: Language[];
31	    onLanguageChange: (langCode: string) => void;
32	    className?: string;
33	}
34	
35	export function LanguageDropdown({
36	    currentLanguage,

40	}: LanguageDropdownProps) {

42	    const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
43	    const { t } = useTranslation();
44	
45	    useClickOutside(menuRef, () => setIsOpen(false));

48	        onLanguageChange(langCode);
49	        setIsOpen(false);
50	    };
51	
52	    return (
53	        <div className={`relative ${className}`} ref={menuRef}>
54	            <button
55	                onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
56	                className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-base-200 hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-base-100 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors"
57	                title={t('settings.general.language')}
58	            >
59	                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
60	                    {languages.find(l => l.code === currentLanguage)?.short || 'EN'}
61	                </span>
62	            </button>

# 重构菜单：新增"服务配置"和"路由管理"页面

## 背景

当前"API 反代"页面 (`ApiProxy.tsx`) 内容过于庞大，混合了多种不同职责的配置项。用户希望将其拆分为更清晰的菜单结构：

- **服务配置**：服务基础配置 + CLI 同步 + MCP + 多协议支持 + 支持模型与集成
- **路由管理**：高级思维与全局配置 + 实验性设置 + 模型路由中心

## 变更概要

### 1. 新增两个页面

| 新页面 | 文件 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| 服务配置 | `src/pages/ServiceConfig.tsx` | 从 ApiProxy.tsx 提取 |
| 路由管理 | `src/pages/RouteManager.tsx` | 从 ApiProxy.tsx 提取 |

### 2. 菜单项变更 (`src/components/navbar/Navbar.tsx`)

在现有菜单中新增两项（high priority）：

\```
{ path: '/service-config', label: t('nav.service_config'), icon: Settings, priority: 'high' },
{ path: '/route-manage', label: t('nav.route_manage'), icon: BrainCircuit, priority: 'high' },
\```

### 3. 路由注册 (`src/App.tsx`)

\```tsx
{ path: 'service-config', element: <ServiceConfig /> },
{ path: 'route-manage', element: <RouteManager /> },
\```

### 4. 从 ApiProxy.tsx 拆出的内容

**ServiceConfig.tsx 包含：**
- 服务基础配置（端口、超时、自启动、LAN 访问、鉴权、API Key 等）— 即原"服务配置"卡片
- CLI 配置一键同步 (`CliSyncCard`)
- MCP 系统配置
- 多协议支持（OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini 卡片）
- 支持模型与集成（模型列表表 + 代码预览）

**RouteManager.tsx 包含：**
- 高级思维与全局配置 (`AdvancedThinking` 组件)
- 实验性设置（usage_scaling、context compression）
- 模型路由中心（预设管理、自定义映射、背景任务模型配置）

**ApiProxy.tsx 保留：**
- 账号调度与轮换（CacheFirst/Balance/PerformanceFirst）
- 熔断器配置
- Cloudflared 公共访问
- （保留一个精简的入口页面，或考虑将此页面改为"调度与高级"页面）

### 5. 代码复用策略

由于 ApiProxy.tsx 中的状态（`appConfig`、`configLoading`、`status` 等）和函数（`handleSave`、`handleToggle` 等）被多处共享，**最佳做法是提取公共 hooks**：

- 提取 `useProxyConfig()` hook：封装 `appConfig`、`configLoading`、`status`、`handleSave`、`handleToggle` 等公共逻辑
- 三个页面（ApiProxy、ServiceConfig、RouteManager）共享同一个 hook

### 6. i18n 翻译键

在 12 个 locale 文件中新增：
- `nav.service_config` — "服务配置"
- `nav.route_manage` — "路由管理"

|---|---|
| `src/pages/ServiceConfig.tsx` | **新建** |
| `src/pages/RouteManager.tsx` | **新建** |
| `src/hooks/useProxyConfig.ts` | **新建** — 提取公共 hook |
| `src/App.tsx` | 编辑 — 新增路由 |
| `src/components/navbar/Navbar.tsx` | 编辑 — 新增菜单项 |
| `src/pages/ApiProxy.tsx` | 编辑 — 移除已拆出的章节，复用 hook |
| `src/locales/*.json` (12 文件) | 编辑 — 新增翻译键 |

66	function CollapsibleCard({
67	    title,
68	    icon,
69	    enabled,
70	    onToggle,
71	    children,
72	    defaultExpanded = false,
73	    rightElement,
74	    allowInteractionWhenDisabled = false,
75	}: CollapsibleCardProps) {
76	    const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(defaultExpanded);
77	    const { t } = useTranslation();
78	
79	    return (
80	        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-base-100 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700/50 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-md">
81	            <div
82	                className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer bg-gray-50/50 dark:bg-gray-800/50 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-700/50 transition-colors"
83	                onClick={(e) => {
84	                    // Prevent toggle when clicking the switch or right element
85	                    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.no-expand')) return;
86	                    setIsExpanded(!isExpanded);
87	                }}
88	            >
89	                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
90	                    <div className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
91	                        {icon}
92	                    </div>
93	                    <span className="font-medium text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
94	                        {title}
95	                    </span>
96	                    {enabled !== undefined && (
97	                        <div className={cn('text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full', enabled ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/40 dark:text-green-400' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-500 dark:bg-gray-600/50 dark:text-gray-300')}>
98	                            {enabled ? t('common.enabled') : t('common.disabled')}
99	                        </div>
100	                    )}
101	                </div>
102	
103	                <div className="flex items-center gap-4 no-expand">
104	                    {rightElement}
105	
106	                    {enabled !== undefined && onToggle && (
107	                        <div className="flex items-center" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
108	                            <input
109	                                type="checkbox"
110	                                className="toggle toggle-sm bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 checked:bg-blue-500 checked:border-blue-500"
111	                                checked={enabled}
112	                                onChange={(e) => onToggle(e.target.checked)}
113	                            />
114	                        </div>
115	                    )}
116	
117	                    <button
118	                        className={cn('p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 transition-all duration-200', isExpanded ? 'rotate-180' : '')}
119	                    >
120	                        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
121	                            <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" />
122	                        </svg>
123	                    </button>
124	                </div>
125	            </div>
126	
127	            <div
128	                className={`transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-base-200 ${isExpanded ? 'max-h-[2000px] opacity-100' : 'max-h-0 opacity-0 overflow-hidden'
129	                    }`}
130	            >
131	                <div className="p-5 relative">
132	                    {/* Overlay when disabled */}
133	                    {enabled === false && !allowInteractionWhenDisabled && (
134	                        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gray-100/40 dark:bg-black/30 z-10 cursor-not-allowed" />
135	                    )}
136	                    <div className={enabled === false && !allowInteractionWhenDisabled ? 'opacity-60 pointer-events-none select-none' : ''}>
137	                        {children}
138	                    </div>
139	                </div>
140	
141	            </div>
142	        </div>
143	    );
144	}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { AppConfig } from '../types/config';
import { showToast } from '../components/common/ToastContainer';
import { request as invoke } from '../utils/request';

interface ProxyStatus {
    running: boolean;
    port: number;
    base_url: string;
    active_accounts: number;
}

interface UseProxyConfigReturn {
    appConfig: AppConfig | null;
    configLoading: boolean;
    configError: string | null;
    status: ProxyStatus;
    loading: boolean;
    setAppConfig: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<AppConfig | null>>;
    saveConfig: (newConfig: AppConfig) => Promise<void>;
    handleToggle: () => Promise<void>;
    loadConfig: () => Promise<void>;
    loadStatus: () => Promise<void>;
}

export function useProxyConfig(): UseProxyConfigReturn {
    const [appConfig, setAppConfig] = useState<AppConfig | null>(null);
    const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);
    const [configError, setConfigError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [status, setStatus] = useState<ProxyStatus>({
        running: false,
        port: 0,
        base_url: '',
        active_accounts: 0,
    });
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

    const loadConfig = async () => {
        setConfigLoading(true);
        setConfigError(null);
        try {
            const config = await invoke<AppConfig>('load_config');
            setAppConfig(config);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('加载配置失败:', error);
            setConfigError(String(error));
        } finally {
            setConfigLoading(false);
        }
    };

    const loadStatus = async () => {
        try {
            const s = await invoke<ProxyStatus>('get_proxy_status');
            if (s.base_url === 'starting' || s.base_url === 'busy') {
                setStatus(prev => ({ ...s, running: prev.running }));
            } else {
                setStatus(s);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('获取状态失败:', error);
        }
    };

    const saveConfig = async (newConfig: AppConfig) => {
        setAppConfig(newConfig);
        try {
            await invoke('save_config', { config: newConfig });
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('保存配置失败:', error);
            showToast(`保存失败: ${error}`, 'error');
        }
    };

    const handleToggle = async () => {
        if (!appConfig) return;
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            if (status.running) {
                await invoke('stop_proxy_service');
                showToast('代理服务已停止', 'success');
            } else {
                await invoke('start_proxy_service', { config: appConfig.proxy });
                showToast('代理服务已启动', 'success');
            }
            await loadStatus();
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('切换服务状态失败:', error);
            showToast(`操作失败: ${error}`, 'error');
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        loadConfig();
        loadStatus();
        const interval = setInterval(loadStatus, 3000);
        return () => clearInterval(interval);
    }, []);

    return {
        appConfig,
        configLoading,
        configError,
        status,
        loading,
        setAppConfig,
        saveConfig,
        handleToggle,
        loadConfig,
        loadStatus,
    };
}

        }
    };

    const updateProxyConfig = async (partial: Partial<ProxyConfig>) => {
        if (!appConfig) return;

        await saveConfig(newConfig);

                        <div className="border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-base-300 pt-3 mt-3">
                            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                                <div className="space-y-2">
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                            {t('proxy.config.allow_lan_access')}
                                            <HelpTooltip text={t('proxy.config.allow_lan_access_tooltip')} ariaLabel={t('proxy.config.allow_lan_access')} placement="right" />
                                        </span>
                                        <input type="checkbox" className="toggle toggle-sm bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 checked:bg-blue-500 checked:border-blue-500"
                                            checked={appConfig.proxy.allow_lan_access || false}
                                            onChange={(e) => updateProxyConfig({ allow_lan_access: e.target.checked })} />
                                    </div>
                                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                                        {(appConfig.proxy.allow_lan_access || false) ? t('proxy.config.allow_lan_access_hint_enabled') : t('proxy.config.allow_lan_access_hint_disabled')}
                                    </p>
                                    {(appConfig.proxy.allow_lan_access || false) && (
                                        <p className="text-[10px] text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-500">{t('proxy.config.allow_lan_access_warning')}</p>
                                    )}
                                    {status.running && (
                                        <p className="text-[10px] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">{t('proxy.config.allow_lan_access_restart_hint')}</p>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                                <div className="space-y-2">
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                        <label className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                                {t('proxy.config.auth.title')}
                                                <HelpTooltip text={t('proxy.config.auth.title_tooltip')} ariaLabel={t('proxy.config.auth.title')} placement="top" />
                                            </span>
                                        </label>
                                        <label className="flex items-center cursor-pointer gap-2">
                                            <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                                {(appConfig.proxy.auth_mode || 'off') !== 'off' ? t('proxy.config.auth.enabled') : t('common.disabled')}
                                                <HelpTooltip text={t('proxy.config.auth.enabled_tooltip')} ariaLabel={t('proxy.config.auth.enabled')} placement="left" />
                                            </span>
                                            <input type="checkbox" className="toggle toggle-sm bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 checked:bg-blue-500 checked:border-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:bg-gray-100 dark:disabled:bg-gray-800"
                                                checked={(appConfig.proxy.auth_mode || 'off') !== 'off'}
                                                onChange={(e) => updateProxyConfig({ auth_mode: e.target.checked ? 'all_except_health' : 'off' })} />
                                        </label>
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <label className="block text-[11px] text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-1">
                                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                                {t('proxy.config.auth.mode')}
                                                <HelpTooltip text={t('proxy.config.auth.mode_tooltip')} ariaLabel={t('proxy.config.auth.mode')} placement="top" />
                                            </span>
                                        </label>
                                        <select value={appConfig.proxy.auth_mode || 'off'}
                                            onChange={(e) => updateProxyConfig({ auth_mode: e.target.value as ProxyConfig['auth_mode'] })}
                                            className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 dark:border-base-200 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-xs text-gray-900 dark:text-base-content focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent">
                                            <option value="off">{t('proxy.config.auth.modes.off')}</option>
                                            <option value="strict">{t('proxy.config.auth.modes.strict')}</option>
                                            <option value="all_except_health">{t('proxy.config.auth.modes.all_except_health')}</option>
                                            <option value="auto">{t('proxy.config.auth.modes.auto')}</option>
                                        </select>
                                        <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{t('proxy.config.auth.hint')}</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* API 密钥 */}
                        <div>
                            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-1">
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                    {t('proxy.config.api_key')}
                                    <HelpTooltip text={t('proxy.config.api_key_tooltip')} ariaLabel={t('proxy.config.api_key')} placement="right" />
                                </span>
                            </label>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                                <input type="text"
                                    value={isEditingApiKey ? tempApiKey : (appConfig.proxy.api_key)}
                                    onChange={(e) => isEditingApiKey && setTempApiKey(e.target.value)}
                                    readOnly={!isEditingApiKey}
                                    className={`flex-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 dark:border-base-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono ${isEditingApiKey ? 'bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-gray-900 dark:text-base-content' : 'bg-gray-50 dark:bg-base-300 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400'}`} />
                                {isEditingApiKey ? (<>
                                    <button onClick={handleSaveApiKey} className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-green-300 dark:border-green-700 rounded-lg bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 hover:bg-green-100 dark:hover:bg-green-900/30 transition-colors text-green-600 dark:text-green-400" title={t('proxy.config.btn_save')}><CheckCircle size={14} /></button>
                                    <button onClick={handleCancelEditApiKey} className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 dark:border-base-200 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-base-200 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-base-300 transition-colors" title={t('common.cancel')}><X size={14} /></button>
                                </>) : (<>
                                    <button onClick={handleEditApiKey} className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 dark:border-base-200 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-base-200 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-base-300 transition-colors" title={t('proxy.config.btn_edit')}><Edit2 size={14} /></button>
                                    <button onClick={handleGenerateApiKey} className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 dark:border-base-200 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-base-200 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-base-300 transition-colors" title={t('proxy.config.btn_regenerate')}><RefreshCw size={14} /></button>
                                    <button onClick={() => copyToClipboardHandler(appConfig.proxy.api_key, 'api_key')} className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 dark:border-base-200 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-base-200 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-base-300 transition-colors" title={t('proxy.config.btn_copy')}>
                                        {copied === 'api_key' ? <CheckCircle size={14} className="text-green-500" /> : <Copy size={14} />}
                                    </button>
                                </>)}
                            </div>
                            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-500">{t('proxy.config.warning_key')}</p>
                        </div>

                        {/* Web UI 管理密码 */}
                        <div className="border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-base-300 pt-3 mt-3">
                            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-1">
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                    {t('proxy.config.admin_password', { defaultValue: 'Web UI Login Password' })}
                                    <HelpTooltip text={t('proxy.config.admin_password_tooltip', { defaultValue: 'Used for logging into the Web Management Console. If empty, it defaults to the API Key.' })} ariaLabel={t('proxy.config.admin_password')} placement="right" />
                                </span>
                            </label>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                                <input type="text"
                                    value={isEditingAdminPassword ? tempAdminPassword : (appConfig.proxy.admin_password || t('proxy.config.admin_password_default', { defaultValue: '(Same as API Key)' }))}
                                    onChange={(e) => isEditingAdminPassword && setTempAdminPassword(e.target.value)}
                                    readOnly={!isEditingAdminPassword}
                                    placeholder={t('proxy.config.admin_password_placeholder', { defaultValue: 'Enter new password or leave empty to use API Key' })}
                                    className={`flex-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 dark:border-base-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono ${isEditingAdminPassword ? 'bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-gray-900 dark:text-base-content' : 'bg-gray-50 dark:bg-base-300 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400'}`} />
                                {isEditingAdminPassword ? (<>
                                    <button onClick={handleSaveAdminPassword} className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-green-300 dark:border-green-700 rounded-lg bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 hover:bg-green-100 dark:hover:bg-green-900/30 transition-colors text-green-600 dark:text-green-400" title={t('proxy.config.btn_save')}><CheckCircle size={14} /></button>
                                    <button onClick={handleCancelEditAdminPassword} className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 dark:border-base-200 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-base-200 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-base-300 transition-colors" title={t('common.cancel')}><X size={14} /></button>
                                </>) : (<>
                                    <button onClick={handleEditAdminPassword} className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 dark:border-base-200 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-base-200 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-base-300 transition-colors" title={t('proxy.config.btn_edit')}><Edit2 size={14} /></button>
                                    <button onClick={() => copyToClipboardHandler(appConfig.proxy.admin_password || appConfig.proxy.api_key, 'admin_password')} className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 dark:border-base-200 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-base-200 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-base-300 transition-colors" title={t('proxy.config.btn_copy')}>
                                        {copied === 'admin_password' ? <CheckCircle size={14} className="text-green-500" /> : <Copy size={14} />}
                                    </button>
                                </>)}
                            </div>
                            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{t('proxy.config.admin_password_hint', { defaultValue: 'For safety in Docker/Browser environments, you can set a separate login password from your API Key.' })}</p>
                        </div>

                        {/* User-Agent Overrides */}
                        <div className="border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-base-300 pt-3 mt-3">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                                <label className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                    {t('proxy.config.request.user_agent', { defaultValue: 'User-Agent Override' })}
                                    <HelpTooltip text={t('proxy.config.request.user_agent_tooltip', { defaultValue: 'Override the User-Agent header sent to upstream APIs.' })} />
                                </label>
                                <input type="checkbox" className="toggle toggle-sm bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 checked:bg-blue-500 checked:border-blue-500"
                                    checked={!!appConfig.proxy.user_agent_override}
                                    onChange={(e) => {
                                        if (e.target.checked) {
                                            const restoredValue = appConfig.proxy.saved_user_agent || 'antigravity/1.15.8 darwin/arm64';
                                            updateProxyConfig({ user_agent_override: restoredValue, saved_user_agent: restoredValue });
                                        } else {
                                            updateProxyConfig({ user_agent_override: undefined });
                                        }
                                    }} />
                            </div>
                            {!!appConfig.proxy.user_agent_override && (
                                <div className="space-y-2 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-200">
                                    <input type="text" value={appConfig.proxy.user_agent_override}
                                        onChange={(e) => { const v = e.target.value; updateProxyConfig({ user_agent_override: v, saved_user_agent: v }); }}
                                        className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 dark:border-base-200 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-base-200 text-xs font-mono text-gray-900 dark:text-base-content focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
                                        placeholder={t('proxy.config.request.user_agent_placeholder', { defaultValue: 'Enter custom User-Agent string...' })} />
                                    <div className="bg-gray-50 dark:bg-base-300 rounded p-2 text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-mono break-all">
                                        <span className="font-bold select-none mr-2">{t('common.example', { defaultValue: 'Example' })}:</span>
                                        antigravity/1.15.8 darwin/arm64
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* CLI 配置一键同步 */}
                <div className="bg-white dark:bg-base-100 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700/50 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-md">
                    <div className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-50/50 dark:bg-gray-800/50">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"><Terminal size={18} /></div>
                            <span className="font-medium text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">{t('proxy.cli_sync.title', { defaultValue: 'CLI 配置一键同步' })}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-5">
                        <CliSyncCard
                            proxyUrl={status.running ? status.base_url : `http://127.0.0.1:${appConfig.proxy.port || 8045}`}
                            apiKey={appConfig.proxy.api_key}
                        />
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* MCP 系统 */}
                <div className="bg-white dark:bg-base-100 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700/50 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-md">
                    <div className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-50/50 dark:bg-gray-800/50">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div className="text-blue-500"><Puzzle size={18} /></div>
                            <span className="font-medium text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">{t('proxy.config.zai.mcp.title')}</span>
                            <div className="flex gap-2 text-[10px]">
                                {['web_search', 'web_reader', 'vision'].map(f =>
                                    appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp?.[(f + '_enabled') as keyof typeof appConfig.proxy.zai.mcp] && (
                                        <span key={f} className="bg-blue-500 dark:bg-blue-600 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white font-semibold shadow-sm">
                                            {t(`proxy.config.zai.mcp.${f}`).split(' ')[0]}
                                        </span>
                                    )
                                )}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                            <input type="checkbox" className="toggle toggle-sm bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 checked:bg-blue-500 checked:border-blue-500"
                                checked={!!appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp?.enabled}
                                onChange={(e) => updateProxyConfig({ zai: { ...appConfig.proxy.zai, mcp: { ...appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp, enabled: e.target.checked } } })} />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-5 space-y-3">
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 border border-gray-100 dark:border-base-200 p-2 rounded-lg cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-base-200/50 transition-colors">
                                <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-xs rounded border-2 border-gray-400 dark:border-gray-500 checked:border-blue-600 checked:bg-blue-600 [--chkbg:theme(colors.blue.600)] [--chkfg:white]"
                                    checked={!!appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp?.web_search_enabled}
                                    onChange={(e) => updateProxyConfig({ zai: { ...appConfig.proxy.zai, mcp: { ...appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp, web_search_enabled: e.target.checked } } })} />
                                <span className="text-xs">{t('proxy.config.zai.mcp.web_search')}</span>
                            </label>
                            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 border border-gray-100 dark:border-base-200 p-2 rounded-lg cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-base-200/50 transition-colors">
                                <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-xs rounded border-2 border-gray-400 dark:border-gray-500 checked:border-blue-600 checked:bg-blue-600 [--chkbg:theme(colors.blue.600)] [--chkfg:white]"
                                    checked={!!appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp?.web_reader_enabled}
                                    onChange={(e) => updateProxyConfig({ zai: { ...appConfig.proxy.zai, mcp: { ...appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp, web_reader_enabled: e.target.checked } } })} />
                                <span className="text-xs">{t('proxy.config.zai.mcp.web_reader')}</span>
                            </label>
                            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 border border-gray-100 dark:border-base-200 p-2 rounded-lg cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-base-200/50 transition-colors">
                                <input type="checkbox" className="checkbox checkbox-xs rounded border-2 border-gray-400 dark:border-gray-500 checked:border-blue-600 checked:bg-blue-600 [--chkbg:theme(colors.blue.600)] [--chkfg:white]"
                                    checked={!!appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp?.vision_enabled}
                                    onChange={(e) => updateProxyConfig({ zai: { ...appConfig.proxy.zai, mcp: { ...appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp, vision_enabled: e.target.checked } } })} />
                                <span className="text-xs">{t('proxy.config.zai.mcp.vision')}</span>
                            </label>
                        </div>
                        {appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp?.enabled && (
                            <div className="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 rounded-lg p-3 text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                                <div className="mb-1 font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">{t('proxy.config.zai.mcp.local_endpoints')}</div>
                                <div className="space-y-0.5 select-all">
                                    {appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp?.web_search_enabled && <div>http://127.0.0.1:{status.running ? status.port : (appConfig.proxy.port || 8045)}/mcp/web_search_prime/mcp</div>}
                                    {appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp?.web_reader_enabled && <div>http://127.0.0.1:{status.running ? status.port : (appConfig.proxy.port || 8045)}/mcp/web_reader/mcp</div>}
                                    {appConfig.proxy.zai?.mcp?.vision_enabled && <div>http://127.0.0.1:{status.running ? status.port : (appConfig.proxy.port || 8045)}/mcp/zai-mcp-server/mcp</div>}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* 多协议支持 */}
                <div className="bg-white dark:bg-base-100 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 dark:border-base-200 overflow-hidden">
                    <div className="p-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
                            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500 to-purple-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-md">
                                <Code size={16} className="text-white" />
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-base-content">{t('proxy.multi_protocol.title')}</h3>
                                <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{t('proxy.multi_protocol.subtitle')}</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-4 leading-relaxed">{t('proxy.multi_protocol.description')}</p>
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                            {/* OpenAI Card */}
                            <div className={cn('p-3 rounded-xl border-2 transition-all cursor-pointer', selectedProtocol === 'openai' ? 'border-blue-500 bg-blue-50/30 dark:bg-blue-900/10' : 'border-gray-100 dark:border-base-200 hover:border-blue-200')}
                                onClick={() => setSelectedProtocol('openai')}>
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-600">{t('proxy.multi_protocol.openai_label')}</span>
                                    <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); copyToClipboardHandler(`http://127.0.0.1:${status.running ? status.port : (appConfig.proxy.port || 8045)}/v1`, 'openai'); }} className="btn btn-ghost btn-xs">
                                        {copied === 'openai' ? <CheckCircle size={14} /> : <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-tighter"><Copy size={12} /> {t('proxy.multi_protocol.copy_base', { defaultValue: 'Base' })}</div>}
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div className="space-y-1">
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/5 rounded p-0.5 group">
                                        <code className="text-[10px] opacity-70">/v1/chat/completions</code>
                                        <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); copyToClipboardHandler(`http://127.0.0.1:${status.running ? status.port : (appConfig.proxy.port || 8045)}/v1/chat/completions`, 'openai-chat'); }} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">{copied === 'openai-chat' ? <CheckCircle size={10} className="text-green-500" /> : <Copy size={10} />}</button>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/5 rounded p-0.5 group">
                                        <code className="text-[10px] opacity-70">/v1/completions</code>
                                        <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); copyToClipboardHandler(`http://127.0.0.1:${status.running ? status.port : (appConfig.proxy.port || 8045)}/v1/completions`, 'openai-compl'); }} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">{copied === 'openai-compl' ? <CheckCircle size={10} className="text-green-500" /> : <Copy size={10} />}</button>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/5 rounded p-0.5 group">
                                        <code className="text-[10px] opacity-70 font-bold text-blue-500">/v1/responses (Codex)</code>
                                        <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); copyToClipboardHandler(`http://127.0.0.1:${status.running ? status.port : (appConfig.proxy.port || 8045)}/v1/responses`, 'openai-resp'); }} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">{copied === 'openai-resp' ? <CheckCircle size={10} className="text-green-500" /> : <Copy size={10} />}</button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            {/* Anthropic Card */}
                            <div className={cn('p-3 rounded-xl border-2 transition-all cursor-pointer', selectedProtocol === 'anthropic' ? 'border-purple-500 bg-purple-50/30 dark:bg-purple-900/10' : 'border-gray-100 dark:border-base-200 hover:border-purple-200')}
                                onClick={() => setSelectedProtocol('anthropic')}>
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-purple-600">{t('proxy.multi_protocol.anthropic_label')}</span>
                                    <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); copyToClipboardHandler(`http://127.0.0.1:${status.running ? status.port : (appConfig.proxy.port || 8045)}/v1/messages`, 'anthropic'); }} className="btn btn-ghost btn-xs">
                                        {copied === 'anthropic' ? <CheckCircle size={14} /> : <Copy size={14} />}
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <code className="text-[10px] block truncate bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/5 p-1 rounded">/v1/messages</code>
                            </div>
                            {/* Gemini Card */}
                            <div className={cn('p-3 rounded-xl border-2 transition-all cursor-pointer', selectedProtocol === 'gemini' ? 'border-green-500 bg-green-50/30 dark:bg-green-900/10' : 'border-gray-100 dark:border-base-200 hover:border-green-200')}
                                onClick={() => setSelectedProtocol('gemini')}>
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-green-600">{t('proxy.multi_protocol.gemini_label')}</span>
                                    <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); copyToClipboardHandler(`http://127.0.0.1:${status.running ? status.port : (appConfig.proxy.port || 8045)}/v1beta/models`, 'gemini'); }} className="btn btn-ghost btn-xs">
                                        {copied === 'gemini' ? <CheckCircle size={14} /> : <Copy size={14} />}

7	export const useProxyModels = () => {
8	    const { t } = useTranslation();
9	    const { accounts, fetchAccounts } = useAccountStore();
10	
11	    // 确保账号数据已加载（针对未触发 fetchAccounts 的页面，如 ApiProxy）
12	    useEffect(() => {
13	        if (accounts.length === 0) {
14	            fetchAccounts();
15	        }
16	    }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
17	
18	    const models = useMemo(() => {
19	        // Step 1: 从所有账号中收集动态模型
20	        // 以 name（小写）为 key 去重，优先保留含 display_name 的条目
21	        const dynamicMap = new Map<string, { name: string; display_name?: string }>();
22	        for (const account of accounts) {
23	            for (const m of account.quota?.models ?? []) {
24	                const key = m.name.toLowerCase();
25	                if (!dynamicMap.has(key) || m.display_name) {
26	                    dynamicMap.set(key, { name: m.name, display_name: m.display_name });
27	                }
28	            }
29	        }
30	
31	        const result = [];
32	        const seenIds = new Set<string>();
33	
34	        // Step 2: 优先展示来自账号的动态模型（display_name 为主名称，name 为 ID）
35	        for (const [key, m] of dynamicMap) {
36	            if (seenIds.has(key)) continue;
37	            seenIds.add(key);
38	
39	            // 尝试匹配 MODEL_CONFIG 里的图标与分组
40	            const cfgEntry = Object.entries(MODEL_CONFIG).find(
41	                ([cfgId, cfg]) =>
42	                    cfgId.toLowerCase() === key ||
43	                    (cfg.protectedKey && cfg.protectedKey.toLowerCase() === key)
44	            );
45	
46	            const primaryName = m.display_name || m.name;
47	            const CfgIcon = cfgEntry?.[1].Icon;
48	            const icon = CfgIcon
49	                ? <CfgIcon size={16} />
50	                : <Bot size={16} className="text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500" />;
51	            const group = cfgEntry ? (cfgEntry[1].group || 'Other') : 'Dynamic';
52	
53	            result.push({
54	                id: m.name,           // 原始模型 name，作为 ID 展示
55	                name: primaryName,    // display_name（主要展示名称）
56	                desc: primaryName,    // 描述栏同样用 display_name
57	                group,
58	                icon,
59	            });
60	        }
61	
62	        // Step 3: 对于 MODEL_CONFIG 里有但账号未下发的型号，作为静态兜底补充
63	        const addedLabels = new Set<string>();
64	        for (const [id, config] of Object.entries(MODEL_CONFIG)) {
65	            const key = id.toLowerCase();
66	            if (seenIds.has(key)) {
67	                addedLabels.add((config.shortLabel || config.label).toLowerCase());
68	                continue;
69	            }
70	            // 跳过 thinking 变体（这类模型的动态版本由账号数据中 supports_thinking 标记覆盖）
71	            if (key.includes('-thinking')) continue;
72	            // 跳过 label 重复的别名条目
73	            const labelKey = (config.shortLabel || config.label).toLowerCase();
74	            if (addedLabels.has(labelKey)) continue;
75	            addedLabels.add(labelKey);
76	            seenIds.add(key);
77	
78	            const displayName = config.i18nKey ? t(config.i18nKey, config.label) : config.label;
79	            result.push({
80	                id,
81	                name: displayName,
82	                desc: displayName,
83	                group: config.group || 'Other',
84	                icon: <config.Icon size={16} />,
85	            });
86	        }
87	
88	        return result;
89	    }, [accounts, t]);
90	
91	    return { models };
92	};

export default function RouteManager() {

    const [isResetConfirmOpen, setIsResetConfirmOpen] = useState(false);

    const customMappingOptions: SelectOption[] = useMemo(() => {

            mappings: {
                "gpt-4*": "claude-opus-4-6-thinking",
                "gpt-4o*": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
                "gpt-3.5*": "gemini-3-flash",
                "o1-*": "claude-opus-4-6-thinking",
                "o3-*": "claude-opus-4-6-thinking",
                "claude-3-5-sonnet-*": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
                "claude-3-opus-*": "claude-opus-4-6-thinking",
                "claude-opus-4-6*": "claude-opus-4-6-thinking",
                "claude-haiku-*": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
                "claude-3-haiku-*": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
            }
        },
        {
            id: 'cost-effective',
            name: t('proxy.router.preset_cost'),
            description: t('proxy.router.preset_cost_desc'),
            mappings: {
                "gpt-4*": "gemini-3-flash",
                "gpt-4o*": "gemini-2.5-flash",
                "gpt-3.5*": "gemini-2.5-flash",
                "o1-*": "gemini-3-flash",
                "o3-*": "gemini-3-flash",
                "claude-3-5-sonnet-*": "gemini-3-flash",
                "claude-3-opus-*": "gemini-3-flash",
                "claude-opus-4-*": "gemini-3-flash",
                "claude-haiku-*": "gemini-2.5-flash",
                "claude-3-haiku-*": "gemini-2.5-flash",
            }
        },
        {
            id: 'balanced',
            name: t('proxy.router.preset_balanced'),
            description: t('proxy.router.preset_balanced_desc'),
            mappings: {
                "gpt-4*": "gemini-3.1-pro-high",
                "gpt-4o*": "gemini-3-flash",
                "gpt-3.5*": "gemini-2.5-flash",
                "o1-*": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
                "o3-*": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
