                            <Cpu className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />{t('token_stats.model_details', '分模型详细统计')}
                        </h2>
                        <table className="w-full text-sm min-w-[600px]">
                            <thead>
                                <tr className="border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
                                    <th className="text-left py-2 px-3 font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 text-xs">{t('token_stats.model', '模型')}</th>
                                    <th className="text-right py-2 px-3 font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 text-xs">{t('token_stats.requests', '请求数')}</th>
                                    <th className="text-right py-2 px-3 font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 text-xs">{t('token_stats.input', '输入')}</th>
                                    <th className="text-right py-2 px-3 font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 text-xs">{t('token_stats.output', '输出')}</th>
                                    <th className="text-right py-2 px-3 font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 text-xs">{t('token_stats.total', '合计')}</th>
                                    <th className="text-right py-2 px-3 font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 text-xs">{t('token_stats.percentage', '占比')}</th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                                {modelData.map((model, idx) => {
                                    const pct = summary ? ((model.total_tokens / summary.total_tokens) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0';
                                    return (
                                        <tr key={model.model} className="border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700/50 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-700/30">
                                            <td className="py-2 px-3">
                                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                                    <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: MODEL_COLORS[idx % MODEL_COLORS.length] }} />
                                                    <span className="text-gray-800 dark:text-white text-xs font-medium">{model.model}</span>
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 text-xs">{model.request_count.toLocaleString()}</td>
                                            <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right text-blue-600 text-xs">{formatNumber(model.total_input_tokens)}</td>
                                            <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right text-purple-600 text-xs">{formatNumber(model.total_output_tokens)}</td>
                                            <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right font-semibold text-gray-800 dark:text-white text-xs">{formatNumber(model.total_tokens)}</td>
                                            <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right">
                                                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                                                    <div className="w-16 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-full h-1.5">
                                                        <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ width: `${pct}%`, backgroundColor: MODEL_COLORS[idx % MODEL_COLORS.length] }} />
                                                    </div>
                                                    <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 text-xs w-10 text-right">{pct}%</span>
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                    );
                                })}
                            </tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>
                )}

                {/* 快速链接 */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <button className="bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-900/20 rounded-lg p-3 shadow-sm border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900/30 hover:border-indigo-300 dark:hover:border-indigo-700 hover:shadow-md transition-all flex items-center justify-between group" onClick={() => navigate('/accounts')}>
                        <span className="text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 font-medium text-sm">{t('dashboard.view_all_accounts')}</span>
                        <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-400 dark:text-indigo-500 group-hover:text-indigo-600 dark:group-hover:text-indigo-300 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-all" />
                    </button>
                    <button className="bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-900/20 rounded-lg p-3 shadow-sm border border-purple-100 dark:border-purple-900/30 hover:border-purple-300 dark:hover:border-purple-700 hover:shadow-md transition-all flex items-center justify-between group" onClick={handleExport}>
                        <span className="text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 font-medium text-sm">{t('dashboard.export_data')}</span>
                        <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400 dark:text-purple-500 group-hover:text-purple-600 dark:group-hover:text-purple-300 transition-all" />
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

export default Dashboard;

## Model Routing and Provider Selection: Complete Analysis

### 1. Provider Configuration

**Types file:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/types/config.ts`

Providers are defined via `UpstreamProvider` (lines 24-36 in config.ts):

```typescript
interface UpstreamProvider {
    name: string;
    enabled: boolean;
    base_url: string;
    api_key: string;
    protocol: ProviderProtocol;              // 'anthropic_passthrough' | 'openai_compatible' | 'gemini_v1internal'
    dispatch_mode: ProviderDispatchMode;     // 'exclusive' | 'pooled' | 'fallback'
    priority: number;
    model_prefixes: string[];                // which model prefixes this provider handles (empty = all)
    model_mapping: Record<string, string>;   // per-provider model name overrides
    default_models: ProviderModelDefaults;   // { opus, sonnet, haiku } fallback models
    request_timeout_secs?: number;
}
```

The Providers page does not exist as a standalone UI page -- provider configuration is managed through `AppConfig.proxy.providers` (a `UpstreamProvider[]` array) and the legacy `AppConfig.proxy.zai` (a single `ZaiConfig` provider). The `AppConfig` structure (lines 159-180 in `src/types/config.ts`) holds the full config tree:

```typescript
interface AppConfig {
    proxy: ProxyConfig;      // proxy.enabled, port, api_key, custom_mapping, providers, zai, scheduling, etc.
    // ... other UI-level settings (language, theme, etc.)
}
```

**Rust-side config:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/config.rs`

The same structure is mirrored in Rust with `ProxyConfig` (line 559) containing:
- `custom_mapping: HashMap<String, String>` -- user model routing rules
- `providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>` -- multi-provider gateway config
- `zai: ZaiConfig` -- legacy single-provider config

---

### 2. Model Routing Center (Frontend: RouteManager.tsx)

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/RouteManager.tsx`

The "模型路由中心" (Model Routing Center) UI allows users to manage `custom_mapping` -- a `Record<string, string>` mapping source model names to target model names. Key mechanisms:

**Built-in Presets** (lines 78-148): Four presets shipped in the frontend:
- `default` -- maps GPT models to Gemini, Claude to Claude 4.6
- `performance` -- maps everything to higher-tier Claude models
- `cost-effective` -- maps everything to Gemini Flash
- `balanced` -- mixed high/mid tier routing

**Custom Presets** (lines 64-73, 155-196): User-created presets stored in `localStorage` under key `antigravity_custom_presets`.

**Applying a preset** (lines 198-218): Merges the preset's mappings into `appConfig.proxy.custom_mapping` and calls `invoke('update_model_mapping', ...)` to push changes to the Rust backend.

**Individual mapping CRUD** (lines 221-271): Users can add/edit/remove individual `source_model -> target_model` entries, each persisted via `invoke('update_model_mapping', ...)`.

---

### 3. The `useProxyModels` Hook

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/hooks/useProxyModels.tsx`

This hook builds the unified model list shown in the UI by merging two sources:

1. **Dynamic models** from accounts (lines 21-28): Iterates all accounts' `quota.models[]` arrays, deduplicates by lowercase name, prefers entries with `display_name`.

2. **Static models** from `MODEL_CONFIG` (lines 63-86): For model IDs in `src/config/modelConfig.ts` that are NOT already covered by dynamic account data, adds them as static fallback entries.

Each model entry gets: `{ id, name, desc, group, icon }`. The icon comes from `MODEL_CONFIG[id].Icon` (e.g., `Gemini.Color`, `Claude.Color` from `@lobehub/icons`), or a default `Bot` icon.

---

### 4. Rust Backend: Model-to-Provider Selection Flow

The complete routing chain for an incoming request is:

#### Step 1: Model Name Resolution (`resolve_model_route`)

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/common/model_mapping.rs`

Function `resolve_model_route()` (lines 253-299) applies these priority levels:

1. **Dynamic forwarding rules** (highest priority): `DYNAMIC_MODEL_FORWARDING_RULES` -- runtime-registered deprecated model redirects
2. **Exact custom mapping match**: `custom_mapping.get(original_model)`
3. **Wildcard custom mapping match**: iterates `custom_mapping` entries with `*` patterns, picks the most specific (pattern length minus wildcard count)
4. **System default mapping**: `map_claude_model_to_gemini()` -- built-in `CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI` HashMap (lines 16-89) that maps old Claude/OpenAI model IDs to current Gemini/Claude equivalents
5. **Pass-through**: unknown models are returned as-is

#### Step 2: Provider Selection (`ProviderRouter`)

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/router.rs`

The `ProviderRouter` selects which upstream provider handles the resolved model:

1. `candidates_for_model(model)` (line 67): Filters enabled providers whose `model_prefixes` match the model name (empty prefixes = wildcard, matches all)

2. `select(model, prev_failed)` (line 80): Picks one candidate with this priority:
   - **Exclusive** providers first (sorted by `priority` number)
   - **Pooled** providers next (round-robin among them, sorted by priority)
   - **Fallback** providers last (highest-priority only)

3. `map_model(provider, incoming)` (line 129): Converts the incoming model name to the provider's native model ID using:
   - Exact match in `provider.model_mapping`
   - Prefix match in `provider.model_mapping`
   - Strip `zai:` prefix
   - Pass through `glm-*` models
   - Claude family defaults (`opus`/`sonnet`/`haiku` -> provider's `default_models`)
   - Fallback: pass through as-is

#### Step 3: Account Selection (`TokenManager.get_token`)

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/token_manager.rs`

After the provider is selected, `TokenManager::get_token()` (line 1064) picks a specific Google account (for the default path) using:
- Sticky session support (session_id-based affinity)
- Power of Two Choices (P2C) load balancing (line 964)
- Quota protection checks
- Preferred account / fixed account mode

#### Step 4: Handler Invocation

**Files:**
- `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/openai.rs` (OpenAI protocol handler)
- `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/claude.rs` (Claude protocol handler)
- `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/gemini.rs` (Gemini protocol handler)

Each handler calls `resolve_model_route()` at the start of its request loop to get the `mapped_model`, then uses it for account/provider selection.

---

### 5. "支持模型与集成" Section in ServiceConfig.tsx

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/ServiceConfig.tsx`, lines 708-755

This section provides:
- A **model browser** showing all models from `useProxyModels()` (the merged dynamic+static list)
- A **protocol selector** (OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini) that filters which models are displayed
- **Python code examples** generated dynamically based on the selected model ID and protocol
- A **copy-to-clipboard** button for each model ID

The `filteredModels` logic (lines 305-309) filters out `image` models for the Anthropic protocol tab.

---

### Summary: Complete Model-to-Provider Selection Flow

```
Incoming Request (e.g. model="gpt-4-turbo")
    |
    v
[1] resolve_model_route() in model_mapping.rs
    - Checks dynamic forwarding rules
    - Checks custom_mapping (exact then wildcard)
    - Falls back to CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI built-in map
    - Result: "gemini-2.5-flash"
    |
    v
[2] ProviderRouter.select() in providers/router.rs
    - Finds candidate providers whose model_prefixes match
    - Picks by dispatch_mode: exclusive > pooled (RR) > fallback
    |
    v
[3] ProviderRouter.map_model() in providers/router.rs
    - Maps "gemini-2.5-flash" to provider's native model name
    |
    v
[4] TokenManager.get_token() in token_manager.rs
    - Selects a specific account (sticky session, P2C, quota checks)
    |
    v
[5] Upstream request dispatched to Google/Claude API
```

198	/// Wildcard matching - supports multiple wildcards
199	///
200	/// **Note**: Matching is **case-sensitive**. Pattern `GPT-4*` will NOT match `gpt-4-turbo`.
201	///
202	/// Examples:
203	/// - `gpt-4*` matches `gpt-4`, `gpt-4-turbo` ✓
204	/// - `claude-*-sonnet-*` matches `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022` ✓
205	/// - `*-thinking` matches `claude-opus-4-5-thinking` ✓
206	/// - `a*b*c` matches `a123b456c` ✓
207	fn wildcard_match(pattern: &str, text: &str) -> bool {
208	    let parts: Vec<&str> = pattern.split('*').collect();
209	
210	    // No wildcard - exact match
211	    if parts.len() == 1 {
212	        return pattern == text;
213	    }
214	
215	    let mut text_pos = 0;
216	
217	    for (i, part) in parts.iter().enumerate() {
218	        if part.is_empty() {
219	            continue; // Skip empty segments from consecutive wildcards
220	        }
221	
222	        if i == 0 {
223	            // First segment must match start
224	            if !text[text_pos..].starts_with(part) {
225	                return false;
226	            }
227	            text_pos += part.len();
228	        } else if i == parts.len() - 1 {
229	            // Last segment must match end
230	            return text[text_pos..].ends_with(part);
231	        } else {
232	            // Middle segments - find next occurrence
233	            if let Some(pos) = text[text_pos..].find(part) {
234	                text_pos += pos + part.len();
235	            } else {
236	                return false;
237	            }
238	        }
239	    }
240	
241	    true
242	}

244	/// 核心模型路由解析引擎
245	/// 优先级：精确匹配 > 通配符匹配 > 系统默认映射
246	/// 
247	/// # 参数
248	/// - `original_model`: 原始模型名称
249	/// - `custom_mapping`: 用户自定义映射表
250	/// 
251	/// # 返回
252	/// 映射后的目标模型名称
253	pub fn resolve_model_route(
254	    original_model: &str,
255	    custom_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
256	) -> String {
257	    // 0. API 热更新废弃模型转发 (最高物理优先级，强制纠正)
258	    // 如果用户非要用已经被移除的模型，并且官方下发了 fallback path，我们在此拦截并纠正
259	    if let Some(forwarded) = DYNAMIC_MODEL_FORWARDING_RULES.get(original_model) {
260	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Router] 官方淘汰重定向: {} -> {}", original_model, forwarded.value()));
261	        return forwarded.value().clone();
262	    }
263	
264	    // 1. 精确匹配 (次高优先级)
265	    if let Some(target) = custom_mapping.get(original_model) {
266	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Router] 精确映射: {} -> {}", original_model, target));
267	        return target.clone();
268	    }
269	    
270	    // 2. Wildcard match - most specific (highest non-wildcard chars) wins
271	    // Note: When multiple patterns have the SAME specificity, HashMap iteration order
272	    // determines the result (non-deterministic). Users can avoid this by making patterns
273	    // more specific. Future improvement: use IndexMap + frontend sorting for full control.
274	    let mut best_match: Option<(&str, &str, usize)> = None;
275	
276	    for (pattern, target) in custom_mapping.iter() {
277	        if pattern.contains('*') && wildcard_match(pattern, original_model) {
278	            let specificity = pattern.chars().count() - pattern.matches('*').count();
279	            if best_match.is_none() || specificity > best_match.unwrap().2 {
280	                best_match = Some((pattern.as_str(), target.as_str(), specificity));
281	            }
282	        }
283	    }
284	
285	    if let Some((pattern, target, _)) = best_match {
286	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
287	            "[Router] Wildcard match: {} -> {} (rule: {})",
288	            original_model, target, pattern
289	        ));
290	        return target.to_string();
291	    }
292	    
293	    // 3. 系统默认映射
294	    let result = map_claude_model_to_gemini(original_model);
295	    if result != original_model {
296	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Router] 系统默认映射: {} -> {}", original_model, result));
297	    }
298	    result
299	}

301	/// Normalize any physical model name to one of the 3 standard protection IDs.
302	/// This ensures quota protection works consistently regardless of API versioning or request variations.
303	/// 
304	/// Standard IDs:
305	/// - `gemini-3-flash`: All Flash variants (1.5-flash, 2.5-flash, 3-flash, etc.)
306	/// - `gemini-3-pro-high`: All Pro variants (1.5-pro, 2.5-pro, etc.)
307	/// - `claude-sonnet-4-5`: All Claude Sonnet variants (3-5-sonnet, sonnet-4-5, etc.)
308	/// 
309	/// Returns `None` if the model doesn't match any of the 3 protected categories.
310	pub fn normalize_to_standard_id(model_name: &str) -> Option<String> {
311	    let lower = model_name.to_lowercase();
312	    
313	    // 1. image 资源 (优先匹配，使用 contains 匹配以支持任何变体，如 gemini-3.1-flash-image)
314	    if lower.contains("image") {
315	        return Some("gemini-3-pro-image".to_string());
316	    }
317	
318	    // 2. gemini-3-flash (包含所有 flash 变体)
319	    if lower.contains("flash") {
320	        return Some("gemini-3-flash".to_string());
321	    }
322	
323	    // 3. gemini-3-pro-high (包含 pro 变体)
324	    if lower.contains("pro") && !lower.contains("image") {
325	        return Some("gemini-3-pro-high".to_string());
326	    }
327	
328	    // 4. Claude 系列 (合并 Opus, Sonnet, Haiku 为统一保护组 'claude')
329	    if lower.contains("claude") || lower.contains("opus") || lower.contains("sonnet") || lower.contains("haiku") {
330	        return Some("claude".to_string());
331	    }
332	
333	    None
334	}

8	/// Routes incoming requests to the appropriate upstream provider.
9	pub struct ProviderRouter {
10	    providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>,
11	    rr_counter: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
12	}

14	impl ProviderRouter {
15	    /// Build from config. If `providers` is empty, optionally migrate from legacy z.ai config.
16	    pub fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self {
17	        let enabled: Vec<_> = providers.into_iter().filter(|p| p.enabled).collect();
18	
19	        if enabled.is_empty() {
20	            if let Some(zai) = legacy_zai {
21	                if zai.enabled && zai.dispatch_mode != crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
22	                    return Self::from_zai_config(zai);
23	                }
24	            }
25	        }
26	
27	        Self {
28	            providers: enabled,
29	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
30	        }
31	    }
32	
33	    /// Build a single-provider router from legacy z.ai configuration.
34	    fn from_zai_config(zai: &ZaiConfig) -> Self {
35	        let dispatch_mode = match zai.dispatch_mode {
36	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
37	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Exclusive => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
38	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Pooled => ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled,
39	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback => ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback,
40	        };
41	
42	        let provider = UpstreamProvider {
43	            name: "z.ai".to_string(),
44	            enabled: true,
45	            base_url: zai.base_url.clone(),
46	            api_key: zai.api_key.clone(),
47	            protocol: ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough,
48	            dispatch_mode,
49	            priority: 0,
50	            model_prefixes: Vec::new(), // wildcard
51	            model_mapping: zai.model_mapping.clone(),
52	            default_models: ProviderModelDefaults {
53	                opus: zai.models.opus.clone(),
54	                sonnet: zai.models.sonnet.clone(),
55	                haiku: zai.models.haiku.clone(),
56	            },
57	            request_timeout_secs: None,
58	        };
59	
60	        Self {
61	            providers: vec![provider],
62	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
63	        }
64	    }
65	
66	    /// Find enabled providers that can handle the given model.
67	    pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider> {
68	        let m = model.to_lowercase();
69	        self.providers
70	            .iter()
71	            .filter(|p| {
72	                p.model_prefixes.is_empty()
73	                    || p.model_prefixes.iter().any(|prefix| m.starts_with(prefix))
74	            })
75	            .collect()
76	    }
77	
78	    /// Select the next provider for the given model.
79	    /// `prev_failed` excludes a provider that just failed, triggering fallback.
80	    pub fn select(
81	        &self,
82	        model: &str,
83	        prev_failed: Option<&str>,
84	    ) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> {
85	        let candidates: Vec<_> = self
86	            .candidates_for_model(model)
87	            .into_iter()
88	            .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
89	            .collect();
90	
91	        if candidates.is_empty() {
92	            return None;
93	        }
94	
95	        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority)
96	        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates
97	            .iter()
98	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
99	            .copied()
100	            .collect();
101	        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
102	        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
103	            return Some(*p);
104	        }
105	
106	        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
107	        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates
108	            .iter()
109	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
110	            .copied()
111	            .collect();
112	        if !pooled.is_empty() {
113	            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
114	            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % pooled.len();
115	            return Some(pooled[idx]);
116	        }
117	
118	        // 3. Fallback providers
119	        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates
120	            .iter()
121	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
122	            .copied()
123	            .collect();
124	        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
125	        fallback.first().copied()
126	    }
127	
128	    /// Map incoming model name to the provider's native model ID.
129	    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String {
130	        // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
131	        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.get(incoming) {
132	            return mapped.clone();
133	        }
134	        // 2. Prefix match in model_mapping
135	        let m = incoming.to_lowercase();
136	        if let Some((_, mapped)) = provider
137	            .model_mapping
138	            .iter()
139	            .find(|(k, _)| m.starts_with(k.as_str()))
140	        {
141	            return mapped.clone();
142	        }
143	        // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
144	        if m.starts_with("zai:") {
145	            return incoming[4..].to_string();
146	        }
147	        // 4. Pass through glm-* models
148	        if m.starts_with("glm-") {
149	            return incoming.to_string();
150	        }
151	        // 5. Family defaults for Claude models
152	        if m.starts_with("claude-") {
153	            if m.contains("opus") {
154	                return provider.default_models.opus.clone();
155	            }
156	            if m.contains("haiku") {
157	                return provider.default_models.haiku.clone();
158	            }
159	            return provider.default_models.sonnet.clone();
160	        }
161	        // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
162	        incoming.to_string()
163	    }
164	
165	    /// Check if the router has any enabled providers.
166	    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
167	        self.providers.is_empty()
168	    }
169	}

171	/// Map a model name to the provider's expected model name.
172	/// This is a free function so it can be used without holding a `ProviderRouter` lock.
173	pub fn map_model_for_provider(
174	    original: &str,
175	    model_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
176	    default_models: &ProviderModelDefaults,
177	) -> String {
178	    // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
179	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(original) {
180	        return mapped.clone();
181	    }
182	    // 2. Lowercase match
183	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
184	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(&m) {
185	        return mapped.clone();
186	    }
187	    // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
188	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
189	        return original[4..].to_string();
190	    }
191	    // 4. Pass through glm-* models
192	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
193	        return original.to_string();
194	    }
195	    // 5. Claude family defaults
196	    if m.starts_with("claude-") {
197	        if m.contains("opus") {
198	            return default_models.opus.clone();
199	        }
200	        if m.contains("haiku") {
201	            return default_models.haiku.clone();
202	        }
203	        return default_models.sonnet.clone();
204	    }
205	    // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
206	    original.to_string()
207	}

1	use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};
2	use tracing::{debug, info};
3	use axum::{http::StatusCode, response::{IntoResponse, Response}, Json, extract::State};
4	use serde_json::{json, Value};
5	use crate::proxy::server::AppState;
6	
7	// ===== 统一重试与退避策略 =====
8	
9	/// 重试策略枚举
10	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
11	pub enum RetryStrategy {
12	    /// 不重试，直接返回错误
13	    NoRetry,
14	    /// 固定延迟
15	    FixedDelay(Duration),
16	    /// 线性退避：base_ms * (attempt + 1)
17	    LinearBackoff { base_ms: u64 },
18	    /// 指数退避：base_ms * 2^attempt，上限 max_ms
19	    ExponentialBackoff { base_ms: u64, max_ms: u64 },
20	}
21	
22	/// 根据错误状态码和错误信息确定重试策略
23	pub fn determine_retry_strategy(
24	    status_code: u16,
25	    error_text: &str,
26	    retried_without_thinking: bool,
27	) -> RetryStrategy {
28	    match status_code {
29	        // 400 错误：仅在特定 Thinking 签名失败时重试一次
30	        400 if !retried_without_thinking
31	            && (error_text.contains("Invalid `signature`")
32	                || error_text.contains("thinking.signature")
33	                || error_text.contains("thinking.thinking")
34	                || error_text.contains("Corrupted thought signature")) =>
35	        {
36	            RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(Duration::from_millis(200))
37	        }
38	
39	        // 429 限流错误
40	        429 => {
41	            // 优先使用服务端返回的 Retry-After
42	            if let Some(delay_ms) = crate::proxy::upstream::retry::parse_retry_delay(error_text) {
43	                let actual_delay = delay_ms.saturating_add(200).min(30_000); // 上限上调至 30s
44	                RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(Duration::from_millis(actual_delay))
45	            } else {
46	                // 否则使用线性退避：起始 5s，逐步增加
47	                RetryStrategy::LinearBackoff { base_ms: 5000 }
48	            }
49	        }
50	
51	        // 503 服务不可用 / 529 服务器过载
52	        503 | 529 => {
53	            // 指数退避：起始 10s，上限 60s (针对 Google 边缘节点过载)
54	            RetryStrategy::ExponentialBackoff {
55	                base_ms: 10000,
56	                max_ms: 60000,
57	            }
58	        }
59	
60	        // 500 服务器内部错误
61	        500 => {
62	            // 线性退避：起始 3s
63	            RetryStrategy::LinearBackoff { base_ms: 3000 }
64	        }
65	
66	        // 401/403 认证/权限错误：切换账号前给予极短缓冲
67	        401 | 403 => RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(Duration::from_millis(200)),
68	
69	        // 404 资源未找到：Google Cloud Code API 的 404 通常是账号级别的间歇性问题
70	        // (灰度发布、账号权限不同步等)，轮换账号往往能解决
71	        404 => RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(Duration::from_millis(300)),
72	
73	        // 其他错误：不重试
74	        _ => RetryStrategy::NoRetry,
75	    }
76	}
77	
78	/// 执行退避策略并返回是否应该继续重试
79	pub async fn apply_retry_strategy(
80	    strategy: RetryStrategy,
81	    attempt: usize,
82	    max_attempts: usize,
83	    status_code: u16,
84	    trace_id: &str,
85	) -> bool {
86	    match strategy {
87	        RetryStrategy::NoRetry => {
88	            debug!("[{}] Non-retryable error {}, stopping", trace_id, status_code);
89	            false
90	        }
91	
92	        RetryStrategy::FixedDelay(duration) => {
93	            let base_ms = duration.as_millis() as u64;
94	            info!(
95	                "[{}] ⏱️ Retry with fixed delay: status={}, attempt={}/{}, delay={}ms",
96	                trace_id,
97	                status_code,
98	                attempt + 1,
99	                max_attempts,
100	                base_ms
101	            );
102	            sleep(duration).await;
103	            true
104	        }
105	
106	        RetryStrategy::LinearBackoff { base_ms } => {
107	            let calculated_ms = base_ms * (attempt as u64 + 1);
108	            info!(
109	                "[{}] ⏱️ Retry with linear backoff: status={}, attempt={}/{}, delay={}ms",
110	                trace_id,
111	                status_code,
112	                attempt + 1,
113	                max_attempts,
114	                calculated_ms
115	            );
116	            sleep(Duration::from_millis(calculated_ms)).await;
117	            true
118	        }
119	
120	        RetryStrategy::ExponentialBackoff { base_ms, max_ms } => {
121	            let calculated_ms = (base_ms * 2_u64.pow(attempt as u32)).min(max_ms);
122	            info!(
123	                "[{}] ⏱️ Retry with exponential backoff: status={}, attempt={}/{}, delay={}ms",
124	                trace_id,
125	                status_code,
126	                attempt + 1,
127	                max_attempts,
128	                calculated_ms
129	            );
130	            sleep(Duration::from_millis(calculated_ms)).await;
131	            true
132	        }
133	    }
134	}
135	
136	/// 判断是否应该轮换账号
137	pub fn should_rotate_account(status_code: u16) -> bool {
138	    match status_code {
139	        // 这些错误是账号级别或特定节点配额的，需要轮换
140	        // 404: Google Cloud Code API 模型可用性因账号而异（灰度/权限）
141	        429 | 401 | 403 | 404 | 500 => true,
142	        // 这些错误通常是协议或服务端全局性、甚至参数错误的，轮换账号通常无意义
143	        400 | 503 | 529 => false,
144	        _ => false,
145	    }
146	}
147	
148	/// Detects model capabilities and configuration
149	/// POST /v1/models/detect
150	pub async fn handle_detect_model(
151	    State(state): State<AppState>,
152	    Json(body): Json<Value>,
153	) -> Response {
154	    let model_name = body.get("model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
155	    
156	    if model_name.is_empty() {
157	        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "Missing 'model' field").into_response();
158	    }
159	
160	    // 1. Resolve mapping
161	    let mapped_model = crate::proxy::common::model_mapping::resolve_model_route(
162	        model_name,
163	        &*state.custom_mapping.read().await,
164	    );
165	
166	    // 2. Resolve capabilities
167	    let config = crate::proxy::mappers::common_utils::resolve_request_config(
168	        model_name,
169	        &mapped_model,
170	        &None, // We don't check tools for static capability detection
171	        None,  // size
172	        None,  // quality
173	        None,  // image_size
174	        None,  // body (not needed for static detection)
175	    );
176	
177	    // 3. Construct response
178	    let mut response = json!({
179	        "model": model_name,
180	        "mapped_model": mapped_model,
181	        "type": config.request_type,
182	        "features": {
183	            "has_web_search": config.inject_google_search,
184	            "is_image_gen": config.request_type == "image_gen"
185	        }
186	    });
187	
188	    if let Some(img_conf) = config.image_config {
189	        if let Some(obj) = response.as_object_mut() {
190	            obj.insert("config".to_string(), img_conf);
191	        }
192	    }
193	
194	    Json(response).into_response()
195	}
196

109	
110	pub fn update_image_thinking_mode(mode: Option<String>) {
111	    let val = mode.unwrap_or_else(|| "enabled".to_string());
112	    if let Some(lock) = GLOBAL_IMAGE_THINKING_MODE.get() {
113	        if let Ok(mut cfg) = lock.write() {
114	            if *cfg != val {
115	                *cfg = val.clone();
116	                tracing::info!("[Image-Thinking] Global config updated: {}", val);
117	            }
118	        }
119	    } else {
120	        let _ = GLOBAL_IMAGE_THINKING_MODE.set(RwLock::new(val.clone()));
121	    }
122	}

752	pub struct ProxyEntry {
753	    pub id: String,                       // 唯一标识
754	    pub name: String,                     // 显示名称
755	    pub url: String,                      // 代理地址 (http://, https://, socks5://)
756	    pub auth: Option<ProxyAuth>,          // 认证信息 (可选)
757	    pub enabled: bool,                    // 是否启用
758	    pub priority: i32,                    // 优先级 (数字越小优先级越高)
759	    pub tags: Vec<String>,                // 标签 (如 "美国", "住宅IP")
760	    pub max_accounts: Option<usize>,      // 最大绑定账号数 (0 = 无限制)
761	    pub health_check_url: Option<String>, // 健康检查 URL
762	    pub last_check_time: Option<i64>,     // 上次检查时间
763	    pub is_healthy: bool,                 // 健康状态
764	    pub latency: Option<u64>,             // 延迟 (毫秒) [NEW]
765	}
766	
767	/// 代理池配置
768	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
769	pub struct ProxyPoolConfig {
770	    pub enabled: bool, // 是否启用代理池
771	    // pub mode: ProxyPoolMode,        // [REMOVED] 代理池模式，统一为 Hybrid 逻辑
772	    pub proxies: Vec<ProxyEntry>,         // 代理列表
773	    pub health_check_interval: u64,       // 健康检查间隔 (秒)
774	    pub auto_failover: bool,              // 自动故障转移
775	    pub strategy: ProxySelectionStrategy, // 代理选择策略
776	    /// 账号到代理的绑定关系 (account_id -> proxy_id)，持久化存储
777	    #[serde(default)]
778	    pub account_bindings: HashMap<String, String>,
779	}
780	
781	impl Default for ProxyPoolConfig {
782	    fn default() -> Self {
783	        Self {
784	            enabled: false,
785	            // mode: ProxyPoolMode::Global,
786	            proxies: Vec::new(),
787	            health_check_interval: 300,
788	            auto_failover: true,
789	            strategy: ProxySelectionStrategy::Priority,
790	            account_bindings: HashMap::new(),
791	        }
792	    }
793	}
794	
795	/// 代理选择策略
796	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
797	#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
798	pub enum ProxySelectionStrategy {
799	    /// 轮询: 依次使用
800	    RoundRobin,
801	    /// 随机: 随机选择
802	    Random,
803	    /// 优先级: 按 priority 字段排序
804	    Priority,
805	    /// 最少连接: 选择当前使用最少的代理
806	    LeastConnections,
807	    /// 加权轮询: 根据健康状态和优先级
808	    WeightedRoundRobin,
809	}

192	/**
193	 * 模型排序权重配置
194	 * 数字越小，优先级越高
195	 */
196	const MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS = {
197	    // 系列权重 (第一优先级)
198	    series: {
199	        'gemini-3': 100,
200	        'gemini-2.5': 200,
201	        'gemini-2': 300,
202	        'claude': 400,
203	    },
204	    // 性能级别权重 (第二优先级)
205	    tier: {
206	        'pro': 10,
207	        'flash': 20,
208	        'lite': 30,
209	        'opus': 5,
210	        'sonnet': 10,
211	    },
212	    // 特殊后缀权重 (第三优先级)
213	    suffix: {
214	        'thinking': 1,
215	        'image': 2,
216	        'high': 0,
217	        'low': 3,
218	    }
219	};
220	
221	/**
222	 * 获取模型的排序权重
223	 */
224	function getModelSortWeight(modelId: string): number {
225	    const id = modelId.toLowerCase();
226	    let weight = 0;
227	
228	    // 1. 系列权重 (x1000)
229	    if (id.startsWith('gemini-3')) {
230	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.series['gemini-3'] * 1000;
231	    } else if (id.startsWith('gemini-2.5')) {
232	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.series['gemini-2.5'] * 1000;
233	    } else if (id.startsWith('gemini-2')) {
234	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.series['gemini-2'] * 1000;
235	    } else if (id.startsWith('claude')) {
236	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.series['claude'] * 1000;
237	    }
238	
239	    // 2. 性能级别权重 (x100)
240	    if (id.includes('pro')) {
241	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.tier['pro'] * 100;
242	    } else if (id.includes('flash')) {
243	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.tier['flash'] * 100;
244	    } else if (id.includes('lite')) {
245	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.tier['lite'] * 100;
246	    } else if (id.includes('opus')) {
247	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.tier['opus'] * 100;
248	    } else if (id.includes('sonnet')) {
249	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.tier['sonnet'] * 100;
250	    }
251	
252	    // 3. 特殊后缀权重 (x10)
253	    if (id.includes('thinking')) {
254	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.suffix['thinking'] * 10;
255	    } else if (id.includes('image')) {
256	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.suffix['image'] * 10;
257	    } else if (id.includes('high')) {
258	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.suffix['high'] * 10;
259	    } else if (id.includes('low')) {
260	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.suffix['low'] * 10;
261	    }
262	
263	    return weight;
264	}
265	
266	/**
267	 * 对模型列表进行排序
268	 * @param models 模型列表
269	 * @returns 排序后的模型列表
270	 */
271	export function sortModels<T extends { id: string }>(models: T[]): T[] {
272	    return [...models].sort((a, b) => {
273	        const weightA = getModelSortWeight(a.id);
274	        const weightB = getModelSortWeight(b.id);
275	
276	        // 按权重升序排序
277	        if (weightA !== weightB) {
278	            return weightA - weightB;
279	        }
280	
281	        // 权重相同时，按字母顺序排序
282	        return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
283	    });
284	}

## Model Routing and Provider Selection: Complete Analysis

### 1. Provider Configuration

**Types file:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/types/config.ts`

Providers are defined via `UpstreamProvider` (lines 24-36 in config.ts):

```typescript
interface UpstreamProvider {
    name: string;
    enabled: boolean;
    base_url: string;
    api_key: string;
    protocol: ProviderProtocol;              // 'anthropic_passthrough' | 'openai_compatible' | 'gemini_v1internal'
    dispatch_mode: ProviderDispatchMode;     // 'exclusive' | 'pooled' | 'fallback'
    priority: number;
    model_prefixes: string[];                // which model prefixes this provider handles (empty = all)
    model_mapping: Record<string, string>;   // per-provider model name overrides
    default_models: ProviderModelDefaults;   // { opus, sonnet, haiku } fallback models
    request_timeout_secs?: number;
}
```

The Providers page does not exist as a standalone UI page -- provider configuration is managed through `AppConfig.proxy.providers` (a `UpstreamProvider[]` array) and the legacy `AppConfig.proxy.zai` (a single `ZaiConfig` provider). The `AppConfig` structure (lines 159-180 in `src/types/config.ts`) holds the full config tree:

```typescript
interface AppConfig {
    proxy: ProxyConfig;      // proxy.enabled, port, api_key, custom_mapping, providers, zai, scheduling, etc.
    // ... other UI-level settings (language, theme, etc.)
}
```

**Rust-side config:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/config.rs`

The same structure is mirrored in Rust with `ProxyConfig` (line 559) containing:
- `custom_mapping: HashMap<String, String>` -- user model routing rules
- `providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>` -- multi-provider gateway config
- `zai: ZaiConfig` -- legacy single-provider config

### 2. Model Routing Center (Frontend: RouteManager.tsx)

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/RouteManager.tsx`

The "模型路由中心" (Model Routing Center) UI allows users to manage `custom_mapping` -- a `Record<string, string>` mapping source model names to target model names. Key mechanisms:

**Built-in Presets** (lines 78-148): Four presets shipped in the frontend:
- `default` -- maps GPT models to Gemini, Claude to Claude 4.6
- `performance` -- maps everything to higher-tier Claude models
- `cost-effective` -- maps everything to Gemini Flash
- `balanced` -- mixed high/mid tier routing

**Custom Presets** (lines 64-73, 155-196): User-created presets stored in `localStorage` under key `antigravity_custom_presets`.

**Applying a preset** (lines 198-218): Merges the preset's mappings into `appConfig.proxy.custom_mapping` and calls `invoke('update_model_mapping', ...)` to push changes to the Rust backend.

**Individual mapping CRUD** (lines 221-271): Users can add/edit/remove individual `source_model -> target_model` entries, each persisted via `invoke('update_model_mapping', ...)`.

---

### 3. The `useProxyModels` Hook

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/hooks/useProxyModels.tsx`

This hook builds the unified model list shown in the UI by merging two sources:

1. **Dynamic models** from accounts (lines 21-28): Iterates all accounts' `quota.models[]` arrays, deduplicates by lowercase name, prefers entries with `display_name`.

2. **Static models** from `MODEL_CONFIG` (lines 63-86): For model IDs in `src/config/modelConfig.ts` that are NOT already covered by dynamic account data, adds them as static fallback entries.

Each model entry gets: `{ id, name, desc, group, icon }`. The icon comes from `MODEL_CONFIG[id].Icon` (e.g., `Gemini.Color`, `Claude.Color` from `@lobehub/icons`), or a default `Bot` icon.

---

### 4. Rust Backend: Model-to-Provider Selection Flow

The complete routing chain for an incoming request is:

#### Step 1: Model Name Resolution (`resolve_model_route`)

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/common/model_mapping.rs`

Function `resolve_model_route()` (lines 253-299) applies these priority levels:

1. **Dynamic forwarding rules** (highest priority): `DYNAMIC_MODEL_FORWARDING_RULES` -- runtime-registered deprecated model redirects
2. **Exact custom mapping match**: `custom_mapping.get(original_model)`
3. **Wildcard custom mapping match**: iterates `custom_mapping` entries with `*` patterns, picks the most specific (pattern length minus wildcard count)
4. **System default mapping**: `map_claude_model_to_gemini()` -- built-in `CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI` HashMap (lines 16-89) that maps old Claude/OpenAI model IDs to current Gemini/Claude equivalents
5. **Pass-through**: unknown models are returned as-is

#### Step 2: Provider Selection (`ProviderRouter`)

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/router.rs`

The `ProviderRouter` selects which upstream provider handles the resolved model:

1. `candidates_for_model(model)` (line 67): Filters enabled providers whose `model_prefixes` match the model name (empty prefixes = wildcard, matches all)

2. `select(model, prev_failed)` (line 80): Picks one candidate with this priority:
   - **Exclusive** providers first (sorted by `priority` number)
   - **Pooled** providers next (round-robin among them, sorted by priority)
   - **Fallback** providers last (highest-priority only)

3. `map_model(provider, incoming)` (line 129): Converts the incoming model name to the provider's native model ID using:
   - Exact match in `provider.model_mapping`
   - Prefix match in `provider.model_mapping`
   - Strip `zai:` prefix
   - Pass through `glm-*` models
   - Claude family defaults (`opus`/`sonnet`/`haiku` -> provider's `default_models`)
   - Fallback: pass through as-is

#### Step 3: Account Selection (`TokenManager.get_token`)

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/token_manager.rs`

After the provider is selected, `TokenManager::get_token()` (line 1064) picks a specific Google account (for the default path) using:
- Sticky session support (session_id-based affinity)
- Power of Two Choices (P2C) load balancing (line 964)
- Quota protection checks
- Preferred account / fixed account mode

#### Step 4: Handler Invocation

**Files:**
- `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/openai.rs` (OpenAI protocol handler)
- `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/claude.rs` (Claude protocol handler)
- `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/gemini.rs` (Gemini protocol handler)

Each handler calls `resolve_model_route()` at the start of its request loop to get the `mapped_model`, then uses it for account/provider selection.

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/ServiceConfig.tsx`, lines 708-755

根据现有架构分析，当前已经有模型路由系统（`custom_mapping`），但它是**模型 → 模型**的映射，没有**模型 → 供应商**的自动选择。供应商选择目前靠 `UpstreamProvider` 的 `model_prefixes` 字段手动匹配。

## 方案对比

| 方案 | 做法 | 优点 | 缺点 |
|------|------|------|------|
| **A. 模型库内置供应商标签** | 在 `MODEL_CONFIG` 中为每个模型标记默认供应商（如 `gemini-*` → Google, `claude-*` → Anthropic, `glm-*` → Zhipu） | 改动最小，前端即可推断，不需要后端变更 | 需要维护模型-供应商映射表 |
| **B. 新增 `model -> provider` 映射 UI** | 在路由管理新增"模型→供应商"映射表，持久化到 config | 用户可自定义，最灵活 | 开发量大，UI 复杂 |
| **C. 后端 ProviderRouter 自动匹配** | Rust 端根据模型名前缀自动选择候选 provider（已有 `model_prefixes` 机制，但需前端可视化） | 核心逻辑已在 Rust，只需前端展示 | 用户感知弱，调试困难 |

## 我的推荐：方案 A + 前端可视化

**核心思路**：在 `src/config/modelConfig.ts` 中为模型增加 `provider` 标签，然后在"模型路由中心"新增一个只读卡片，展示"当前模型会自动路由到哪个供应商"。如果用户配置了 `custom_mapping`，以自定义为准。

**改动范围**：
1. `src/config/modelConfig.ts` — 给每个模型加 `provider: 'google' | 'anthropic' | 'zhipu' | 'openai'` 字段
2. `src/pages/RouteManager.tsx` — 在路由中心顶部新增"自动路由预览"卡片
3. 不改动 Rust 后端 — 现有的 `ProviderRouter.select()` 已经能根据 `model_prefixes` 正确选择

你觉得这个方向对吗？还是你更倾向其他方案？比如你想要的是**在发起请求时**根据模型名自动切供应商，还是在**配置界面**上能看到映射关系？

41	        if let Ok(mut cfg) = lock.write() {
42	            *cfg = config.clone();
43	            tracing::info!(
44	                "[Thinking-Budget] Global config updated: mode={:?}, custom_value={}",
45	                config.mode,
46	                config.custom_value
47	            );
48	        }
49	    } else {
50	        // 首次初始化
51	        let _ = GLOBAL_THINKING_BUDGET_CONFIG.set(RwLock::new(config.clone()));
52	        tracing::info!(
53	            "[Thinking-Budget] Global config initialized: mode={:?}, custom_value={}",
54	            config.mode,
55	            config.custom_value
56	        );
57	    }
58	}

62	// 用户可在设置中配置一段全局提示词，自动注入到所有请求的 systemInstruction 中
63	// ============================================================================
64	static GLOBAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT_CONFIG: OnceLock<RwLock<GlobalSystemPromptConfig>> = OnceLock::new();
65	
66	/// 获取当前全局系统提示词配置
67	pub fn get_global_system_prompt() -> GlobalSystemPromptConfig {
68	    GLOBAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT_CONFIG
69	        .get()
70	        .and_then(|lock| lock.read().ok())
71	        .map(|cfg| cfg.clone())
72	        .unwrap_or_default()
73	}
74	
75	/// 更新全局系统提示词配置
76	pub fn update_global_system_prompt_config(config: GlobalSystemPromptConfig) {
77	    if let Some(lock) = GLOBAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT_CONFIG.get() {
78	        if let Ok(mut cfg) = lock.write() {
79	            *cfg = config.clone();
80	            tracing::info!(
81	                "[Global-System-Prompt] Config updated: enabled={}, content_len={}",
82	                config.enabled,
83	                config.content.len()
84	            );
85	        }
86	    } else {
87	        // 首次初始化
88	        let _ = GLOBAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT_CONFIG.set(RwLock::new(config.clone()));
89	        tracing::info!(
90	            "[Global-System-Prompt] Config initialized: enabled={}, content_len={}",
91	            config.enabled,
92	            config.content.len()
93	        );
94	    }
95	}

97	// ============================================================================
98	// 全局图像思维模式配置存储
99	// ============================================================================
100	static GLOBAL_IMAGE_THINKING_MODE: OnceLock<RwLock<String>> = OnceLock::new();
101	
102	pub fn get_image_thinking_mode() -> String {
103	    GLOBAL_IMAGE_THINKING_MODE
104	        .get()
105	        .and_then(|lock| lock.read().ok())
106	        .map(|s| s.clone())
107	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "enabled".to_string())
108	}
109	
110	pub fn update_image_thinking_mode(mode: Option<String>) {
111	    let val = mode.unwrap_or_else(|| "enabled".to_string());
112	    if let Some(lock) = GLOBAL_IMAGE_THINKING_MODE.get() {
113	        if let Ok(mut cfg) = lock.write() {
114	            if *cfg != val {
115	                *cfg = val.clone();
116	                tracing::info!("[Image-Thinking] Global config updated: {}", val);
117	            }
118	        }
119	    } else {
120	        let _ = GLOBAL_IMAGE_THINKING_MODE.set(RwLock::new(val.clone()));
121	    }
122	}

730	    pub fn get_bind_address(&self) -> &str {

772	    pub proxies: Vec<ProxyEntry>,         // 代理列表

808	    WeightedRoundRobin,

### `select()` -- Provider selection (line 80)

```rust

Selection priority order:
1. **Exclusive** providers (sorted by `priority`, lowest first). Returns the first match.
2. **Pooled** providers (sorted by priority, selected via round-robin counter `rr_counter.fetch_add`).
3. **Fallback** providers (sorted by priority, returns the first/lowest-priority match).

The `prev_failed` parameter excludes a specific provider name, enabling fallback retry to a different provider after a failure.

## Summary: Provider Selection vs Model Resolution Ordering

```
Request arrives
  |
  v
[1] Parse request body -> extract raw model name
  |
  v
[2] ProviderRouter.select(raw_model)  -- "Which upstream provider handles this?"
  |                                      Uses: model_prefixes, dispatch_mode, priority
  |                                      Does NOT use: custom_mapping or resolve_model_route
  |
  +-- Provider found? --> Forward to provider immediately
  |                        (AnthropicPassthrough path applies provider.model_mapping
  |                         via map_model_for_provider inside the forwarder)
  |
  +-- No provider --> Fall through to legacy Google path
                       |
                       v
                   [3] resolve_model_route(raw_model, custom_mapping)
                       -- "What is the canonical Gemini model ID?"
                       Uses: dynamic_forwarding > custom exact > custom wildcard > CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI
                       |
                       v
                   [4] Retry loop (get token, transform, send)
```

The critical architectural point is that **provider selection (`ProviderRouter.select`) happens BEFORE model name resolution (`resolve_model_route`)**. The router uses the raw, client-supplied model name to pick a provider. Model name resolution to canonical IDs only happens when falling through to the legacy Google/AI Studio path. When a provider handles the request, the provider's own `model_mapping` config is applied inside the forwarder function via `map_model_for_provider`.

81	        &self,
82	        model: &str,
83	        prev_failed: Option<&str>,

85	        let candidates: Vec<_> = self
86	            .candidates_for_model(model)
87	            .into_iter()
88	            .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))

94

97	            .iter()
98	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
99	            .copied()
100	            .collect();
101	        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
102	        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
103	            return Some(*p);
104	        }
105

107	        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates
108	            .iter()
109	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
110	            .copied()
111	            .collect();
112	        if !pooled.is_empty() {
113	            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
114	            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % pooled.len();
115	            return Some(pooled[idx]);
116	        }
117	
118	        // 3. Fallback providers
119	        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates
120	            .iter()
121	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
122	            .copied()
123	            .collect();
124	        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
125	        fallback.first().copied()
126	    }

92	/// Map Claude model names to Gemini model names
93	/// 
94	/// # 映射策略
95	/// 1. **精确匹配**: 检查 CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI 映射表
96	/// 2. **已知前缀透传**: gemini-* 和 *-thinking 模型直接透传
97	/// 3. **[NEW] 直接透传**: 未知模型 ID 直接传递给 Google API (支持体验未发布模型)
98	/// 
99	/// # 参数
100	/// - `input`: 原始模型名称
101	/// 
102	/// # 返回
103	/// 映射后的目标模型名称
104	/// 
105	/// # 示例
106	/// ```
107	/// // 精确匹配
108	/// assert_eq!(map_claude_model_to_gemini("claude-opus-4"), "claude-opus-4-5-thinking");
109	/// 
110	/// // Gemini 模型透传
111	/// assert_eq!(map_claude_model_to_gemini("gemini-2.5-flash"), "gemini-2.5-flash");
112	/// 
113	/// // 直接透传未知模型 (NEW!)
114	/// assert_eq!(map_claude_model_to_gemini("claude-opus-4-6"), "claude-opus-4-6");
115	/// assert_eq!(map_claude_model_to_gemini("claude-sonnet-5"), "claude-sonnet-5");
116	/// ```
117	pub fn map_claude_model_to_gemini(input: &str) -> String {
118	    // 1. Check exact match in map
119	    if let Some(mapped) = CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI.get(input) {
120	        return mapped.to_string();
121	    }
122	
123	    // 2. Pass-through known prefixes (gemini-, -thinking) to support dynamic suffixes
124	    if input.starts_with("gemini-") || input.contains("thinking") {
125	        return input.to_string();
126	    }
127	
128	
129	    // 3. [ENHANCED] 直接透传未知模型 ID,而不是强制 fallback
130	    // 这允许用户通过自定义映射体验未发布的模型 (如 claude-opus-4-6)
131	    // Google API 会自动处理无效模型并返回错误,用户可以根据错误调整映射
132	    input.to_string()
133	}

198	/// Wildcard matching - supports multiple wildcards
199	///
200	/// **Note**: Matching is **case-sensitive**. Pattern `GPT-4*` will NOT match `gpt-4-turbo`.
201	///
202	/// Examples:
203	/// - `gpt-4*` matches `gpt-4`, `gpt-4-turbo` ✓
204	/// - `claude-*-sonnet-*` matches `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022` ✓
205	/// - `*-thinking` matches `claude-opus-4-5-thinking` ✓
206	/// - `a*b*c` matches `a123b456c` ✓
207	fn wildcard_match(pattern: &str, text: &str) -> bool {
208	    let parts: Vec<&str> = pattern.split('*').collect();
209	
210	    // No wildcard - exact match
211	    if parts.len() == 1 {
212	        return pattern == text;
213	    }
214	
215	    let mut text_pos = 0;
216	
217	    for (i, part) in parts.iter().enumerate() {
218	        if part.is_empty() {
219	            continue; // Skip empty segments from consecutive wildcards
220	        }
221	
222	        if i == 0 {
223	            // First segment must match start
224	            if !text[text_pos..].starts_with(part) {
225	                return false;
226	            }
227	            text_pos += part.len();
228	        } else if i == parts.len() - 1 {
229	            // Last segment must match end
230	            return text[text_pos..].ends_with(part);
231	        } else {
232	            // Middle segments - find next occurrence
233	            if let Some(pos) = text[text_pos..].find(part) {
234	                text_pos += pos + part.len();
235	            } else {
236	                return false;
237	            }
238	        }
239	    }
240	
241	    true
242	}
243	
244	/// 核心模型路由解析引擎
245	/// 优先级：精确匹配 > 通配符匹配 > 系统默认映射
246	/// 
247	/// # 参数
248	/// - `original_model`: 原始模型名称
249	/// - `custom_mapping`: 用户自定义映射表
250	/// 
251	/// # 返回
252	/// 映射后的目标模型名称
253	pub fn resolve_model_route(
254	    original_model: &str,
255	    custom_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
256	) -> String {
257	    // 0. API 热更新废弃模型转发 (最高物理优先级，强制纠正)
258	    // 如果用户非要用已经被移除的模型，并且官方下发了 fallback path，我们在此拦截并纠正
259	    if let Some(forwarded) = DYNAMIC_MODEL_FORWARDING_RULES.get(original_model) {
260	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Router] 官方淘汰重定向: {} -> {}", original_model, forwarded.value()));
261	        return forwarded.value().clone();
262	    }
263	
264	    // 1. 精确匹配 (次高优先级)
265	    if let Some(target) = custom_mapping.get(original_model) {
266	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Router] 精确映射: {} -> {}", original_model, target));
267	        return target.clone();
268	    }
269	    
270	    // 2. Wildcard match - most specific (highest non-wildcard chars) wins
271	    // Note: When multiple patterns have the SAME specificity, HashMap iteration order
272	    // determines the result (non-deterministic). Users can avoid this by making patterns
273	    // more specific. Future improvement: use IndexMap + frontend sorting for full control.
274	    let mut best_match: Option<(&str, &str, usize)> = None;
275	
276	    for (pattern, target) in custom_mapping.iter() {
277	        if pattern.contains('*') && wildcard_match(pattern, original_model) {
278	            let specificity = pattern.chars().count() - pattern.matches('*').count();
279	            if best_match.is_none() || specificity > best_match.unwrap().2 {
280	                best_match = Some((pattern.as_str(), target.as_str(), specificity));
281	            }
282	        }
283	    }
284	
285	    if let Some((pattern, target, _)) = best_match {
286	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!(
287	            "[Router] Wildcard match: {} -> {} (rule: {})",
288	            original_model, target, pattern
289	        ));
290	        return target.to_string();
291	    }
292	    
293	    // 3. 系统默认映射
294	    let result = map_claude_model_to_gemini(original_model);
295	    if result != original_model {
296	        crate::modules::logger::log_info(&format!("[Router] 系统默认映射: {} -> {}", original_model, result));
297	    }
298	    result
299	}
300	
301	/// Normalize any physical model name to one of the 3 standard protection IDs.
302	/// This ensures quota protection works consistently regardless of API versioning or request variations.
303	/// 
304	/// Standard IDs:
305	/// - `gemini-3-flash`: All Flash variants (1.5-flash, 2.5-flash, 3-flash, etc.)
306	/// - `gemini-3-pro-high`: All Pro variants (1.5-pro, 2.5-pro, etc.)
307	/// - `claude-sonnet-4-5`: All Claude Sonnet variants (3-5-sonnet, sonnet-4-5, etc.)
308	/// 
309	/// Returns `None` if the model doesn't match any of the 3 protected categories.
310	pub fn normalize_to_standard_id(model_name: &str) -> Option<String> {
311	    let lower = model_name.to_lowercase();
312	    
313	    // 1. image 资源 (优先匹配，使用 contains 匹配以支持任何变体，如 gemini-3.1-flash-image)
314	    if lower.contains("image") {
315	        return Some("gemini-3-pro-image".to_string());
316	    }
317	
318	    // 2. gemini-3-flash (包含所有 flash 变体)
319	    if lower.contains("flash") {
320	        return Some("gemini-3-flash".to_string());
321	    }
322	
323	    // 3. gemini-3-pro-high (包含 pro 变体)
324	    if lower.contains("pro") && !lower.contains("image") {
325	        return Some("gemini-3-pro-high".to_string());
326	    }
327	
328	    // 4. Claude 系列 (合并 Opus, Sonnet, Haiku 为统一保护组 'claude')
329	    if lower.contains("claude") || lower.contains("opus") || lower.contains("sonnet") || lower.contains("haiku") {
330	        return Some("claude".to_string());
331	    }
332	
333	    None
334	}

236	    state: &AppState,

249	    }

268	        Ok(u) => u,
269	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, e).into_response(),
270	    };
271	
272	    let timeout_secs = state.request_timeout.max(5);
273	    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
274	    let client = match build_client(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
275	        Ok(c) => c,
276	        Err(e) => return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e).into_response(),
277	    };
278

### `new()` -- Constructor (line 16)

```rust
pub fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self
```

Filters to only enabled providers. If none are enabled, optionally falls back to legacy z.ai config via `from_zai_config()`, which builds a single `UpstreamProvider` named `"z.ai"` with `ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough`.

### `candidates_for_model()` -- Provider filtering (line 67)

```rust
pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider>
```

Returns all enabled providers whose `model_prefixes` match the given model (case-insensitive prefix match). An empty `model_prefixes` means wildcard -- the provider accepts all models.

### `select()` -- Provider selection (line 80)

```rust
pub fn select(&self, model: &str, prev_failed: Option<&str>) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider>
```

Selection priority order:
1. **Exclusive** providers (sorted by `priority`, lowest first). Returns the first match.
2. **Pooled** providers (sorted by priority, selected via round-robin counter `rr_counter.fetch_add`).
3. **Fallback** providers (sorted by priority, returns the first/lowest-priority match).

The `prev_failed` parameter excludes a specific provider name, enabling fallback retry to a different provider after a failure.

### `map_model()` -- Model name translation (line 129)

```rust
pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String
```

Resolution order:
1. Exact match in `provider.model_mapping` HashMap.
2. Prefix match in `provider.model_mapping` (lowercase).
3. Strip `zai:` prefix.
4. Pass through `glm-*` models as-is.
5. Claude family defaults: `claude-*` models map to `provider.default_models.opus/sonnet/haiku` based on substring match.
6. Fallback: pass through as-is.

Resolution priority (descending):

1. **Exact match** in user's `custom_mapping`.

## Summary: Provider Selection vs Model Resolution Ordering

```
Request arrives
  |
  v
[1] Parse request body -> extract raw model name
  |
  v
[2] ProviderRouter.select(raw_model)  -- "Which upstream provider handles this?"
  |                                      Uses: model_prefixes, dispatch_mode, priority
  |                                      Does NOT use: custom_mapping or resolve_model_route
  |
  +-- Provider found? --> Forward to provider immediately
  |                        (AnthropicPassthrough path applies provider.model_mapping
  |                         via map_model_for_provider inside the forwarder)
  |
  +-- No provider --> Fall through to legacy Google path
                       |
                       v
                   [3] resolve_model_route(raw_model, custom_mapping)
                       -- "What is the canonical Gemini model ID?"
                       Uses: dynamic_forwarding > custom exact > custom wildcard > CLAUDE_TO_GEMINI
                       |
                       v
                   [4] Retry loop (get token, transform, send)
```

The critical architectural point is that **provider selection (`ProviderRouter.select`) happens BEFORE model name resolution (`resolve_model_route`)**. The router uses the raw, client-supplied model name to pick a provider. Model name resolution to canonical IDs only happens when falling through to the legacy Google/AI Studio path. When a provider handles the request, the provider's own `model_mapping` config is applied inside the forwarder function via `map_model_for_provider`.

## Implementation Plan: `provider_id` Field and Model-Based Provider Routing

### Design Decision Summary

**Where to strip the prefix**: In `ProviderRouter.select()`. This is the only place that has access to the full set of registered provider IDs, making it the authoritative place to recognize and strip `provider_id/` prefixes.

**How to thread the stripped model**: Change `select()` to return a `ProviderSelection` struct containing both the provider reference and the resolved (possibly stripped) model name. All callers then use the resolved model for downstream operations.

**Why not strip in handlers**: Handlers don't know which provider IDs are registered. Stripping at the router level avoids duplicating the `provider_id` index and centralizes the routing logic.

---

### Phase 1: Rust Backend Changes

#### 1.1 `src-tauri/src/proxy/config.rs` -- Add `provider_id` field

**Location**: Lines 317-343, the `UpstreamProvider` struct.

Add a new field after `name`:

```rust

/// Enables direct routing via `provider_id/model_name` format.
/// Optional; providers without a provider_id are only matched via model_prefixes.
#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
pub provider_id: Option<String>,
```

Add a validation helper function below the struct:

/// Validate that a provider_id matches the allowed format: 1-8 alphanumeric/underscore chars.
pub fn is_valid_provider_id(id: &str) -> bool {
    !id.is_empty() && id.len() <= 8 && id.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_')
}
```

```rust
/// If `model` starts with a registered `provider_id/`, return `(provider_id, rest)`.
fn extract_provider_id_prefix(&self, model: &str) -> Option<(&str, &str)> {
    if let Some(slash_pos) = model.find('/') {
        let candidate = &model[..slash_pos];
        if self.provider_id_index.contains_key(candidate) {
            let rest = &model[slash_pos + 1..];
            if !rest.is_empty() {
                return Some((candidate, rest));
            }
        }
    }
    None
}
```

**Replace `select()` method** with a new version that returns `Option<ProviderSelection>`:

```rust
/// Select the next provider for the given model.
/// If the model starts with a registered `provider_id/`, routes directly to that provider.
/// Returns both the provider and the resolved model name (with prefix stripped if applicable).
pub fn select(&self, model: &str, prev_failed: Option<&str>) -> Option<ProviderSelection<'_>> {
    // STEP 1: Check for provider_id/ prefix routing (highest priority)
    if let Some((pid, rest)) = self.extract_provider_id_prefix(model) {
        if let Some(&idx) = self.provider_id_index.get(pid) {
            let provider = &self.providers[idx];
            if provider.enabled && prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| provider.name != pf) {
                return Some(ProviderSelection {
                    provider,
                    resolved_model: rest.to_string(),
                });
            }
        }
        // provider_id matched but provider is disabled or failed; fall through to normal selection
    }

    // STEP 2: Normal selection (existing logic, unchanged)
    let candidates: Vec<_> = self
        .candidates_for_model(model)
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
        .collect();

    if candidates.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }

    // ... existing exclusive > pooled > fallback logic ...
    // At the end, return:
    // Some(ProviderSelection { provider: <selected>, resolved_model: model.to_string() })
}
```

**Key behavior**: When a `provider_id/` prefix matches, the method returns the resolved model with the prefix stripped. When falling through to normal selection, `resolved_model` equals the original model.

**Update `map_model()` and `map_model_for_provider()`** -- These already handle model name mapping internally and don't need changes. They will receive the stripped model name from callers.

### Phase 3: Backwards Compatibility

1. **Existing configs**: All existing providers will deserialize with `provider_id: None` (via `#[serde(default)]`). They continue to work exclusively via `model_prefixes` matching. No migration needed.

2. **ProviderRouter `from_zai_config()`**: The legacy z.ai migration creates a provider without a `provider_id`, which is correct -- legacy z.ai configs don't have this concept.

3. **API compatibility**: The `select()` return type change from `Option<&UpstreamProvider>` to `Option<ProviderSelection<'_>>` is a breaking change within the codebase only. All callers are in the same crate and will be updated in Phase 1.3.

4. **Edge case -- `provider_id` matching a model prefix**: If a provider has `provider_id: "g"` and another provider has `model_prefixes: ["gpt-"]`, a request for `gpt-4o` will NOT trigger provider_id routing (because `gpt-4o` does not contain a `/`). The provider_id routing only activates when the model contains a `/` and the part before `/` matches a registered `provider_id`. No conflict is possible.

5. **Edge case -- `provider_id/model` where provider_id exists but model doesn't match any prefix**: The `provider_id/` match bypasses `model_prefixes` entirely. This is intentional -- it gives users a way to force-route any model to a specific provider regardless of prefix configuration.

## Current Architecture

### Rust UpstreamProvider (src-tauri/src/proxy/config.rs:317-343)
```rust
pub struct UpstreamProvider {
    pub name: String,
    pub enabled: bool,
    pub base_url: String,
    pub api_key: String,
    pub protocol: ProviderProtocol,
    pub dispatch_mode: ProviderDispatchMode,
    pub priority: u8,
    pub model_prefixes: Vec<String>,
    pub model_mapping: HashMap<String, String>,
    pub default_models: ProviderModelDefaults,
    pub request_timeout_secs: Option<u64>,
}
```

### ProviderRouter.select() (src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/router.rs:80)
```rust
pub fn select(&self, model: &str, prev_failed: Option<&str>) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider>
```
Currently filters by `model_prefixes` + dispatch_mode + priority. Selection order: exclusive > pooled (RR) > fallback.

### Request Flow (OpenAI handler):
1. Parse request -> extract model name
2. `ProviderRouter.select(raw_model)` -> picks provider by prefix
3. If provider found, forward immediately (applies provider.model_mapping inside forwarder)
4. If no provider, fall through to legacy Google path (calls `resolve_model_route`)

### Request Flow (Claude handler):
1. Parse request
2. `ProviderRouter.select(raw_model)` if providers exist
3. If provider found, route immediately
4. Otherwise legacy z.ai or Google path

### TypeScript UpstreamProvider (src/types/config.ts:24-36)
Same fields as Rust.

### ProviderManager UI (src/pages/ProviderManager.tsx)
Full CRUD page for providers with add/edit/delete/toggle. Form fields match UpstreamProvider struct.

## User Requirements

1. Add a `provider_id` field to each provider (short name/abbreviation like "g", "a", "z")
2. Support model names in format `provider_id/model_name` (e.g., `g/gemini-2.5-pro`, `a/claude-sonnet-4-6`)
3. When request model has a provider ID prefix, route directly to that provider
4. Strip the `provider_id/` prefix before forwarding to the provider
5. If no provider ID prefix, use existing default provider selection (model_prefixes matching)

## Design Requirements

1. **Rust changes**:
   - Add `provider_id: Option<String>` to `UpstreamProvider` struct with Deserialize/Serialize
   - In `ProviderRouter`, add a `select_by_provider_id()` method OR modify `select()` to first check for `provider_id/` prefix
   - The stripping of `provider_id/` prefix must happen BEFORE the model name is passed to the forwarder
   - Need to decide: strip at ProviderRouter level or at handler level?

2. **TypeScript changes**:
   - Add `provider_id?: string` to `UpstreamProvider` interface
   - Add `provider_id` input field to ProviderManager form

3. **Validation considerations**:
   - Provider ID should be unique across all providers
   - Should validate format (alphanumeric + underscores, short)
   - What if provider_id conflicts with an actual model prefix?

- Exact code changes needed in each file
- Where to place the provider_id extraction logic (recommend: in `ProviderRouter.select()` as first step)
- How to handle the model name stripping (recommend: return a tuple of (provider, stripped_model_name) from the selection)
- How to thread the stripped model name to the forwarder
- UI changes needed in ProviderManager.tsx
- Migration/backwards compatibility considerations

1	use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
2	use std::sync::Arc;

4	use crate::proxy::config::{
5	    ProviderDispatchMode, ProviderModelDefaults, ProviderProtocol, UpstreamProvider, ZaiConfig,
6	};
7	
8	/// Routes incoming requests to the appropriate upstream provider.
9	pub struct ProviderRouter {
10	    providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>,
11	    rr_counter: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
12	}
13	
14	impl ProviderRouter {
15	    /// Build from config. If `providers` is empty, optionally migrate from legacy z.ai config.
16	    pub fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self {
17	        let enabled: Vec<_> = providers.into_iter().filter(|p| p.enabled).collect();
18	
19	        if enabled.is_empty() {
20	            if let Some(zai) = legacy_zai {
21	                if zai.enabled && zai.dispatch_mode != crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
22	                    return Self::from_zai_config(zai);
23	                }
24	            }
25	        }
26	
27	        Self {
28	            providers: enabled,
29	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
30	        }
31	    }
32	
33	    /// Build a single-provider router from legacy z.ai configuration.
34	    fn from_zai_config(zai: &ZaiConfig) -> Self {
35	        let dispatch_mode = match zai.dispatch_mode {
36	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
37	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Exclusive => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
38	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Pooled => ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled,
39	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback => ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback,
40	        };
41	
42	        let provider = UpstreamProvider {
43	            name: "z.ai".to_string(),
44	            enabled: true,
45	            base_url: zai.base_url.clone(),
46	            api_key: zai.api_key.clone(),
47	            protocol: ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough,
48	            dispatch_mode,
49	            priority: 0,
50	            model_prefixes: Vec::new(), // wildcard
51	            model_mapping: zai.model_mapping.clone(),
52	            default_models: ProviderModelDefaults {
53	                opus: zai.models.opus.clone(),
54	                sonnet: zai.models.sonnet.clone(),
55	                haiku: zai.models.haiku.clone(),
56	            },
57	            request_timeout_secs: None,
58	        };
59	
60	        Self {
61	            providers: vec![provider],
62	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
63	        }
64	    }
65	
66	    /// Find enabled providers that can handle the given model.
67	    pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider> {
68	        let m = model.to_lowercase();
69	        self.providers
70	            .iter()
71	            .filter(|p| {
72	                p.model_prefixes.is_empty()
73	                    || p.model_prefixes.iter().any(|prefix| m.starts_with(prefix))
74	            })
75	            .collect()
76	    }
77	
78	    /// Select the next provider for the given model.
79	    /// `prev_failed` excludes a provider that just failed, triggering fallback.
80	    pub fn select(
81	        &self,
82	        model: &str,
83	        prev_failed: Option<&str>,
84	    ) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> {
85	        let candidates: Vec<_> = self
86	            .candidates_for_model(model)
87	            .into_iter()
88	            .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
89	            .collect();
90	
91	        if candidates.is_empty() {
92	            return None;
93	        }
94	
95	        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority)
96	        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates
97	            .iter()
98	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
99	            .copied()
100	            .collect();
101	        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
102	        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
103	            return Some(*p);
104	        }
105	
106	        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
107	        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates
108	            .iter()
109	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
110	            .copied()
111	            .collect();
112	        if !pooled.is_empty() {
113	            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
114	            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % pooled.len();
115	            return Some(pooled[idx]);
116	        }
117	
118	        // 3. Fallback providers
119	        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates
120	            .iter()
121	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
122	            .copied()
123	            .collect();
124	        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
125	        fallback.first().copied()
126	    }
127	
128	    /// Map incoming model name to the provider's native model ID.
129	    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String {
130	        // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
131	        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.get(incoming) {
132	            return mapped.clone();
133	        }
134	        // 2. Prefix match in model_mapping
135	        let m = incoming.to_lowercase();
136	        if let Some((_, mapped)) = provider
137	            .model_mapping
138	            .iter()
139	            .find(|(k, _)| m.starts_with(k.as_str()))
140	        {
141	            return mapped.clone();
142	        }
143	        // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
144	        if m.starts_with("zai:") {
145	            return incoming[4..].to_string();
146	        }
147	        // 4. Pass through glm-* models
148	        if m.starts_with("glm-") {
149	            return incoming.to_string();
150	        }
151	        // 5. Family defaults for Claude models
152	        if m.starts_with("claude-") {
153	            if m.contains("opus") {
154	                return provider.default_models.opus.clone();
155	            }
156	            if m.contains("haiku") {
157	                return provider.default_models.haiku.clone();
158	            }
159	            return provider.default_models.sonnet.clone();
160	        }
161	        // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
162	        incoming.to_string()
163	    }
164	
165	    /// Check if the router has any enabled providers.
166	    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
167	        self.providers.is_empty()
168	    }
169	}
