171	/// Map a model name to the provider's expected model name.
172	/// This is a free function so it can be used without holding a `ProviderRouter` lock.
173	pub fn map_model_for_provider(
174	    original: &str,
175	    model_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
176	    default_models: &ProviderModelDefaults,
177	) -> String {
178	    // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
179	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(original) {
180	        return mapped.clone();
181	    }
182	    // 2. Lowercase match
183	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
184	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(&m) {
185	        return mapped.clone();
186	    }
187	    // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
188	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
189	        return original[4..].to_string();
190	    }
191	    // 4. Pass through glm-* models
192	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
193	        return original.to_string();
194	    }
195	    // 5. Claude family defaults
196	    if m.starts_with("claude-") {
197	        if m.contains("opus") {
198	            return default_models.opus.clone();
199	        }
200	        if m.contains("haiku") {
201	            return default_models.haiku.clone();
202	        }
203	        return default_models.sonnet.clone();
204	    }
205	    // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
206	    original.to_string()
207	}

39	/// Extract thinking hints from raw request JSON (OpenCode variants compatibility)
40	/// Checks multiple possible paths for budget and level configuration
41	fn extract_thinking_hint(body: &Value) -> ThinkingHint {
42	    let mut hint = ThinkingHint {
43	        budget_tokens: None,
44	        level: None,
45	    };
46	
47	    // Try to extract budget_tokens from various paths
48	    // Priority: thinking.budget_tokens > thinking.budgetTokens > thinking.budget > thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget
49	    if let Some(budget) = body
50	        .get("thinking")
51	        .and_then(|t| t.get("budget_tokens"))
52	        .and_then(|b| b.as_u64())
53	    {
54	        hint.budget_tokens = Some(budget as u32);
55	    } else if let Some(budget) = body
56	        .get("thinking")
57	        .and_then(|t| t.get("budgetTokens"))
58	        .and_then(|b| b.as_u64())
59	    {
60	        hint.budget_tokens = Some(budget as u32);
61	    } else if let Some(budget) = body
62	        .get("thinking")
63	        .and_then(|t| t.get("budget"))
64	        .and_then(|b| b.as_u64())
65	    {
66	        hint.budget_tokens = Some(budget as u32);
67	    } else if let Some(budget) = body
68	        .get("thinkingConfig")
69	        .and_then(|t| t.get("thinkingBudget"))
70	        .and_then(|b| b.as_u64())
71	    {
72	        hint.budget_tokens = Some(budget as u32);
73	    }
74	
75	    // Try to extract level from thinkingLevel
76	    if let Some(level) = body.get("thinkingLevel").and_then(|l| l.as_str()) {
77	        hint.level = Some(level.to_lowercase());
78	    }
79	
80	    hint
81	}
82	
83	/// Map thinking level to suggested budget tokens
84	fn level_to_budget(level: &str, cap: u64) -> u32 {
85	    let base = match level {
86	        "minimal" => 1024,
87	        "low" => 8192,
88	        "medium" => 16384,
89	        "high" => 24576,
90	        _ => 8192, // default to low
91	    };
92	    base.min(cap as u32)
93	}
94	
95	/// Map thinking level to effort level for output_config
96	fn level_to_effort(level: &str) -> String {
97	    match level {
98	        "minimal" | "low" => "low".to_string(),
99	        "medium" => "medium".to_string(),
100	        "high" => "high".to_string(),
101	        _ => "low".to_string(),
102	    }
103	}
104	
105	/// Apply thinking hints to ClaudeRequest
106	fn apply_thinking_hints(
107	    request: &mut crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::ClaudeRequest,
108	    hint: &ThinkingHint,
109	    trace_id: &str,
110	    budget_cap: u64, // [NEW]
111	) {
112	    let mut applied = false;
113	
114	    // If budget is provided, set/override thinking config
115	    if let Some(budget) = hint.budget_tokens {
116	        request.thinking = Some(crate::proxy::mappers::claude::models::ThinkingConfig {
117	            type_: "enabled".to_string(),
118	            budget_tokens: Some(budget),
119	            effort: None,
120	        });
121	        tracing::debug!(
122	            "[{}] Applied thinking hint: budget_tokens={}",
123	            trace_id, budget
124	        );
125	        applied = true;
126	    }
127

53	    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()

71	fn copy_passthrough_headers(incoming: &HeaderMap) -> HeaderMap {
72	    // Only forward a conservative set of headers to avoid leaking the local proxy key or cookies.
73	    let mut out = HeaderMap::new();
74	
75	    for (k, v) in incoming.iter() {
76	        let key = k.as_str().to_ascii_lowercase();
77	        match key.as_str() {
78	            "content-type" | "accept" | "anthropic-version" | "user-agent" => {
79	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
80	            }
81	            // Some clients use these for streaming; safe to pass through.
82	            "accept-encoding" | "cache-control" => {
83	                out.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
84	            }
85	            _ => {}
86	        }
87	    }
88	
89	    out
90	}

92	fn set_zai_auth(headers: &mut HeaderMap, incoming: &HeaderMap, api_key: &str) {
93	    // Prefer to keep the same auth scheme as the incoming request:
94	    // - If the client used x-api-key (Anthropic style), replace it.
95	    // - Else if it used Authorization, replace it with Bearer.
96	    // - Else default to x-api-key.
97	    let has_x_api_key = incoming.contains_key("x-api-key");
98	    let has_auth = incoming.contains_key(header::AUTHORIZATION);
99	
100	    if has_x_api_key || !has_auth {
101	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(api_key) {
102	            headers.insert("x-api-key", v);
103	        }
104	    }
105	
106	    if has_auth {
107	        if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", api_key)) {
108	            headers.insert(header::AUTHORIZATION, v);
109	        }
110	    }
111	}

115	pub fn deep_remove_cache_control(value: &mut Value) {
116	    match value {
117	        Value::Object(map) => {
118	            if let Some(v) = map.remove("cache_control") {
119	                tracing::info!("[ISSUE-744] Deep Cleaning found nested cache_control: {:?}", v);
120	            }

123	            }
124	        }
125	        Value::Array(arr) => {
126	            for v in arr {

128	            }
129	        }
130	        _ => {}
131	    }
132	}

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Now I need to understand where the model name is used in the forwarder path. Let me trace the flow more carefully:

1. In `openai.rs` handler:
   - `openai_req.model` is the raw model from the request
   - `router.select(&openai_req.model, None)` selects the provider
   - For AnthropicPassthrough: `to_claude_body(&openai_req)` converts the request, then `forward_anthropic_with_provider` is called
   - For OpenAICompatible: `forward_openai_compatible` is called, which serializes `openai_req` as-is
   - For GeminiV1Internal: `forward_gemini_v1internal_with_provider` is called

2. In `claude.rs` handler:
   - `request.model` is the raw model
   - `router.select(&request.model, None)` selects the provider
   - Then forwards to the provider

The critical insight is that when a provider ID prefix like `g/gemini-2.5-pro` arrives, I need to intercept this at the `select()` level to extract the provider ID and strip it before passing to the forwarder, otherwise the provider receives a malformed model name with the prefix still attached.

Now I need to check whether the provider ID should be validated against a precomputed index, and I should also examine how the ProviderManager.tsx form gets saved and the full structure of the remaining sections.
</details></think>

11	const CREATE_NO_WINDOW: u32 = 0x08000000;
12	
13	/// Windows 常见 CLI 安装路径扫描
14	#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
15	fn scan_windows_cli_paths(cmd: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
16	    let mut common_paths: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new();
17	
18	    // 常见 Windows 安装路径，按优先级排序（仅加入可推导出的绝对路径，避免空/相对路径误判）
19	    if let Some(app_data) = std::env::var_os("APPDATA") {
20	        let npm_base = PathBuf::from(app_data).join("npm");
21	        common_paths.push(npm_base.join(format!("{}.cmd", cmd)));
22	        common_paths.push(npm_base.join(cmd));
23	    }
24	
25	    if let Some(local_app_data) = std::env::var_os("LOCALAPPDATA") {
26	        let pnpm_base = PathBuf::from(&local_app_data).join("pnpm");
27	        common_paths.push(pnpm_base.join(format!("{}.cmd", cmd)));
28	        common_paths.push(pnpm_base.join(cmd));
29	
30	        let yarn_base = PathBuf::from(local_app_data).join("Yarn").join("bin");
31	        common_paths.push(yarn_base.join(format!("{}.cmd", cmd)));
32	        common_paths.push(yarn_base.join(cmd));
33	    }
34	
35	    if let Some(home) = dirs::home_dir() {
36	        let bun_base = home.join(".bun").join("bin");
37	        common_paths.push(bun_base.join(format!("{}.exe", cmd)));
38	        common_paths.push(bun_base.join(cmd));
39	    }
40	
41	    for path in common_paths {
42	        if is_safe_path(&path) {
43	            tracing::debug!("[CLI-Sync] Detected {} via Windows explicit path: {:?}", cmd, path);
44	            return Some(path);
45	        }
46	    }
47	
48	    // 扫描 NVM Windows 目录
49	    if let Ok(nvm_home) = std::env::var("NVM_HOME") {
50	        let nvm_path = PathBuf::from(nvm_home);
51	        if nvm_path.is_dir() {
52	            // NVM Windows 结构: %NVM_HOME%\v{version}\{cmd}.cmd
53	            if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(&nvm_path) {
54	                for entry in entries.flatten() {
55	                    let cmd_path = entry.path().join(format!("{}.cmd", cmd));
56	                    if is_safe_path(&cmd_path) {
57	                        tracing::debug!("[CLI-Sync] Detected {} via NVM_HOME: {:?}", cmd, cmd_path);
58	                        return Some(cmd_path);
59	                    }
60	                    // 也检查 .exe 版本
61	                    let exe_path = entry.path().join(format!("{}.exe", cmd));
62	                    if is_safe_path(&exe_path) {
63	                        tracing::debug!("[CLI-Sync] Detected {} via NVM_HOME: {:?}", cmd, exe_path);
64	                        return Some(exe_path);
65	                    }
66	                }
67	            }
68	        }
69	    }
70	
71	    None
72	}
73	
74	/// 解析 where 命令输出获取第一个有效路径
75	#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
76	fn parse_where_output(output: &[u8]) -> Option<PathBuf> {
77	    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(output);
78	    for line in stdout.lines() {
79	        let trimmed = line.trim();
80	        if !trimmed.is_empty() {
81	            let path = PathBuf::from(trimmed);
82	            if is_safe_path(&path) {
83	                return Some(path);
84	            }
85	        }
86	    }
87	    None
88	}
89	
90	/// 检查路径是否是 .cmd/.bat 文件
91	#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
92	fn is_cmd_file(path: &PathBuf) -> bool {
93	    path.extension()
94	        .and_then(|e| e.to_str())
95	        .map(|e| e.eq_ignore_ascii_case("cmd") || e.eq_ignore_ascii_case("bat"))
96	        .unwrap_or(false)
97	}
98	
99	/// 验证路径是否安全（防止命令注入）
100	#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
101	fn is_safe_path(path: &PathBuf) -> bool {
102	    // 检查路径是否存在且是文件
103	    if !path.exists() || !path.is_file() {
104	        return false;
105	    }
106	
107	    // 必须为绝对路径，避免执行相对路径文件
108	    if !path.is_absolute() {
109	        return false;
110	    }
111	
112	    // 检查路径是否包含危险字符
113	    let path_str = path.to_string_lossy();
114	    let dangerous_chars = ['&', '|', ';', '<', '>', '(', ')', '`', '$', '^', '%', '!'];
115	    if path_str.chars().any(|c| dangerous_chars.contains(&c)) {
116	        tracing::warn!("[CLI-Sync] Path contains dangerous characters: {}", path_str);
117	        return false;
118	    }
119	
120	    true
121	}
122	
123	/// 执行版本命令（Windows 特殊处理 .cmd/.bat）
124	#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
125	fn run_version_command(executable_path: &PathBuf) -> Option<String> {
126	    // 安全校验：验证路径不包含危险字符
127	    if !is_safe_path(executable_path) {
128	        return None;
129	    }
130	
131	    let output = if is_cmd_file(executable_path) {
132	        // 使用引号包裹路径防止注入，使用 /S 开关确保安全解析
133	        let quoted_path = format!("\"{}\"", executable_path.to_string_lossy());
134	        Command::new("cmd.exe")
135	            .arg("/C")
136	            .arg(&quoted_path)
137	            .arg("--version")
138	            .creation_flags(CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
139	            .output()
140	    } else {
141	        let mut cmd = Command::new(executable_path);
142	        cmd.arg("--version");
143	        cmd.creation_flags(CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
144	        cmd.output()
145	    };
146	
147	    match output {
148	        Ok(out) if out.status.success() => {
149	            let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
150	            // 使用正则提取版本号（更精确）
151	            extract_version(&s)
152	        }
153	        _ => None,
154	    }
155	}
156	
157	/// 提取版本号（使用更精确的 semver 匹配）
158	fn extract_version(s: &str) -> Option<String> {
159	    // 匹配 semver 格式: x.y.z 或 x.y
160	    let re = regex::Regex::new(r"(\d+\.\d+(?:\.\d+)?)").ok()?;
161	    re.captures(s)
162	        .and_then(|caps| caps.get(1))
163	        .map(|m| m.as_str().to_string())
164	}

250	pub struct CliStatus {
251	    pub installed: bool,
252	    pub version: Option<String>,
253	    pub is_synced: bool,
254	    pub has_backup: bool,
255	    pub current_base_url: Option<String>,
256	    pub files: Vec<String>, // 返回关联的文件名列表供前端展示

259	/// 检测 CLI 是否安装并获取版本
260	pub fn check_cli_installed(app: &CliApp) -> (bool, Option<String>) {
261	    let cmd = app.as_str();
262	    // 默认使用命令名，如果 fallback 找到路径则更新为绝对路径
263	    let mut executable_path = PathBuf::from(cmd);
264	    
265	    // 1. 优先使用 which/where 检测 (遵循 PATH)
266	    let which_output = if cfg!(target_os = "windows") {
267	        let mut c = Command::new("where");
268	        c.arg(cmd);
269	        #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
270	        c.creation_flags(CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
271	        c.output()
272	    } else {
273	        Command::new("which").arg(cmd).output()
274	    };
275	
276	    let mut installed = match &which_output {
277	        Ok(out) => out.status.success(),
278	        Err(_) => false,
279	    };
280	
281	    #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
282	    if installed {
283	        if let Ok(out) = &which_output {
284	            if let Some(found_path) = parse_where_output(&out.stdout) {
285	                executable_path = found_path;
286	            }
287	        }
288	    }
289	
290	    #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
291	    if !installed {
292	        if let Some(found_path) = scan_windows_cli_paths(cmd) {
293	            installed = true;
294	            executable_path = found_path;
295	        }
296	    }
297	
298	    // [FIX #765] macOS 增强检测: 如果 which 失败,显式搜索常用二进制路径
299	    // 解决 Tauri 进程 PATH 可能不完整导致检测不到已安装 CLI 的问题
300	    if !installed && !cfg!(target_os = "windows") {
301	        let home = dirs::home_dir().unwrap_or_default();
302	        let mut common_paths = vec![
303	            home.join(".local/bin"),
304	            home.join(".bun/bin"),
305	            home.join(".bun/install/global/node_modules/.bin"),
306	            home.join(".npm-global/bin"),
307	            home.join(".volta/bin"),
308	            home.join("bin"),
309	            PathBuf::from("/opt/homebrew/bin"),
310	            PathBuf::from("/usr/local/bin"),
311	            PathBuf::from("/usr/bin"),
312	        ];
313	
314	        // 增强：扫描 nvm 目录下的所有 node 版本
315	        let nvm_base = home.join(".nvm/versions/node");
316	        if nvm_base.exists() {
317	            if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&nvm_base) {
318	                for entry in entries.flatten() {
319	                    let bin_path = entry.path().join("bin");
320	                    if bin_path.exists() {
321	                        common_paths.push(bin_path);
322	                    }
323	                }
324	            }
325	        }
326	
327	        for path in common_paths {
328	            let full_path = path.join(cmd);
329	            if full_path.exists() {
330	                tracing::debug!("[CLI-Sync] Detected {} via explicit path: {:?}", cmd, full_path);
331	                installed = true;
332	                executable_path = full_path;
333	                break;
334	            }
335	        }
336	    }
337	
338	    if !installed {
339	        return (false, None);
340	    }
341	
342	    // 2. 获取版本（Windows 使用特殊处理 .cmd/.bat）
343	    #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
344	    let version = run_version_command(&executable_path);
345	
346	    #[cfg(not(target_os = "windows"))]
347	    let version = {
348	        let mut ver_cmd = Command::new(&executable_path);
349	        ver_cmd.arg("--version");
350	        let version_output = ver_cmd.output();
351	        match version_output {
352	            Ok(out) if out.status.success() => {
353	                let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
354	                let cleaned = s.split(|c: char| !c.is_numeric() && c != '.')
355	                    .filter(|part| !part.is_empty())
356	                    .last()
357	                    .map(|p| p.trim())
358	                    .unwrap_or(&s)
359	                    .to_string();
360	                Some(cleaned)
361	            }
362	            _ => None,
363	        }
364	    };
365	
366	    (true, version)
367	}

369	/// 读取当前配置并检测同步状态
370	pub fn get_sync_status(app: &CliApp, proxy_url: &str) -> (bool, bool, Option<String>) {
371	    let files = app.config_files();
372	    if files.is_empty() {
373	        return (false, false, None);
374	    }
375	
376	    let mut all_synced = true;
377	    let mut has_backup = false;
378	    let mut current_base_url = None;
379	
380	    for file in &files {
381	        // 使用更简单的命名规则: original_name + .antigravity.bak
382	        let backup_path = file.path.with_file_name(format!("{}.antigravity.bak", file.name));
383	        
384	        if backup_path.exists() {
385	            has_backup = true;
386	        }
387	
388	        // 如果物理文件不存在
389	        // 如果物理文件不存在
390	        if !file.path.exists() {
391	            // Gemini 的 settings.json/config.json 只要有一个存在即可，或者都不存在（视为未同步）
392	            if app == &CliApp::Gemini && (file.name == "settings.json" || file.name == "config.json") {
393	                continue; 
394	            }
395	            all_synced = false;
396	            continue;
397	        }
398	
399	        let content = match fs::read_to_string(&file.path) {
400	            Ok(c) => c,
401	            Err(_) => {
402	                all_synced = false;
403	                continue;
404	            }
405	        };
406	
407	        match app {
408	            CliApp::Claude => {
409	                if file.name == "settings.json" {
410	                    let json: Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or_default();
411	                    let url = json.get("env").and_then(|e| e.get("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL")).and_then(|v| v.as_str());
412	                    if let Some(u) = url {
413	                        current_base_url = Some(u.to_string());
414	                        if u.trim_end_matches('/') != proxy_url.trim_end_matches('/') {
415	                            all_synced = false;
416	                        }
417	                    } else {
418	                        all_synced = false;
419	                    }
420	                } else if file.name == ".claude.json" {
421	                    let json: Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or_default();
422	                    if json.get("hasCompletedOnboarding") != Some(&Value::Bool(true)) {
423	                        all_synced = false;
424	                    }
425	                }
426	            }
427	            CliApp::Codex => {
428	                if file.name == "config.toml" {
429	                    // 正则匹配 base_url
430	                    let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"(?m)^\s*base_url\s*=\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]"#).unwrap();
431	                    if let Some(caps) = re.captures(&content) {
432	                        let url = &caps[1];
433	                        current_base_url = Some(url.to_string());
434	                        if url.trim_end_matches('/') != proxy_url.trim_end_matches('/') {
435	                            all_synced = false;
436	                        }
437	                    } else {
438	                        all_synced = false;
439	                    }
440	                }
441	            }
442	            CliApp::Gemini => {
443	                if file.name == ".env" {
444	                    let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"(?m)^GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL=(.*)$"#).unwrap();
445	                    if let Some(caps) = re.captures(&content) {
446	                        let url = caps[1].trim();
447	                        current_base_url = Some(url.to_string());
448	                        if url.trim_end_matches('/') != proxy_url.trim_end_matches('/') {
449	                            all_synced = false;
450	                        }
451	                    } else {
452	                        all_synced = false;
453	                    }
454	                }
455	            }
456	            CliApp::OpenCode => {
457	                if file.name == "config.json" {
458	                    let json: Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or_default();
459	                    let url = json.get("providers")
460	                        .and_then(|p| p.get("openai"))
461	                        .and_then(|o| o.get("baseURL"))
462	                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str());
463	                    if let Some(u) = url {
464	                        current_base_url = Some(u.to_string());
465	                        if u.trim_end_matches('/') != proxy_url.trim_end_matches('/') {
466	                            all_synced = false;
467	                        }
468	                    } else {
469	                        all_synced = false;
470	                    }
471	                }
472	            }
473	        }
474	    }
475	
476	    (all_synced, has_backup, current_base_url)
477	}

479	/// 执行同步逻辑
480	pub fn sync_config(app: &CliApp, proxy_url: &str, api_key: &str, model: Option<&str>) -> Result<(), String> {
481	    let files = app.config_files();
482	    
483	    for file in &files {
484	        // Gemini 兼容性逻辑：优先使用 settings.json
485	        if app == &CliApp::Gemini && file.name == "config.json" && !file.path.exists() {
486	            let settings_path = file.path.with_file_name("settings.json");
487	            if settings_path.exists() {
488	                continue; 
489	            }
490	        }
491	
492	        if let Some(parent) = file.path.parent() {
493	            fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| format!("无法创建目录: {}", e))?;
494	        }
495	
496	        // [New Feature] 自动备份：如果文件存在且没有备份，创建 .antigravity.bak 备份
497	        // 这样可以保留用户最初的配置，后续多次同步不会覆盖这个备份
498	        if file.path.exists() {
499	            let backup_path = file.path.with_file_name(format!("{}.antigravity.bak", file.name));
500	            if !backup_path.exists() {
501	                if let Err(e) = fs::copy(&file.path, &backup_path) {
502	                    tracing::warn!("Failed to create backup for {}: {}", file.name, e);
503	                } else {
504	                    tracing::info!("Created backup for {}: {:?}", file.name, backup_path);
505	                }
506	            }
507	        }
508	
509	        let mut content = if file.path.exists() {
510	            fs::read_to_string(&file.path).unwrap_or_default()
511	        } else {
512	            String::new()
513	        };
514	
515	        match app {
516	            CliApp::Claude => {
517	                if file.name == ".claude.json" {
518	                    let mut json: Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or_else(|_| serde_json::json!({}));
519	                    if let Some(obj) = json.as_object_mut() {
520	                        obj.insert("hasCompletedOnboarding".to_string(), Value::Bool(true));
521	                    }
522	                    content = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&json).unwrap();
523	                } else if file.name == "settings.json" {
524	                    let mut json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or_else(|_| serde_json::json!({}));
525	                    if json.as_object().is_none() { json = serde_json::json!({}); }
526	                    let env = json.as_object_mut().unwrap().entry("env").or_insert(serde_json::json!({}));
527	                    if let Some(env_obj) = env.as_object_mut() {
528	                        env_obj.insert("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL".to_string(), Value::String(proxy_url.to_string()));
529	                        if !api_key.is_empty() {
530	                            env_obj.insert("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY".to_string(), Value::String(api_key.to_string()));
531	                            
532	                            // [FIX] 避免冲突：如果存在则移除 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
533	                            env_obj.remove("ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN");
534	
535	                            // [FIX] 清理可能来自其他 Provider 的模型覆盖设置
536	                            env_obj.remove("ANTHROPIC_MODEL");
537	                            env_obj.remove("ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL");
538	                            env_obj.remove("ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL");
539	                            env_obj.remove("ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL");
540	                        } else {
541	                            // 如果 API Key 为空，则移除该键，避免设置为空字符串
542	                            env_obj.remove("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY");
543	                        }
544	                    }
545	
546	                    if let Some(m) = model {
547	                        // 注意：Claude Code 的官方配置中，当前选定模型放在根节点的 model 字段
548	                        json.as_object_mut().unwrap().insert("model".to_string(), Value::String(m.to_string()));
549	                    }
550	                    content = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&json).unwrap();
551	                }
552	            }
553	            CliApp::Codex => {
554	                if file.name == "auth.json" {
555	                    let mut json: Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or_else(|_| serde_json::json!({}));
556	                    if let Some(obj) = json.as_object_mut() {
557	                        obj.insert("OPENAI_API_KEY".to_string(), Value::String(api_key.to_string()));

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The provider_router is initialized at server startup and never updated during runtime. This means when providers are changed in the UI, the user must restart the proxy for the changes to take effect. That's fine for now -- the provider_id validation can be done at the UI level and at config load time.

Now I have a thorough understanding of the codebase. Let me design the implementation plan.

Key observations:
1. The `select()` method returns `Option<&UpstreamProvider>`. To thread the stripped model name through, we need to either:
   a. Return a tuple `Option<(&UpstreamProvider, String)>` from `select()` -- but this would break all callers
   b. Add a new method `select_with_stripped_model()` that returns the tuple, and gradually migrate callers
   c. Strip the provider_id prefix at the handler level before calling select(), then call select() with the stripped model
   d. Add a helper function to extract provider_id and strip it, then use that in the handlers

Looking at the design requirements, stripping at the ProviderRouter level is the right place, and returning a tuple of provider and stripped model name makes sense. I need to check all the callers of `select()` to understand the scope of changes required.

The callers in the OpenAI and Claude handlers each have different downstream requirements. In the OpenAI handler, the original model is stored in `openai_req.model` and used when converting to Claude format or forwarding to OpenAI-compatible providers. The Claude handler has similar needs. Rather than changing the `select()` method's return type, I could add a new method like `select_by_provider_id()` that returns a tuple with the stripped model, keeping the original method unchanged for backward compatibility. Looking at the trade-offs between approaches, option B seems best -- modifying `select()` to return a tuple with the stripped model keeps the logic centralized in the router, avoids scattering the prefix-stripping across multiple handlers, and handles all the edge cases in one place. The main downside is that all callers need updating, but that's straightforward since they'll just destructure the new return type.

Now I'm examining how the model name flows through each handler -- whether it's the `openai_req.model` field being modified directly or passed to mapping functions like `map_model_for_provider()`. Looking at the handler flow, when a provider matches, the request gets forwarded with the original model name still intact, but then `forward_anthropic_with_provider` applies the model mapping to the body before sending. This means the stripped model name from the router needs to be threaded through all these steps -- it has to replace the original model in the OpenAI request, the Claude body after conversion, and the OpenAI-compatible forwarding path, while also being used in logging.

Rather than change the return type of `select()` which would require updating multiple callers, the cleanest approach is to modify `select()` to return a tuple containing both the selected provider and the stripped model name, then pass that stripped model through to each forwarder.

Implementing the extraction logic... The stripped model name needs to replace the original model in each protocol path. For AnthropicPassthrough, `openai_req.model` gets overwritten before converting to the Claude body. For OpenAICompatible, I update `openai_req.model` directly since the request is serialized. For GeminiV1Internal, I'll create a cloned OpenAIRequest with the stripped model and pass that to the forwarder. The Claude handler follows a similar pattern where the request body's model field needs updating before serialization.

So the second lookup would also need to use the stripped model, OR the `candidates_for_model` needs to also check `provider_id`. This is a critical insight.

The simplest approach is to strip the model in the handler right after the first `select()` call. When `select()` returns a `SelectionResult`, we update `request.model = stripped_model` before any other lookups happen. This ensures both the initial selection and the subsequent `candidates_for_model` call use the same stripped model.

Then update all callers to use this new return type. The model stripping happens inside `select()`, so callers don't need to know about the logic.

The first phase focuses on the Rust backend changes: adding the `provider_id` field with serde defaults and validation attributes, creating a `SelectionResult` struct to encapsulate the selection logic, and implementing a validation function to check provider IDs match the expected pattern and are unique across the provider list.

For the handler modifications, I'll update the OpenAI handler to work with the new `SelectionResult`, replacing the model field with the stripped version before forwarding to providers across all three protocol types. ## Implementation Plan: `provider_id` Field and Model-Based Provider Routing

### Design Decision Summary

**Where to strip the prefix**: In `ProviderRouter.select()`. This is the only place that has access to the full set of registered provider IDs, making it the authoritative place to recognize and strip `provider_id/` prefixes.

**How to thread the stripped model**: Change `select()` to return a `ProviderSelection` struct containing both the provider reference and the resolved (possibly stripped) model name. All callers then use the resolved model for downstream operations.

**Why not strip in handlers**: Handlers don't know which provider IDs are registered. Stripping at the router level avoids duplicating the `provider_id` index and centralizes the routing logic.

---

/// Enables direct routing via `provider_id/model_name` format.
/// Optional; providers without a provider_id are only matched via model_prefixes.
#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
pub provider_id: Option<String>,
```

Add a validation helper function below the struct:

```rust
/// Validate that a provider_id matches the allowed format: 1-8 alphanumeric/underscore chars.
pub fn is_valid_provider_id(id: &str) -> bool {
    !id.is_empty() && id.len() <= 8 && id.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_')
}
```

#### 1.2 `src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/router.rs` -- Core routing logic

}

}
```

}

let mut seen_ids = HashSet::new();
for p in &enabled {
    if let Some(ref pid) = p.provider_id {
        if !crate::proxy::config::is_valid_provider_id(pid) {
            tracing::warn!("[ProviderRouter] Invalid provider_id format: '{}' (provider: '{}'). Must be 1-8 alphanumeric/underscore chars.", pid, p.name);
        }

**Add helper method** `extract_provider_id_prefix`:

```rust
/// If `model` starts with a registered `provider_id/`, return `(provider_id, rest)`.
fn extract_provider_id_prefix(&self, model: &str) -> Option<(&str, &str)> {
    if let Some(slash_pos) = model.find('/') {
        let candidate = &model[..slash_pos];
        if self.provider_id_index.contains_key(candidate) {
            let rest = &model[slash_pos + 1..];
            if !rest.is_empty() {
                return Some((candidate, rest));
            }
        }
    }
    None
}
```

**Replace `select()` method** with a new version that returns `Option<ProviderSelection>`:

```rust
/// Select the next provider for the given model.
/// If the model starts with a registered `provider_id/`, routes directly to that provider.
/// Returns both the provider and the resolved model name (with prefix stripped if applicable).
pub fn select(&self, model: &str, prev_failed: Option<&str>) -> Option<ProviderSelection<'_>> {
    // STEP 1: Check for provider_id/ prefix routing (highest priority)
    if let Some((pid, rest)) = self.extract_provider_id_prefix(model) {
        if let Some(&idx) = self.provider_id_index.get(pid) {
            let provider = &self.providers[idx];
            if provider.enabled && prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| provider.name != pf) {
                return Some(ProviderSelection {
                    provider,
                    resolved_model: rest.to_string(),
                });
            }
        }
        // provider_id matched but provider is disabled or failed; fall through to normal selection
    }

    // STEP 2: Normal selection (existing logic, unchanged)
    let candidates: Vec<_> = self
        .candidates_for_model(model)
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
        .collect();

    if candidates.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }

    // ... existing exclusive > pooled > fallback logic ...
    // At the end, return:
    // Some(ProviderSelection { provider: <selected>, resolved_model: model.to_string() })
}
```

**Key behavior**: When a `provider_id/` prefix matches, the method returns the resolved model with the prefix stripped. When falling through to normal selection, `resolved_model` equals the original model.

**Update `map_model()` and `map_model_for_provider()`** -- These already handle model name mapping internally and don't need changes. They will receive the stripped model name from callers.

- Add `provider_id: None` to `make_test_provider()`.

fn test_select_by_provider_id() {
    let mut p1 = make_test_provider("google", ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive, 0, vec![]);
    p1.provider_id = Some("g".to_string());
    p1.model_prefixes = vec!["gemini-".to_string()];

    let mut p2 = make_test_provider("anthropic", ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive, 0, vec![]);
    p2.provider_id = Some("a".to_string());
    p2.model_prefixes = vec!["claude-".to_string()];

    let router = ProviderRouter {

        rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),

            let mut m = std::collections::HashMap::new();
            m.insert("g".to_string(), 0);
            m.insert("a".to_string(), 1);
            m
        },
    };

    assert_eq!(sel.resolved_model, "gemini-2.5-pro");

    let sel = router.select("x/unknown-model", None);
    assert!(sel.is_none());
}

---

### Phase 3: Backwards Compatibility

1. **Existing configs**: All existing providers will deserialize with `provider_id: None` (via `#[serde(default)]`). They continue to work exclusively via `model_prefixes` matching. No migration needed.

2. **ProviderRouter `from_zai_config()`**: The legacy z.ai migration creates a provider without a `provider_id`, which is correct -- legacy z.ai configs don't have this concept.

3. **API compatibility**: The `select()` return type change from `Option<&UpstreamProvider>` to `Option<ProviderSelection<'_>>` is a breaking change within the codebase only. All callers are in the same crate and will be updated in Phase 1.3.

4. **Edge case -- `provider_id` matching a model prefix**: If a provider has `provider_id: "g"` and another provider has `model_prefixes: ["gpt-"]`, a request for `gpt-4o` will NOT trigger provider_id routing (because `gpt-4o` does not contain a `/`). The provider_id routing only activates when the model contains a `/` and the part before `/` matches a registered `provider_id`. No conflict is possible.

5. **Edge case -- `provider_id/model` where provider_id exists but model doesn't match any prefix**: The `provider_id/` match bypasses `model_prefixes` entirely. This is intentional -- it gives users a way to force-route any model to a specific provider regardless of prefix configuration.

---

1. `config.rs` -- Add field + validation function
2. `router.rs` -- Add struct, index, helper method, new `select()` signature, tests
3. Handler files -- Update all callers (openai.rs, claude.rs, gemini.rs, audio.rs)
4. `config.ts` -- Add TypeScript interface field
5. `ProviderManager.tsx` -- Add form field, table column, validation
6. Locale files -- Add translation keys
7. Run `cargo test` to verify router tests pass
8. Manual testing: Add a provider with `provider_id: "g"`, send request with `model: "g/gemini-2.5-pro"`, verify routing and stripped model name in forwarded request

66	    /// Find enabled providers that can handle the given model.
67	    pub fn candidates_for_model(&self, model: &str) -> Vec<&UpstreamProvider> {
68	        let m = model.to_lowercase();
69	        self.providers
70	            .iter()
71	            .filter(|p| {

78	    /// Select the next provider for the given model.
79	    /// `prev_failed` excludes a provider that just failed, triggering fallback.
80	    pub fn select(
81	        &self,
82	        model: &str,
83	        prev_failed: Option<&str>,
84	    ) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> {
85	        let candidates: Vec<_> = self
86	            .candidates_for_model(model)
87	            .into_iter()
88	            .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
89	            .collect();
90	
91	        if candidates.is_empty() {
92	            return None;
93	        }
94	
95	        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority)
96	        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates
97	            .iter()
98	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
99	            .copied()
100	            .collect();
101	        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
102	        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
103	            return Some(*p);
104	        }
105	
106	        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
107	        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates
108	            .iter()
109	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
110	            .copied()
111	            .collect();
112	        if !pooled.is_empty() {
113	            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
114	            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % pooled.len();
115	            return Some(pooled[idx]);
116	        }
117	
118	        // 3. Fallback providers
119	        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates
120	            .iter()
121	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
122	            .copied()
123	            .collect();
124	        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
125	        fallback.first().copied()
126	    }

```md
# 供应商路由ID：支持 `provider_id/model_name` 格式路由

## 背景

当前供应商（Provider）路由依赖 `model_prefixes` 字段做前缀匹配。用户希望增加 `provider_id` 字段，支持 `provider_id/model_name` 格式（如 `g/gemini-2.5-pro`）直接指定供应商，提高路由精确度和可控性。

## 核心流程

\```
请求 model = "g/gemini-2.5-pro"
    |
    v
ProviderRouter.select()
    ├─ 检测到 "g/" 是已注册的 provider_id
    ├─ 直接路由到对应供应商
    ├─ 去掉 "g/" 前缀 → "gemini-2.5-pro"
    └─ 返回 (provider, "gemini-2.5-pro")
         |
         v
handler 用 stripped model 调用转发函数
\```

## 涉及文件

| 文件 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| `src-tauri/src/proxy/config.rs` | 编辑 — `UpstreamProvider` 新增 `provider_id` 字段 |
| `src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/router.rs` | 编辑 — 核心路由逻辑变更 |
| `src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/openai.rs` | 编辑 — 更新 `select()` 调用方 |
| `src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/claude.rs` | 编辑 — 更新 `select()` 调用方 |
| `src/types/config.ts` | 编辑 — TypeScript 类型新增字段 |
| `src/pages/ProviderManager.tsx` | 编辑 — 表单和表格新增 provider_id 字段 |

## 实现步骤

### 1. Rust: `config.rs` — 新增字段

在 `UpstreamProvider` 结构体中添加：
\```rust
/// 短路由标识（如 "g", "a", "z"）。支持 `provider_id/model_name` 格式直接路由。
#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
pub provider_id: Option<String>,
\```

### 2. Rust: `router.rs` — 核心路由变更

**a) 新增 `ProviderSelection` 结构体**（替代 `select()` 的返回值）：
\```rust
pub struct ProviderSelection<'a> {
    pub provider: &'a UpstreamProvider,
    pub resolved_model: String,  // 去掉 provider_id/ 前缀后的模型名
}
\```

**b) `ProviderRouter` 新增 `provider_id_index` 字段**（HashMap<provider_id, provider_index>），在 `new()` 中构建索引。

**c) 新增 `extract_provider_id_prefix()` 方法**：检查模型名是否以 `provider_id/` 开头。

**d) 修改 `select()` 签名**：
- 返回 `Option<ProviderSelection<'_>>` 而非 `Option<&UpstreamProvider>`
- 第一步检查 `provider_id/` 前缀（最高优先级）
- 前缀匹配则返回 `(provider, stripped_model)`
- 不匹配则走原有 `model_prefixes` 匹配逻辑，`resolved_model` 等于原始模型名

**e) 更新所有测试**：`make_test_provider()` 新增 `provider_id: None`，添加新测试用例。

### 3. Rust: 更新 handlers 调用方

**openai.rs**（约 line 150-188）：
\```rust
// 改前
let provider_match = router.select(&openai_req.model, None);
if let Some(provider) = provider_match { ... }

// 改后
let selection = router.select(&openai_req.model, None);
if let Some(sel) = selection {
    openai_req.model = sel.resolved_model.clone();  // 去掉前缀
    let provider = sel.provider;
    ...
}
\```

**claude.rs**（约 line 314-360）：
同样替换 `select()` 调用，用 `sel.resolved_model` 更新 `request.model`。

**其他 handlers**（gemini.rs, audio.rs, images.rs 等如有）：同理更新。

### 4. TypeScript: `config.ts` — 类型更新

`UpstreamProvider` 接口新增：
\```typescript
provider_id?: string;
\```

### 5. 前端: `ProviderManager.tsx` — 表单和表格

- 表单新增 `provider_id` 输入框（1-8 位字母/数字/下划线），放在名称和协议之间
- 新增唯一性校验（添加时检查是否与其他供应商冲突）
- 表格新增一列显示 provider_id 缩写
- `createEmptyProvider()` 新增 `provider_id: ''`

## 验证

1. `cd src-tauri && cargo test` — 路由测试通过
2. `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` — 无 lint 错误
3. 前端 `npx tsc --noEmit` — TypeScript 编译通过
4. 手动测试：在供应商管理页添加一个 `provider_id` 为 `g` 的供应商，请求 model 设为 `g/gemini-2.5-pro`，验证路由到正确供应商且转发时模型名为 `gemini-2.5-pro`

# 供应商路由ID：支持 `provider_id/model_name` 格式路由

## 背景

当前供应商（Provider）路由依赖 `model_prefixes` 字段做前缀匹配。用户希望增加 `provider_id` 字段，支持 `provider_id/model_name` 格式（如 `g/gemini-2.5-pro`）直接指定供应商，提高路由精确度和可控性。

## 核心流程

\```
请求 model = "g/gemini-2.5-pro"
    |
    v
ProviderRouter.select()
    ├─ 检测到 "g/" 是已注册的 provider_id
    ├─ 直接路由到对应供应商
    ├─ 去掉 "g/" 前缀 → "gemini-2.5-pro"
    └─ 返回 (provider, "gemini-2.5-pro")
         |
         v
handler 用 stripped model 调用转发函数
\```

## 涉及文件

| 文件 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| `src-tauri/src/proxy/config.rs` | 编辑 — `UpstreamProvider` 新增 `provider_id` 字段 |
| `src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/router.rs` | 编辑 — 核心路由逻辑变更 |
| `src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/openai.rs` | 编辑 — 更新 `select()` 调用方 |
| `src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/claude.rs` | 编辑 — 更新 `select()` 调用方 |
| `src/types/config.ts` | 编辑 — TypeScript 类型新增字段 |
| `src/pages/ProviderManager.tsx` | 编辑 — 表单和表格新增 provider_id 字段 |

## 实现步骤

### 1. Rust: `config.rs` — 新增字段

在 `UpstreamProvider` 结构体中添加（`name` 之后）：
\```rust
/// 短路由标识（如 "g", "a", "z"）。支持 `provider_id/model_name` 格式直接路由。
#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
pub provider_id: Option<String>,
\```

### 2. Rust: `router.rs` — 核心路由变更

**a) `ProviderRouter` 新增 `provider_id_index` 字段**：`HashMap<String, usize>`，在 `new()` 和 `from_zai_config()` 中构建。

**b) 新增 `ProviderSelection` 结构体**：
\```rust
pub struct ProviderSelection<'a> {
    pub provider: &'a UpstreamProvider,
    pub resolved_model: String,
}
\```

**c) 新增 `extract_provider_id_prefix()` 方法**：
检查模型名是否以 `{已注册的provider_id}/` 开头，返回 `Some((provider_id, rest))` 或 `None`。

**d) 修改 `select()` 返回值为 `Option<ProviderSelection<'_>>`**：
- 第一步：检查 `provider_id/` 前缀（最高优先级），匹配则返回 `(provider, stripped_model)`
- 第二步：走原有 `model_prefixes` + dispatch_mode 匹配逻辑，`resolved_model` = 原始模型名

**e) 更新测试**：`make_test_provider()` 加 `provider_id: None`，新增 `test_select_by_provider_id` 测试。

### 3. Rust: 更新 handlers 调用方

**openai.rs**（~line 150-188，`handle_chat_completions`）：
- `select()` 返回 `Option<ProviderSelection>` 而非 `Option<&UpstreamProvider>`
- 匹配成功后 `openai_req.model = sel.resolved_model.clone()` 去掉前缀
- 图片生成（~line 1854）、图片编辑（~line 2232）等同步更新

**claude.rs**（~line 314-360，`handle_messages`）：
- 同样替换，用 `sel.resolved_model` 更新 `request.model`
- 后续 `candidates_for_model(&request.model)` 自动使用已去前缀的模型名

### 4. TypeScript: `config.ts` — 类型更新

`UpstreamProvider` 接口新增 `provider_id?: string`

### 5. 前端: `ProviderManager.tsx` — 表单和表格

- 表单新增 `provider_id` 输入框（1-8 位字母/数字/下划线），放在名称和协议之间
- 添加时检查 `provider_id` 唯一性
- 表格新增一列显示 provider_id
- `createEmptyProvider()` 新增 `provider_id: ''`

## 验证

1. `cd src-tauri && cargo test` — 路由测试通过
2. `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` — 无 lint 错误
3. 前端 `npx tsc --noEmit` — TypeScript 编译通过

## `model_prefixes` vs `provider_id/` 关系

| 场景 | model_prefixes 作用 | provider_id/ 作用 | 是否冲突 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 请求 `gemini-2.5-pro` | 匹配 `gemini-` 前缀的供应商 | 未使用 | 无 |
| 请求 `g/gemini-2.5-pro` | **被绕过** | 直接路由到 `provider_id=g` 的供应商 | 有优先级关系，不冲突 |

**结论**：`provider_id/` 是**最高优先级**路由，匹配时直接绕过 `model_prefixes` 前缀匹配。这实际上是**互补关系**而非冲突：

- **日常使用**：用 `model_prefixes` 自动匹配（如所有 `gemini-*` 走 Google 供应商）
- **精确控制**：用 `g/model_name` 强制指定某个供应商，不受前缀限制

比如你有一个 `provider_id=g` 的 OpenAI 兼容供应商，通常 `gemini-*` 模型不会匹配它的前缀，但用 `g/gemini-2.5-pro` 可以**强制**路由到它。

# 供应商路由ID：基于 `provider_id/model_name` 的供应商路由

## 背景

当前供应商路由依赖 `model_prefixes` 前缀匹配。用户希望改为基于 `provider_id` 的精确路由方案：
- 每个供应商配置一个 `provider_id`（如 `g`, `a`, `z`）
- 请求时模型名格式为 `provider_id/model_name`（如 `g/gemini-2.5-pro`）
- 根据 `provider_id` 直接路由到对应供应商
- 去掉 `provider_id/` 前缀后用原始模型名执行 LLM 会话
- 没有 `provider_id/` 前缀则走默认供应商选择（无前缀时不匹配任何供应商）

## 核心流程

\```
请求 model = "g/gemini-2.5-pro"
    |
    v
ProviderRouter.select()
    ├─ 提取 "g/" → 查 provider_id_index → 找到对应供应商
    ├─ 去掉 "g/" → "gemini-2.5-pro"
    └─ 返回 (provider, "gemini-2.5-pro")
         |
         v
handler 用 "gemini-2.5-pro" 作为模型名调用转发函数

请求 model = "gemini-2.5-pro"（无前缀）
    |
    v
ProviderRouter.select() → None
    |
    v
走原有默认路径（z.ai / Google）
\```

## 涉及文件

| 文件 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| `src-tauri/src/proxy/config.rs` | 编辑 — `UpstreamProvider` 新增 `provider_id` 字段 |
| `src-tauri/src/proxy/providers/router.rs` | 编辑 — 替换 `model_prefixes` 匹配为 `provider_id` 匹配 |
| `src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/openai.rs` | 编辑 — 更新 `select()` 调用方 |
| `src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/claude.rs` | 编辑 — 更新 `select()` 调用方 |
| `src/types/config.ts` | 编辑 — TypeScript 类型新增字段 |
| `src/pages/ProviderManager.tsx` | 编辑 — 表单和表格新增 provider_id 字段 |

## 实现步骤

### 1. Rust: `config.rs` — 新增字段

\```rust
pub provider_id: Option<String>,
\```

### 2. Rust: `router.rs` — 核心路由变更

**a) `ProviderRouter` 结构体变更**：
- 移除 `model_prefixes` 相关逻辑
- 新增 `provider_id_index: HashMap<String, usize>` 字段

**b) `new()` 中构建 `provider_id_index`**：遍历 enabled providers，建立 `provider_id → index` 映射。检测重复 ID 并记录错误日志。

**c) 新增 `ProviderSelection` 结构体**：
\```rust
pub struct ProviderSelection<'a> {
    pub provider: &'a UpstreamProvider,
    pub resolved_model: String,
}
\```

**d) 重写 `select()` 方法**：
\```rust
pub fn select(&self, model: &str, prev_failed: Option<&str>) -> Option<ProviderSelection<'_>>
\```
- 提取 `model` 中 `/` 前的部分
- 如果匹配某个 `provider_id`，返回对应的供应商和去掉前缀后的模型名
- 如果不匹配任何 `provider_id` 或没有前缀，返回 `None`

**e) 移除 `candidates_for_model()` 方法**：不再需要前缀匹配。

**f) 更新测试**：重写所有测试以匹配新的路由逻辑。

### 3. Rust: 更新 handlers 调用方

**openai.rs**（`handle_chat_completions` ~line 150）：
\```rust
let selection = router.select(&openai_req.model, None);
if let Some(sel) = selection {

# 供应商路由ID：基于 `provider_id/model_name` 的供应商路由

## 背景

当前供应商路由依赖 `model_prefixes` 前缀匹配。用户希望改为基于 `provider_id` 的路由方案：
- 每个供应商配置一个 `provider_id`（10 字符以内，字母数字组合，首字符不能是数字）
- 请求时模型名格式为 `provider_id/model_name`（如 `g/gemini-2.5-pro`）
- 有 `provider_id/` 前缀：精确路由到对应供应商，去掉前缀后用原始模型名
- **没有** `provider_id/` 前缀：选择**默认供应商**（优先级最高的 exclusive > pooled > fallback，优先级相同时取顺序第一个）
- 去掉前缀后的模型名用于后续 LLM 会话和供应商内部 `model_mapping` 转换

## 核心流程

\```
请求 model = "g/gemini-2.5-pro"
    |
    v
ProviderRouter.select()
    ├─ 提取 "g/" → 查 provider_id_index → 找到供应商
    ├─ 去掉 "g/" → "gemini-2.5-pro"
    └─ 返回 (provider, "gemini-2.5-pro")
         |
         v
handler 用 "gemini-2.5-pro" 调用转发函数

请求 model = "gemini-2.5-pro"（无前缀）
    |
    v
ProviderRouter.select()
    ├─ 无 provider_id 前缀 → 走默认供应商选择
    ├─ 优先级排序：exclusive(最高) > pooled > fallback
    ├─ 优先级相同时取配置顺序第一个
    └─ 返回 (default_provider, "gemini-2.5-pro")
\```

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::sync::Arc;

use crate::proxy::config::{
    is_valid_provider_id, ProviderDispatchMode, ProviderModelDefaults, ProviderProtocol,
    UpstreamProvider, ZaiConfig,
};

/// Result of provider selection, including the resolved model name
/// (with provider_id/ prefix stripped if applicable).
pub struct ProviderSelection<'a> {
    pub provider: &'a UpstreamProvider,
    /// The model name to use when forwarding (prefix stripped if provider_id routing was used).
    pub resolved_model: String,
}

/// Routes incoming requests to the appropriate upstream provider.
pub struct ProviderRouter {
    providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>,
    rr_counter: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
    /// Index of provider_id -> provider index for O(1) lookups.
    provider_id_index: HashMap<String, usize>,
}

impl ProviderRouter {
    /// Build from config. If `providers` is empty, optionally migrate from legacy z.ai config.
    pub fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self {
        let enabled: Vec<_> = providers.into_iter().filter(|p| p.enabled).collect();

        if enabled.is_empty() {
            if let Some(zai) = legacy_zai {
                if zai.enabled && zai.dispatch_mode != crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
                    return Self::from_zai_config(zai);
                }
            }
        }

        // Build provider_id index, validate format and uniqueness
        let mut provider_id_index: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
        let mut seen_ids: std::collections::HashSet<String> = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        for (i, p) in enabled.iter().enumerate() {
            if let Some(ref pid) = p.provider_id {
                if !is_valid_provider_id(pid) {
                    tracing::warn!(
                        "[ProviderRouter] Invalid provider_id format: '{}' (provider: '{}'). \
                         Must be 1-10 alphanumeric chars, starting with a letter.",
                        pid, p.name
                    );
                    continue;
                }
                if !seen_ids.insert(pid.clone()) {
                    tracing::error!(
                        "[ProviderRouter] Duplicate provider_id: '{}' (provider: '{}'). \
                         This provider will not be routable by provider_id.",
                        pid, p.name
                    );
                    provider_id_index.remove(pid);
                    continue;
                }
                provider_id_index.insert(pid.clone(), i);
            }
        }

        Self {
            providers: enabled,
            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
            provider_id_index,
        }
    }

    /// Build a single-provider router from legacy z.ai configuration.
    fn from_zai_config(zai: &ZaiConfig) -> Self {
        let dispatch_mode = match zai.dispatch_mode {
            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Exclusive => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Pooled => ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled,
            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback => ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback,
        };

        let provider = UpstreamProvider {
            name: "z.ai".to_string(),
            provider_id: None,
            enabled: true,
            base_url: zai.base_url.clone(),
            api_key: zai.api_key.clone(),
            protocol: ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough,
            dispatch_mode,
            priority: 0,
            model_prefixes: Vec::new(),
            model_mapping: zai.model_mapping.clone(),
            default_models: ProviderModelDefaults {
                opus: zai.models.opus.clone(),
                sonnet: zai.models.sonnet.clone(),
                haiku: zai.models.haiku.clone(),
            },
            request_timeout_secs: None,
        };

        Self {
            providers: vec![provider],
            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
            provider_id_index: Default::default(),
        }
    }

    /// If `model` starts with a registered `provider_id/`, return `(provider_id, rest)`.
    fn extract_provider_id_prefix(&self, model: &str) -> Option<(&str, &str)> {
        if let Some(slash_pos) = model.find('/') {
            let candidate = &model[..slash_pos];
            if self.provider_id_index.contains_key(candidate) {
                let rest = &model[slash_pos + 1..];
                if !rest.is_empty() {
                    return Some((candidate, rest));
                }
            }
        }
        None
    }

    /// Select the next provider for the given model.
    /// `prev_failed` excludes a provider that just failed, triggering fallback.
    ///
    /// Routing priority:
    /// 1. If model starts with a registered `provider_id/`, route directly to that provider.
    /// 2. Otherwise, select the default provider:
    ///    - Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority, then config order)
    ///    - Pooled providers next (sorted by priority, then RR)
    ///    - Fallback providers last (sorted by priority, then config order)
    pub fn select(
        &self,
        model: &str,
        prev_failed: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Option<ProviderSelection<'_>> {
        // STEP 1: Check for provider_id/ prefix routing (highest priority)
        if let Some((pid, rest)) = self.extract_provider_id_prefix(model) {
            if let Some(&idx) = self.provider_id_index.get(pid) {
                let provider = &self.providers[idx];
                if prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| provider.name != pf) {
                    return Some(ProviderSelection {
                        provider,
                        resolved_model: rest.to_string(),
                    });
                }
            }
            // provider_id matched but provider failed; fall through to default selection
        }

        // STEP 2: Default provider selection (no provider_id prefix or prefix not found)
        let candidates: Vec<_> = self
            .providers
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .filter(|(_, p)| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
            .collect();

        if candidates.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }

        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority, stable sort preserves config order)
        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, p)| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
            .copied()
            .collect();
        exclusive.sort_by_key(|(_, p)| p.priority);
        if let Some((_, p)) = exclusive.first() {
            return Some(ProviderSelection {
                provider: *p,
                resolved_model: model.to_string(),
            });
        }

        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, p)| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
            .copied()
            .collect();
        if !pooled.is_empty() {
            pooled.sort_by_key(|(_, p)| p.priority);
            // Group by priority, RR within same priority group
            if let Some(&(_, first)) = pooled.first() {
                let top_priority = first.priority;
                let same_priority: Vec<_> = pooled
                    .into_iter()
                    .filter(|(_, p)| p.priority == top_priority)
                    .collect();
                let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % same_priority.len();
                return Some(ProviderSelection {
                    provider: same_priority[idx].1,
                    resolved_model: model.to_string(),
                });
            }
        }

        // 3. Fallback providers
        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, p)| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
            .copied()
            .collect();
        fallback.sort_by_key(|(_, p)| p.priority);
        fallback.first().map(|(_, p)| ProviderSelection {
            provider: *p,
            resolved_model: model.to_string(),
        })
    }

    /// Map incoming model name to the provider's native model ID.
    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String {
        // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.get(incoming) {
            return mapped.clone();
        }
        // 2. Prefix match in model_mapping
        let m = incoming.to_lowercase();
        if let Some((_, mapped)) = provider
            .model_mapping
            .iter()
            .find(|(k, _)| m.starts_with(k.as_str()))
        {
            return mapped.clone();
        }
        // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
        if m.starts_with("zai:") {
            return incoming[4..].to_string();
        }
        // 4. Pass through glm-* models
        if m.starts_with("glm-") {
            return incoming.to_string();
        }
        // 5. Family defaults for Claude models
        if m.starts_with("claude-") {
            if m.contains("opus") {
                return provider.default_models.opus.clone();
            }
            if m.contains("haiku") {
                return provider.default_models.haiku.clone();
            }
            return provider.default_models.sonnet.clone();
        }
        // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
        incoming.to_string()
    }

    /// Check if the router has any enabled providers.
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.providers.is_empty()
    }
}

/// Map a model name to the provider's expected model name.
/// This is a free function so it can be used without holding a `ProviderRouter` lock.
pub fn map_model_for_provider(
    original: &str,
    model_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
    default_models: &ProviderModelDefaults,
) -> String {
    // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(original) {
        return mapped.clone();
    }
    // 2. Lowercase match
    let m = original.to_lowercase();
    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(&m) {
        return mapped.clone();
    }
    // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
        return original[4..].to_string();
    }
    // 4. Pass through glm-* models
    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
        return original.to_string();
    }
    // 5. Claude family defaults
    if m.starts_with("claude-") {
        if m.contains("opus") {
            return default_models.opus.clone();
        }
        if m.contains("haiku") {
            return default_models.haiku.clone();
        }
        return default_models.sonnet.clone();
    }
    // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
    original.to_string()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn make_test_provider(
        name: &str,
        dispatch_mode: ProviderDispatchMode,
        priority: u8,
        provider_id: Option<&str>,
    ) -> UpstreamProvider {
        UpstreamProvider {
            name: name.to_string(),
            provider_id: provider_id.map(String::from),
            enabled: true,
            base_url: "https://example.com".to_string(),
            api_key: "test-key".to_string(),
            protocol: ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough,
            dispatch_mode,
            priority,
            model_prefixes: Default::default(),
            model_mapping: Default::default(),
            default_models: ProviderModelDefaults::default(),
            request_timeout_secs: None,
        }
    }

    fn build_router_with_providers(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>) -> ProviderRouter {
        let mut provider_id_index: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
        for (i, p) in providers.iter().enumerate() {
            if let Some(ref pid) = p.provider_id {
                provider_id_index.insert(pid.clone(), i);
            }
        }
        ProviderRouter {
            providers,
            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
            provider_id_index,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_select_exclusive() {
        let router = build_router_with_providers(vec![
            make_test_provider("A", ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive, 1, Some("a")),
            make_test_provider("B", ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled, 0, Some("b")),
        ]);

        let sel = router.select("any-model", None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(sel.provider.name, "A"); // Exclusive wins over Pooled
        assert_eq!(sel.resolved_model, "any-model");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_select_by_provider_id() {
        let p1 = make_test_provider("google", ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive, 0, Some("g"));
        let p2 = make_test_provider("anthropic", ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive, 0, Some("a"));

        let router = build_router_with_providers(vec![p1.clone(), p2.clone()]);

        // Direct provider_id routing
        let sel = router.select("g/gemini-2.5-pro", None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(sel.provider.name, "google");
        assert_eq!(sel.resolved_model, "gemini-2.5-pro");

        let sel = router.select("a/claude-sonnet-4-6", None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(sel.provider.name, "anthropic");
        assert_eq!(sel.resolved_model, "claude-sonnet-4-6");

        // No prefix -> default selection (exclusive, lowest priority first)
        // Both have priority 0, so config order first -> google
        let sel = router.select("gemini-2.5-pro", None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(sel.provider.name, "google");
        assert_eq!(sel.resolved_model, "gemini-2.5-pro");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_provider_id_prefix_stripping() {
        let p = make_test_provider("google", ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled, 0, Some("g"));
        let router = build_router_with_providers(vec![p]);

        let sel = router.select("g/gemini-2.5-flash", None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(sel.provider.name, "google");
        assert_eq!(sel.resolved_model, "gemini-2.5-flash");

        // Unknown provider_id -> default selection
        let sel = router.select("x/unknown-model", None);
        assert!(sel.is_some()); // Falls through to default (the only pooled provider)
        assert_eq!(sel.unwrap().provider.name, "google");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_default_selection_priority() {
        // Exclusive > Pooled > Fallback
        let router = build_router_with_providers(vec![
            make_test_provider("fallback", ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback, 0, Some("f")),
            make_test_provider("pooled", ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled, 0, Some("p")),
            make_test_provider("exclusive", ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive, 0, Some("e")),
        ]);

        let sel = router.select("any-model", None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(sel.provider.name, "exclusive");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_priority_ordering() {
        // Higher priority number = lower priority (lower number wins)
        let router = build_router_with_providers(vec![
            make_test_provider("low", ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive, 5, Some("l")),
            make_test_provider("high", ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive, 1, Some("h")),
        ]);

        let sel = router.select("any-model", None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(sel.provider.name, "high");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_map_model_claude_family() {
        let provider = make_test_provider("test", ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive, 0, None);
        let router = build_router_with_providers(vec![provider.clone()]);

        assert_eq!(router.map_model(&provider, "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"), "glm-4.7");
        assert_eq!(router.map_model(&provider, "claude-opus-4-20250514"), "glm-4.7");
        assert_eq!(router.map_model(&provider, "claude-haiku-4-20250514"), "glm-4.5-air");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_from_zai_config() {
        let zai = ZaiConfig {
            enabled: true,
            base_url: "https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic".to_string(),
            api_key: "zai-key".to_string(),
            dispatch_mode: crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback,
            model_mapping: Default::default(),
            models: ZaiModelDefaults::default(),
            mcp: Default::default(),
        };

        let router = ProviderRouter::new(vec![], Some(&zai));
        assert!(!router.is_empty());

        let sel = router.select("claude-sonnet-4-20250514", None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(sel.provider.name, "z.ai");
        assert_eq!(sel.provider.base_url, "https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_is_valid_provider_id() {
        assert!(is_valid_provider_id("g"));
        assert!(is_valid_provider_id("google"));
        assert!(is_valid_provider_id("g1"));
        assert!(is_valid_provider_id("abc123"));
        assert!(is_valid_provider_id("a1b2c3d4e5")); // 10 chars

        assert!(!is_valid_provider_id("")); // empty
        assert!(!is_valid_provider_id("1a")); // starts with digit
        assert!(!is_valid_provider_id("a1b2c3d4e56")); // 11 chars
        assert!(!is_valid_provider_id("a-b")); // hyphen not allowed
        assert!(!is_valid_provider_id("a_b")); // underscore not allowed
    }
}

592	    const handleModalConfirm = async (values: UpstreamProvider, mappings: { from: string; to: string }[]) => {

## Route Manager Page and Model Mapping Functionality -- Full Analysis

### 1. Route Manager Page Overview

**File**: `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/RouteManager.tsx`

The `RouteManager` component is a comprehensive page that manages model routing, including:

- **Preset management** (lines 78-148): Four built-in presets (`default`, `performance`, `cost-effective`, `balanced`) plus user-defined custom presets stored in `localStorage` under key `antigravity_custom_presets` (lines 64-75, 155-163).
- **Background task model config** (lines 597-633): A special `internal-background-task` mapping with its own `GroupedSelect`.
- **Custom mapping CRUD** (lines 636-763): The core mapping list, edit, and add form.
- **Account scheduling** (lines 767+): CacheFirst/Balance/PerformanceFirst modes, max wait slider, fixed account mode.

### 2. How Mappings Are Created and Edited (UI)

There are three UI pathways for managing mappings:

#### A. Add New Mapping (lines 721-762)
A form at the bottom of the mapping section:
- **Source model input**: Plain `<input>` with id `custom-key` (line 729-733), accepting free text like `gpt-4` or `gpt-4*` (wildcard supported).
- **Target model selector**: A `GroupedSelect` dropdown (line 736-743) populated with `customMappingOptions`.
- **Submit button**: Reads the input value via `document.getElementById('custom-key')`, calls `handleMappingUpdate('custom', k, v)` (lines 748-756).

#### B. Edit Existing Mapping (lines 653-692)
Each existing mapping row in the list shows `source -> target`. Clicking the target text (line 665-667) or the edit button (lines 695-700) enters edit mode:
- The target text is replaced by an inline `GroupedSelect` (lines 655-662) with `allowCustomInput={true}`.
- Save/Cancel buttons appear (lines 673-692).
- On save, `handleMappingUpdate('custom', key, editingValue)` is called (line 677).

#### C. Delete Mapping (lines 702-708)
A trash icon button calls `handleRemoveCustomMapping(key)` which deletes the entry from the map and invokes the backend.

### 3. Target Model Selection -- The GroupedSelect Component

**File**: `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/components/common/GroupedSelect.tsx`

This is a custom portal-based dropdown component (rendered via `createPortal` to `document.body` at line 150). Key features:

- **Grouped options**: Options are grouped by their `group` property and displayed with sticky section headers (lines 168-198).
- **Custom input support**: When `allowCustomInput={true}`, a text input appears at the bottom of the dropdown (lines 202-243) allowing arbitrary model IDs to be typed and submitted via Enter key or the "确定" button.
- **Position tracking**: Dynamically positions itself relative to the trigger button (lines 54-63, 66-90).

**The options source** (`customMappingOptions`) is computed in RouteManager.tsx lines 55-61:
```typescript
const customMappingOptions: SelectOption[] = useMemo(() => {
    return models.map(model => ({
        value: model.id,
        label: `${model.id} (${model.name})`,
        group: model.group || 'Other'
    }));
}, [models]);
```

### 4. Where Model Options Come From (The `models` Data Source)

**File**: `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/hooks/useProxyModels.tsx`

The `useProxyModels` hook assembles the model list from two sources:

1. **Dynamic models from accounts** (lines 20-60): Collects `account.quota.models` from all accounts (via `useAccountStore`), deduplicates by lowercase name, and matches against `MODEL_CONFIG` for icons/grouping.

2. **Static fallback from `MODEL_CONFIG`** (lines 63-86): For models defined in the config but not returned by any account, adds them as static entries.

**File**: `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/config/modelConfig.ts`

`MODEL_CONFIG` is a `Record<string, ModelConfig>` defining known models (lines 29-178) including:
- Gemini 3.x series: `gemini-3.1-pro-high`, `gemini-3-flash`, `gemini-3-pro-image`, etc.
- Gemini 2.5 series: `gemini-2.5-flash`, `gemini-2.5-pro`, etc.
- Claude series: `claude-sonnet-4-6`, `claude-sonnet-4-6-thinking`, `claude-opus-4-6-thinking`

Each entry has `label`, `shortLabel`, `protectedKey`, `Icon`, `group`, and `tags`.

### 5. Data Flow: Frontend to Backend

The full data flow for mapping changes:

#### Step 1: Frontend invokes Tauri command
**File**: `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/pages/RouteManager.tsx`, lines 221-233
```typescript
const handleMappingUpdate = async (_type: 'custom', key: string, value: string) => {
    const newConfig = { ...appConfig.proxy };
    newConfig.custom_mapping = { ...(newConfig.custom_mapping || {}), [key]: value };
    await invoke('update_model_mapping', { config: newConfig });
    setAppConfig({ ...appConfig, proxy: newConfig });
};
```

#### Step 2: Tauri command receives and processes
**File**: `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/commands/proxy.rs`, lines 495-514
```rust
pub async fn update_model_mapping(
    config: ProxyConfig,
    state: State<'_, ProxyServiceState>,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let instance_lock = state.instance.read().await;
    if let Some(instance) = instance_lock.as_ref() {
        instance.axum_server.update_mapping(&config).await;  // Hot-update running server
    }
    // Save to persistent config
    let mut app_config = crate::modules::config::load_app_config().map_err(|e| e)?;
    app_config.proxy.custom_mapping = config.custom_mapping;
    crate::modules::config::save_app_config(&app_config).map_err(|e| e)?;
    Ok(())
}
```

#### Step 3: Running Axum server updates in-memory mapping
**File**: `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/server.rs`, lines 1331-1335
```rust
let mut mapping = state.custom_mapping.write().await;
*mapping = new_config.clone().proxy.custom_mapping;
```

The `custom_mapping` is stored as `Arc<tokio::sync::RwLock<HashMap<String, String>>>` (line 95 of server.rs).

#### Step 4: Request handlers use the mapping at runtime
The `resolve_model_route` function in **`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/common/model_mapping.rs`** (lines 253-299) is called by handlers (openai.rs line 215, gemini.rs line 129, claude.rs line 610, common.rs line 163) with the live `custom_mapping` HashMap. The resolution priority is:
1. Dynamic API forwarding rules (`DYNAMIC_MODEL_FORWARDING_RULES`)
2. Exact match in `custom_mapping`
3. Wildcard match in `custom_mapping` (most specific pattern wins)
4. System default mapping (`map_claude_model_to_gemini`)

## 4. How provider configs are stored and loaded

**Storage flow:**

1. **Frontend store** -- `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/stores/useConfigStore.ts`
   - `loadConfig()` calls `configService.loadConfig()` (line 30)
   - `saveConfig(config)` calls `configService.saveConfig(config)` (line 40)

2. **Service layer** -- `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src/services/configService.ts`
   - `loadConfig()` invokes Tauri command `'load_config'` (line 5)
   - `saveConfig(config)` invokes Tauri command `'save_config', { config }` (line 9)

3. **Rust backend** -- `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/modules/config.rs`
   - `load_app_config()` (line 11): reads from `gui_config.json` in the app data directory. If the file does not exist, creates a default `AppConfig` and persists it. Includes migration logic for legacy fields.
   - `save_app_config()` (line 90): serializes `AppConfig` to pretty-printed JSON and writes to `gui_config.json`.
   - Config file path: `{data_dir}/gui_config.json` (line 8)

4. **Provider persistence**: Providers are stored as `config.proxy.providers` -- a `Vec<UpstreamProvider>` in the Rust `ProxyConfig` struct (line 625 of `config.rs`), which is part of the `AppConfig` that gets serialized to `gui_config.json`.

**In-memory access**: On the Rust side, the providers are accessed via the `ProxyConfig` struct and used by the proxy server (`src/proxy/server.rs`) for request routing.

349	/// Validate that a provider_id matches the allowed format:
350	/// 1-10 chars, alphanumeric, first char must be a letter.
351	pub fn is_valid_provider_id(id: &str) -> bool {
352	    !id.is_empty()
353	        && id.len() <= 10
354	        && id.chars().next().map_or(false, |c| c.is_ascii_alphabetic())
355	        && id.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric())
356	}

73	            if (!isClickInsideContainer && !isClickInsideDropdown) {
74	                setIsOpen(false);

77

83	        }
84	
85	        return () => {
86	            document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
87	            window.removeEventListener('scroll', updateDropdownPosition, true);
88	            window.removeEventListener('resize', updateDropdownPosition);
89	        };
90	    }, [isOpen]);

94	        onChange(optionValue);

190	};
191	
192	/**
193	 * 模型排序权重配置
194	 * 数字越小，优先级越高
195	 */
196	const MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS = {
197	    // 系列权重 (第一优先级)
198	    series: {
199	        'gemini-3': 100,
200	        'gemini-2.5': 200,
201	        'gemini-2': 300,
202	        'claude': 400,
203	    },
204	    // 性能级别权重 (第二优先级)
205	    tier: {
206	        'pro': 10,
207	        'flash': 20,
208	        'lite': 30,
209	        'opus': 5,
210	        'sonnet': 10,
211	    },
212	    // 特殊后缀权重 (第三优先级)
213	    suffix: {
214	        'thinking': 1,
215	        'image': 2,
216	        'high': 0,
217	        'low': 3,
218	    }
219	};
220	
221	/**
222	 * 获取模型的排序权重
223	 */
224	function getModelSortWeight(modelId: string): number {
225	    const id = modelId.toLowerCase();
226	    let weight = 0;
227	
228	    // 1. 系列权重 (x1000)
229	    if (id.startsWith('gemini-3')) {
230	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.series['gemini-3'] * 1000;
231	    } else if (id.startsWith('gemini-2.5')) {
232	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.series['gemini-2.5'] * 1000;
233	    } else if (id.startsWith('gemini-2')) {
234	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.series['gemini-2'] * 1000;
235	    } else if (id.startsWith('claude')) {
236	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.series['claude'] * 1000;
237	    }
238	
239	    // 2. 性能级别权重 (x100)
240	    if (id.includes('pro')) {
241	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.tier['pro'] * 100;
242	    } else if (id.includes('flash')) {
243	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.tier['flash'] * 100;
244	    } else if (id.includes('lite')) {
245	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.tier['lite'] * 100;
246	    } else if (id.includes('opus')) {
247	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.tier['opus'] * 100;
248	    } else if (id.includes('sonnet')) {
249	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.tier['sonnet'] * 100;
250	    }
251	
252	    // 3. 特殊后缀权重 (x10)
253	    if (id.includes('thinking')) {
254	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.suffix['thinking'] * 10;
255	    } else if (id.includes('image')) {
256	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.suffix['image'] * 10;
257	    } else if (id.includes('high')) {
258	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.suffix['high'] * 10;
259	    } else if (id.includes('low')) {
260	        weight += MODEL_SORT_WEIGHTS.suffix['low'] * 10;
261	    }
262	
263	    return weight;
264	}
265	
266	/**
267	 * 对模型列表进行排序
268	 * @param models 模型列表
269	 * @returns 排序后的模型列表
270	 */
271	export function sortModels<T extends { id: string }>(models: T[]): T[] {
272	    return [...models].sort((a, b) => {
273	        const weightA = getModelSortWeight(a.id);
274	        const weightB = getModelSortWeight(b.id);
275	
276	        // 按权重升序排序
277	        if (weightA !== weightB) {
278	            return weightA - weightB;
279	        }
280	
281	        // 权重相同时，按字母顺序排序
282	        return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
283	    });
284	}
