123	/// 执行版本命令（Windows 特殊处理 .cmd/.bat）
124	#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
125	fn run_version_command(executable_path: &PathBuf) -> Option<String> {
126	    // 安全校验：验证路径不包含危险字符
127	    if !is_safe_path(executable_path) {
128	        return None;
129	    }
130	
131	    let output = if is_cmd_file(executable_path) {
132	        // 使用引号包裹路径防止注入，使用 /S 开关确保安全解析
133	        let quoted_path = format!("\"{}\"", executable_path.to_string_lossy());
134	        Command::new("cmd.exe")
135	            .arg("/C")
136	            .arg(&quoted_path)
137	            .arg("--version")
138	            .creation_flags(CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
139	            .output()
140	    } else {
141	        let mut cmd = Command::new(executable_path);
142	        cmd.arg("--version");
143	        cmd.creation_flags(CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
144	        cmd.output()
145	    };
146	
147	    match output {
148	        Ok(out) if out.status.success() => {
149	            let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
150	            // 使用正则提取版本号（更精确）
151	            extract_version(&s)
152	        }
153	        _ => None,
154	    }
155	}
156	
157	/// 提取版本号（使用更精确的 semver 匹配）
158	fn extract_version(s: &str) -> Option<String> {
159	    // 匹配 semver 格式: x.y.z 或 x.y
160	    let re = regex::Regex::new(r"(\d+\.\d+(?:\.\d+)?)").ok()?;
161	    re.captures(s)
162	        .and_then(|caps| caps.get(1))
163	        .map(|m| m.as_str().to_string())
164	}

259	/// 检测 CLI 是否安装并获取版本
260	pub fn check_cli_installed(app: &CliApp) -> (bool, Option<String>) {
261	    let cmd = app.as_str();
262	    // 默认使用命令名，如果 fallback 找到路径则更新为绝对路径
263	    let mut executable_path = PathBuf::from(cmd);
264	    
265	    // 1. 优先使用 which/where 检测 (遵循 PATH)
266	    let which_output = if cfg!(target_os = "windows") {
267	        let mut c = Command::new("where");
268	        c.arg(cmd);
269	        #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
270	        c.creation_flags(CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
271	        c.output()
272	    } else {
273	        Command::new("which").arg(cmd).output()
274	    };
275	
276	    let mut installed = match &which_output {
277	        Ok(out) => out.status.success(),
278	        Err(_) => false,
279	    };
280	
281	    #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
282	    if installed {
283	        if let Ok(out) = &which_output {
284	            if let Some(found_path) = parse_where_output(&out.stdout) {
285	                executable_path = found_path;
286	            }
287	        }
288	    }
289	
290	    #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
291	    if !installed {
292	        if let Some(found_path) = scan_windows_cli_paths(cmd) {
293	            installed = true;
294	            executable_path = found_path;
295	        }
296	    }
297	
298	    // [FIX #765] macOS 增强检测: 如果 which 失败,显式搜索常用二进制路径
299	    // 解决 Tauri 进程 PATH 可能不完整导致检测不到已安装 CLI 的问题
300	    if !installed && !cfg!(target_os = "windows") {
301	        let home = dirs::home_dir().unwrap_or_default();
302	        let mut common_paths = vec![
303	            home.join(".local/bin"),
304	            home.join(".bun/bin"),
305	            home.join(".bun/install/global/node_modules/.bin"),
306	            home.join(".npm-global/bin"),
307	            home.join(".volta/bin"),
308	            home.join("bin"),
309	            PathBuf::from("/opt/homebrew/bin"),
310	            PathBuf::from("/usr/local/bin"),
311	            PathBuf::from("/usr/bin"),
312	        ];
313	
314	        // 增强：扫描 nvm 目录下的所有 node 版本
315	        let nvm_base = home.join(".nvm/versions/node");
316	        if nvm_base.exists() {
317	            if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&nvm_base) {
318	                for entry in entries.flatten() {
319	                    let bin_path = entry.path().join("bin");
320	                    if bin_path.exists() {
321	                        common_paths.push(bin_path);
322	                    }
323	                }
324	            }
325	        }
326	
327	        for path in common_paths {
328	            let full_path = path.join(cmd);
329	            if full_path.exists() {
330	                tracing::debug!("[CLI-Sync] Detected {} via explicit path: {:?}", cmd, full_path);
331	                installed = true;
332	                executable_path = full_path;
333	                break;
334	            }
335	        }
336	    }
337	
338	    if !installed {
339	        return (false, None);
340	    }
341	
342	    // 2. 获取版本（Windows 使用特殊处理 .cmd/.bat）
343	    #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
344	    let version = run_version_command(&executable_path);
345	
346	    #[cfg(not(target_os = "windows"))]
347	    let version = {
348	        let mut ver_cmd = Command::new(&executable_path);
349	        ver_cmd.arg("--version");
350	        let version_output = ver_cmd.output();
351	        match version_output {
352	            Ok(out) if out.status.success() => {
353	                let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
354	                let cleaned = s.split(|c: char| !c.is_numeric() && c != '.')
355	                    .filter(|part| !part.is_empty())
356	                    .last()
357	                    .map(|p| p.trim())
358	                    .unwrap_or(&s)
359	                    .to_string();
360	                Some(cleaned)
361	            }
362	            _ => None,
363	        }
364	    };
365	
366	    (true, version)
367	}

369	/// 读取当前配置并检测同步状态
370	pub fn get_sync_status(app: &CliApp, proxy_url: &str) -> (bool, bool, Option<String>) {
371	    let files = app.config_files();
372	    if files.is_empty() {
373	        return (false, false, None);
374	    }
375	
376	    let mut all_synced = true;
377	    let mut has_backup = false;
378	    let mut current_base_url = None;
379	
380	    for file in &files {
381	        // 使用更简单的命名规则: original_name + .antigravity.bak
382	        let backup_path = file.path.with_file_name(format!("{}.antigravity.bak", file.name));
383	        
384	        if backup_path.exists() {
385	            has_backup = true;
386	        }
387	
388	        // 如果物理文件不存在
389	        // 如果物理文件不存在
390	        if !file.path.exists() {
391	            // Gemini 的 settings.json/config.json 只要有一个存在即可，或者都不存在（视为未同步）
392	            if app == &CliApp::Gemini && (file.name == "settings.json" || file.name == "config.json") {
393	                continue; 
394	            }
395	            all_synced = false;
396	            continue;
397	        }
398	
399	        let content = match fs::read_to_string(&file.path) {
400	            Ok(c) => c,
401	            Err(_) => {
402	                all_synced = false;
403	                continue;
404	            }
405	        };
406	
407	        match app {
408	            CliApp::Claude => {
409	                if file.name == "settings.json" {
410	                    let json: Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or_default();
411	                    let url = json.get("env").and_then(|e| e.get("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL")).and_then(|v| v.as_str());
412	                    if let Some(u) = url {
413	                        current_base_url = Some(u.to_string());
414	                        if u.trim_end_matches('/') != proxy_url.trim_end_matches('/') {
415	                            all_synced = false;
416	                        }
417	                    } else {
418	                        all_synced = false;
419	                    }
420	                } else if file.name == ".claude.json" {
421	                    let json: Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or_default();
422	                    if json.get("hasCompletedOnboarding") != Some(&Value::Bool(true)) {
423	                        all_synced = false;
424	                    }
425	                }
426	            }
427	            CliApp::Codex => {
428	                if file.name == "config.toml" {
429	                    // 正则匹配 base_url
430	                    let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"(?m)^\s*base_url\s*=\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]"#).unwrap();
431	                    if let Some(caps) = re.captures(&content) {
432	                        let url = &caps[1];
433	                        current_base_url = Some(url.to_string());
434	                        if url.trim_end_matches('/') != proxy_url.trim_end_matches('/') {
435	                            all_synced = false;
436	                        }
437	                    } else {
438	                        all_synced = false;
439	                    }
440	                }
441	            }
442	            CliApp::Gemini => {
443	                if file.name == ".env" {
444	                    let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"(?m)^GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL=(.*)$"#).unwrap();
445	                    if let Some(caps) = re.captures(&content) {
446	                        let url = caps[1].trim();
447	                        current_base_url = Some(url.to_string());
448	                        if url.trim_end_matches('/') != proxy_url.trim_end_matches('/') {
449	                            all_synced = false;
450	                        }
451	                    } else {
452	                        all_synced = false;
453	                    }
454	                }
455	            }
456	            CliApp::OpenCode => {
457	                if file.name == "config.json" {
458	                    let json: Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or_default();
459	                    let url = json.get("providers")
460	                        .and_then(|p| p.get("openai"))
461	                        .and_then(|o| o.get("baseURL"))
462	                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str());
463	                    if let Some(u) = url {
464	                        current_base_url = Some(u.to_string());
465	                        if u.trim_end_matches('/') != proxy_url.trim_end_matches('/') {
466	                            all_synced = false;
467	                        }
468	                    } else {
469	                        all_synced = false;
470	                    }
471	                }
472	            }
473	        }
474	    }
475	
476	    (all_synced, has_backup, current_base_url)
477	}

479	/// 执行同步逻辑
480	pub fn sync_config(app: &CliApp, proxy_url: &str, api_key: &str, model: Option<&str>) -> Result<(), String> {
481	    let files = app.config_files();
482	    
483	    for file in &files {
484	        // Gemini 兼容性逻辑：优先使用 settings.json
485	        if app == &CliApp::Gemini && file.name == "config.json" && !file.path.exists() {
486	            let settings_path = file.path.with_file_name("settings.json");
487	            if settings_path.exists() {
488	                continue; 
489	            }
490	        }
491	
492	        if let Some(parent) = file.path.parent() {
493	            fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| format!("无法创建目录: {}", e))?;
494	        }
495	
496	        // [New Feature] 自动备份：如果文件存在且没有备份，创建 .antigravity.bak 备份
497	        // 这样可以保留用户最初的配置，后续多次同步不会覆盖这个备份
498	        if file.path.exists() {
499	            let backup_path = file.path.with_file_name(format!("{}.antigravity.bak", file.name));
500	            if !backup_path.exists() {
501	                if let Err(e) = fs::copy(&file.path, &backup_path) {
502	                    tracing::warn!("Failed to create backup for {}: {}", file.name, e);
503	                } else {
504	                    tracing::info!("Created backup for {}: {:?}", file.name, backup_path);
505	                }
506	            }
507	        }
508	
509	        let mut content = if file.path.exists() {
510	            fs::read_to_string(&file.path).unwrap_or_default()
511	        } else {
512	            String::new()
513	        };
514	
515	        match app {
516	            CliApp::Claude => {
517	                if file.name == ".claude.json" {
518	                    let mut json: Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or_else(|_| serde_json::json!({}));
519	                    if let Some(obj) = json.as_object_mut() {
520	                        obj.insert("hasCompletedOnboarding".to_string(), Value::Bool(true));
521	                    }
522	                    content = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&json).unwrap();
523	                } else if file.name == "settings.json" {
524	                    let mut json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or_else(|_| serde_json::json!({}));
525	                    if json.as_object().is_none() { json = serde_json::json!({}); }
526	                    let env = json.as_object_mut().unwrap().entry("env").or_insert(serde_json::json!({}));
527	                    if let Some(env_obj) = env.as_object_mut() {
528	                        env_obj.insert("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL".to_string(), Value::String(proxy_url.to_string()));
529	                        if !api_key.is_empty() {
530	                            env_obj.insert("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY".to_string(), Value::String(api_key.to_string()));
531	                            
532	                            // [FIX] 避免冲突：如果存在则移除 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
533	                            env_obj.remove("ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN");
534	
535	                            // [FIX] 清理可能来自其他 Provider 的模型覆盖设置
536	                            env_obj.remove("ANTHROPIC_MODEL");
537	                            env_obj.remove("ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL");
538	                            env_obj.remove("ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL");
539	                            env_obj.remove("ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL");
540	                        } else {
541	                            // 如果 API Key 为空，则移除该键，避免设置为空字符串
542	                            env_obj.remove("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY");
543	                        }
544	                    }
545

594	                    let mut found_key = false;

596	                        if line.starts_with("GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL=") {
597	                            *line = format!("GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL={}", proxy_url);
598	                            found_url = true;
599	                        } else if line.trim().starts_with("GEMINI_API_KEY=") {
600	                            *line = format!("GEMINI_API_KEY={}", api_key);
601	                            found_key = true;

604	                    if !found_url { lines.push(format!("GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL={}", proxy_url)); }
605	                    if !found_key { lines.push(format!("GEMINI_API_KEY={}", api_key)); }

617	                    }

621	                    if json.as_object().is_none() { json = serde_json::json!({}); }
622	                    let sec = json.as_object_mut().unwrap().entry("security").or_insert(serde_json::json!({}));

632	                    let mut json: Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or_else(|_| serde_json::json!({}));
633	                    if json.as_object().is_none() { json = serde_json::json!({}); }
634	                    let providers = json.as_object_mut().unwrap().entry("providers").or_insert(serde_json::json!({}));
635	                    let openai = providers.as_object_mut().unwrap().entry("openai").or_insert(serde_json::json!({}));

651	    }
652	
653	    Ok(())
654	}

674	    })

682	#[tauri::command]
683	pub async fn execute_cli_restore(app_type: CliApp) -> Result<(), String> {
684	    let files = app_type.config_files();
685	    let mut restored_count = 0;
686	
687	    // 尝试从备份恢复
688	    for file in &files {
689	        let backup_path = file.path.with_file_name(format!("{}.antigravity.bak", file.name));
690	        if backup_path.exists() {
691	            // 还原：覆盖原文件
692	            if let Err(e) = fs::rename(&backup_path, &file.path) {
693	                return Err(format!("恢复备份失败 {}: {}", file.name, e));
694	            }
695	            restored_count += 1;
696	        }
697	    }
698	
699	    if restored_count > 0 {
700	        // 如果成功恢复了至少一个备份，就认为是恢复成功
701	        return Ok(());
702	    }
703	
704	    // 如果没有备份，则执行原来的逻辑：恢复为默认配置
705	    let default_url = app_type.default_url();
706	    // 恢复默认时清空 API Key，让用户重新授权或使用官方 Key
707	    sync_config(&app_type, default_url, "", None)
708	}

711	pub async fn get_cli_config_content(app_type: CliApp, file_name: Option<String>) -> Result<String, String> {
712	    let files = app_type.config_files();
713	    let file = if let Some(name) = file_name {
714	        files.into_iter().find(|f| f.name == name).ok_or("找不到指定的文件".to_string())?
715	    } else {
716	        files.into_iter().next().ok_or("找不到配置文件".to_string())?
717	    };
718	
719	    if !file.path.exists() {
720	        return Err("配置文件不存在".to_string());
721	    }
722	    fs::read_to_string(&file.path).map_err(|e| format!("读取配置文件失败: {}", e))
723	}

78	fn increase_nofile_limit() {
79	    unsafe {
80	        let mut rl = libc::rlimit {
81	            rlim_cur: 0,
82	            rlim_max: 0,
83	        };
84	
85	        if libc::getrlimit(libc::RLIMIT_NOFILE, &mut rl) == 0 {
86	            info!("Current open file limit: soft={}, hard={}", rl.rlim_cur, rl.rlim_max);
87	
88	            // Attempt to increase to 4096 or maximum hard limit
89	            let target = 4096.min(rl.rlim_max);
90	            if rl.rlim_cur < target {
91	                rl.rlim_cur = target;
92	                if libc::setrlimit(libc::RLIMIT_NOFILE, &rl) == 0 {
93	                    info!("Successfully increased hard file limit to {}", target);
94	                } else {
95	                    warn!("Failed to increase file descriptor limit");
96	                }
97	            }
98	        }
99	    }
100	}

167	export async function request<T>(cmd: string, args?: any): Promise<T> {
168	  // 1. Tauri 环境：直接使用 invoke ...
169	  if (isTauri) {
170	    try {
171	      const { invoke } = await import('@tauri-apps/api/core');
172	      return await invoke<T>(cmd, args);
173	    } catch (error) {
174	      console.error(`Tauri Invoke Error [${cmd}]:`, error);
175	      throw error;
176	    }
177	  }
178	
179	  // 2. Web 环境：映射到 HTTP API
180	  const mapping = COMMAND_MAPPING[cmd];
181	  if (!mapping) {
182	    console.error(`Command [${cmd}] is not yet mapped for Web mode. Failing.`);
183	    throw new Error(`Command [${cmd}] not supported in Web mode.`);
184	  }
185	
186	  let url = mapping.url;
187	  // [FIX] 创建 args 副本，用于移除已使用的路径参数
188	  let bodyArgs = args ? { ...args } : undefined;
189	
190	  // 通用路径参数处理：替换 :key 为 args[key]
191	  if (args) {
192	    Object.keys(args).forEach(key => {
193	      const placeholder = `:${key}`;
194	      if (url.includes(placeholder)) {
195	        url = url.replace(placeholder, encodeURIComponent(String(args[key])));
196	        // [FIX] 从 body 参数中移除已用于路径的参数
197	        if (bodyArgs) {
198	          delete bodyArgs[key];
199	        }
200	      }
201	    });
202	  }
203	
204	  const apiKey = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? sessionStorage.getItem('abv_admin_api_key') : null;
205	
206	  const options: RequestInit = {
207	    method: mapping.method,
208	    headers: {
209	      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
210	      ...(apiKey ? {
211	        'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
212	        'x-api-key': apiKey
213	      } : {}),
214	    },
215	  };
216	
217	  if ((mapping.method === 'GET' || mapping.method === 'DELETE') && args) {
218	    const params = new URLSearchParams();
219	    Object.entries(args).forEach(([key, value]) => {
220	      // [FIX] 跳过已用于路径替换的参数
221	      if (url.includes(encodeURIComponent(String(value)))) return;
222	      if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
223	        params.append(key, String(value));
224	      }
225	    });
226	    const qs = params.toString();
227	    if (qs) url += `?${qs}`;
228	  } else if ((mapping.method === 'POST' || mapping.method === 'PATCH') && bodyArgs) {
229	    // [FIX] 如果有 request 包装，提取其内容作为 body
230	    const body = bodyArgs.request !== undefined ? bodyArgs.request : bodyArgs;
231	    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
232	  }
233	
234	  try {
235	    const response = await fetch(url, options);
236	    if (!response.ok) {
237	      if (!isTauri && response.status === 401) {
238	        // [FIX #1163] 增加防抖锁，避免重复事件导致 UI 抖动
239	        const now = Date.now();
240	        const lastAuthError = (window as any)._lastAuthErrorTime || 0;
241	        if (now - lastAuthError > 2000) {
242	          (window as any)._lastAuthErrorTime = now;
243	          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('abv-unauthorized'));
244	        }
245	      }
246	      const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
247	      throw errorData.error || `HTTP Error ${response.status}`;
248	    }
249	
250	    // 如果是 204 No Content，直接返回 null
251	    if (response.status === 204) {
252	      return null as unknown as T;
253	    }
254	
255	    const text = await response.text();
256	    if (!text) {
257	      return null as unknown as T;
258	    }
259	
260	    try {
261	      return JSON.parse(text) as T;
262	    } catch (e) {
263	      console.warn(`Failed to parse JSON response for [${cmd}]:`, text);
264	      return text as unknown as T; // Fallback for plain text responses
265	    }
266	  } catch (error) {
267	    console.error(`Web Fetch Error [${cmd}]:`, error);
268	    throw error;
269	  }
270	}
271

302	#[tauri::command]
303	pub async fn get_proxy_status(state: State<'_, ProxyServiceState>) -> Result<ProxyStatus, String> {
304	    // 优先检查启动标志，避免被写锁阻塞
305	    if state.starting.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
306	        return Ok(ProxyStatus {
307	            running: false, // 逻辑上还没运行
308	            port: 0,
309	            base_url: "starting".to_string(), // 给前端标识
310	            active_accounts: 0,
311	        });
312	    }
313	
314	    // 使用 try_read 避免在该命令中产生产生排队延迟
315	    let lock_res = state.instance.try_read();
316	
317	    match lock_res {
318	        Ok(instance_lock) => match instance_lock.as_ref() {
319	            Some(instance) => Ok(ProxyStatus {
320	                running: true,
321	                port: instance.config.port,
322	                base_url: format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}", instance.config.port),
323	                active_accounts: instance.token_manager.len(),
324	            }),
325	            None => Ok(ProxyStatus {
326	                running: false,
327	                port: 0,
328	                base_url: String::new(),
329	                active_accounts: 0,
330	            }),
331	        },
332	        Err(_) => {
333	            // 如果拿不到锁，说明正在进行写操作（可能是正在启动或停止中）
334	            Ok(ProxyStatus {
335	                running: false,
336	                port: 0,
337	                base_url: "busy".to_string(),
338	                active_accounts: 0,
339	            })

### 2. Where the Service Address (`127.0.0.1`) is Determined

The address is determined in **three places**:

#### A. Frontend fallback (`ServiceConfig.tsx`, line 582)
```tsx
proxyUrl={status.running ? status.base_url : `http://127.0.0.1:${appConfig.proxy.port || 8045}`}
```
- If proxy is running, uses `status.base_url` from the backend.
- If proxy is NOT running, hardcodes `http://127.0.0.1:{port}` (default port 8045).

#### B. Backend `ProxyStatus.base_url` (`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/commands/proxy.rs`)

- **Line 15** -- struct field: `pub base_url: String`
- **Line 322** -- When running:
  ```rust
  base_url: format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}", instance.config.port),
  ```
- **Line 177** and **Line 205** -- Also hardcoded to `127.0.0.1` in other status paths.

**IMPORTANT:** The `base_url` is **always** `http://127.0.0.1:{port}` regardless of the actual bind address (`allow_lan_access`). Even if `allow_lan_access` is `true` (binds to `0.0.0.0`), the `base_url` returned to the frontend still uses `127.0.0.1`.

#### C. Config bind address (`/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/config.rs`)

- **Lines 742-752** -- The actual server bind address:
  ```rust
  pub fn get_bind_address(&self) -> &str {
      if self.allow_lan_access {
          "0.0.0.0"
      } else {
          "127.0.0.1"
      }
  }
  ```

# CLI 同步增加"容器中"选项

## Context

当代理服务运行在 Docker 容器中时，宿主机上的 CLI 工具（如 Claude Code）无法通过 `127.0.0.1` 访问容器内服务，需要使用 `host.docker.internal`。需要在 CLI 同步卡片中增加一个切换开关，方便用户一键切换容器模式。

## 涉及文件

| 文件 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| `src/components/proxy/CliSyncCard.tsx` | 增加容器模式 toggle，URL 替换逻辑 |
| `src/locales/zh.json` | 新增翻译 key |
| `src/locales/en.json` | 新增翻译 key |

## 实现方案

### 1. `CliSyncCard.tsx` — 新增容器模式

**a) 新增 state**（`openCodeSyncModal` 之后，~line 87）：
\```tsx
const [containerMode, setContainerMode] = useState(false);
\```

**b) 修改 `getFormattedProxyUrl`**（~line 99-108）：在格式化 URL 前，先替换 host：
\```tsx
const getFormattedProxyUrl = useCallback((app: CliAppType) => {
    if (!proxyUrl) return '';
    let url = proxyUrl.trimEnd().replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (containerMode) {
        url = url.replace('127.0.0.1', 'host.docker.internal');
    }
    if (app === 'Codex' || app === 'OpenCode') {
        return url.endsWith('/v1') ? url : `${url}/v1`;
    }
    return url.replace(/\/v1$/, '');
}, [proxyUrl, containerMode]);
\```

**c) 在卡片标题栏添加 Toggle**（~line 410-420，在 subtitle 旁边）：
\```tsx
<div className="px-1 flex items-center justify-between">
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-400">
        <Terminal size={14} />
        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest">
            {t('proxy.cli_sync.title')}
        </span>
    </div>
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <input
                type="checkbox"
                id="cli-container-mode"
                checked={containerMode}
                onChange={(e) => setContainerMode(e.target.checked)}
                className="toggle toggle-xs toggle-primary"
            />
            <label
                htmlFor="cli-container-mode"
                className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 cursor-pointer select-none"
            >
                {t('proxy.cli_sync.container_mode')}
            </label>
        </div>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 italic">
            {t('proxy.cli_sync.subtitle')}
        </p>
    </div>
</div>
\```

### 2. 翻译

**zh.json**（`proxy.cli_sync` 下新增）：
\```json
"container_mode": "容器中"
\```

**en.json**（`proxy.cli_sync` 下新增）：
\```json
"container_mode": "In Container"
\```

## 验证

1. 页面中 CLI 同步卡片标题旁出现"容器中"开关
2. 开启后，所有 CLI 同步请求的 proxyUrl 中 `127.0.0.1` 被替换为 `host.docker.internal`
3. 关闭后恢复 `127.0.0.1`
4. `npx tsc --noEmit` 通过

# CLI 同步增加"容器中"选项

## Context

当代理服务运行在 Docker 容器中时，宿主机上的 CLI 工具（如 Claude Code）无法通过 `127.0.0.1` 访问容器内服务，需要使用 `host.docker.internal`。需要在 CLI 同步卡片中增加一个切换开关，方便用户一键切换容器模式。

## 涉及文件

| 文件 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| `src/components/proxy/CliSyncCard.tsx` | 增加容器模式 toggle + URL host 替换逻辑 |
| `src/locales/zh.json` | 新增翻译 key |
| `src/locales/en.json` | 新增翻译 key |

## 实现方案

### 1. `CliSyncCard.tsx`

**a) 新增 state**（`openCodeSyncModal` 之后，~line 87）：
\```tsx
const [containerMode, setContainerMode] = useState(false);
\```

**b) 修改 `getFormattedProxyUrl`**（~line 99-108）：在格式化 URL 前先替换 host：
\```tsx
const getFormattedProxyUrl = useCallback((app: CliAppType) => {
    if (!proxyUrl) return '';
    let url = proxyUrl.trimEnd().replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (containerMode) {
        url = url.replace('127.0.0.1', 'host.docker.internal');
    }
    if (app === 'Codex' || app === 'OpenCode') {
        return url.endsWith('/v1') ? url : `${url}/v1`;
    }
    return url.replace(/\/v1$/, '');
}, [proxyUrl, containerMode]);
\```

**c) 标题栏添加 Toggle**（~line 410-420，在 subtitle 旁边）：
\```tsx
<div className="px-1 flex items-center justify-between">
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-400">
        <Terminal size={14} />
        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest">
            {t('proxy.cli_sync.title')}
        </span>
    </div>
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <input
                type="checkbox"
                id="cli-container-mode"
                checked={containerMode}
                onChange={(e) => setContainerMode(e.target.checked)}
                className="toggle toggle-xs toggle-primary"
            />
            <label
                htmlFor="cli-container-mode"
                className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 cursor-pointer select-none"
            >
                {t('proxy.cli_sync.container_mode')}
            </label>
        </div>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 italic">
            {t('proxy.cli_sync.subtitle')}
        </p>
    </div>
</div>
\```

\```

\```

1. Calls `resolve_model_route()` to map via custom_mapping

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn save_config(
    app: tauri::AppHandle,
    proxy_state: State<'_, ProxyServiceState>,
    config: AppConfig,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    modules::save_app_config(&config)?;  // Persist to disk
    app.emit("config://updated", ());     // Notify tray

    // Hot-update running service
    let instance_lock = proxy_state.instance.read().await;
    if let Some(instance) = instance_lock.as_ref() {
        instance.axum_server.update_mapping(&config.proxy).await;
        instance.axum_server.update_proxy(...).await;
        instance.axum_server.update_security(...).await;
        instance.axum_server.update_zai(...).await;
        instance.axum_server.update_experimental(...).await;

**Critical observation:** There is **NO** `update_providers()` call in the hot-update path. The `provider_router` in `AppState` is NOT hot-reloaded when providers are saved. Only the following are updated:

- `upstream_proxy`
- `security`
- `zai`
- `experimental`
- `debug_logging`
- `user_agent_override`
- `proxy_pool`

**Provider changes require a service restart** to take effect in the running proxy.

**File:** `/Users/Jacky/workspace/AIWorks/dc_works/MyProxy-Manager/src-tauri/src/proxy/handlers/openai.rs` (lines 149-206)

When an OpenAI request arrives (e.g., `POST /v1/chat/completions`):

`forward_openai_compatible()` in `handlers/openai.rs` (line 2652): For OpenAI-originated requests. Builds URL `{base_url}/v1/chat/completions`, sets Bearer auth from `provider.api_key`, and forwards the request as-is.

12	    let url = url.trim();
13	    if url.is_empty() {
14	        return String::new();
15	    }
16	    if !url.contains("://") {

18	    } else {
19	        url.to_string()

260	#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
261	pub enum ProviderProtocol {
262	    /// Provider speaks Anthropic Messages API. Requests forwarded as-is.
263	    AnthropicPassthrough,
264	    /// Provider speaks OpenAI Chat Completions API.
265	    OpenAICompatible,
266	    /// Provider speaks Google v1internal (Gemini) API.
267	    /// Requests are transformed from OpenAI/Claude to Gemini format.
268	    GeminiV1Internal,
269	}
270	
271	impl Default for ProviderProtocol {
272	    fn default() -> Self {
273	        Self::AnthropicPassthrough
274	    }
275	}

277	/// Dispatch mode for a provider within the routing chain.
278	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
279	#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
280	pub enum ProviderDispatchMode {
281	    /// Always use this provider for matching models.
282	    Exclusive,
283	    /// Round-robin among pooled providers with same model capability.
284	    Pooled,
285	    /// Only when higher-priority providers fail.
286	    Fallback,
287	}
288	
289	impl Default for ProviderDispatchMode {
290	    fn default() -> Self {
291	        Self::Pooled
292	    }
293	}

316	/// A single upstream provider configured by API Key + Base URL.
317	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
318	pub struct UpstreamProvider {
319	    pub name: String,
320	    /// Short routing identifier (1-10 chars, alphanumeric, non-digit start).
321	    /// Enables direct routing via `provider_id/model_name` format.
322	    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
323	    pub provider_id: Option<String>,
324	    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
325	    pub enabled: bool,
326	    pub base_url: String,
327	    #[serde(default)]
328	    pub api_key: String,
329	    #[serde(default)]
330	    pub protocol: ProviderProtocol,
331	    #[serde(default)]
332	    pub dispatch_mode: ProviderDispatchMode,
333	    #[serde(default = "default_provider_priority")]
334	    pub priority: u8,
335	    /// Model prefix patterns this provider supports (empty = wildcard).
336	    #[serde(default)]
337	    pub model_prefixes: Vec<String>,
338	    /// Explicit per-model overrides: incoming model -> upstream model name.
339	    #[serde(default)]
340	    pub model_mapping: HashMap<String, String>,
341	    /// Comma-separated list of available models, e.g. "gemini-2.5-pro,gemini-2.5-flash".
342	    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
343	    pub available_models: Option<String>,
344	    /// Default model mapping by family (for AnthropicPassthrough providers).
345	    #[serde(default)]
346	    pub default_models: ProviderModelDefaults,
347	    /// Optional HTTP request timeout in seconds.
348	    #[serde(default)]
349	    pub request_timeout_secs: Option<u64>,
350	}
351	
352	/// Validate that a provider_id matches the allowed format:
353	/// 1-10 chars, alphanumeric, first char must be a letter.
354	pub fn is_valid_provider_id(id: &str) -> bool {
355	    !id.is_empty()
356	        && id.len() <= 10
357	        && id.chars().next().map_or(false, |c| c.is_ascii_alphabetic())
358	        && id.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric())
359	}
360

362	    "glm-4.7".to_string()
363	}

365	    "glm-4.7".to_string()
366	}
367	fn default_provider_haiku() -> String {
368	    "glm-4.5-air".to_string()
369	}
370	fn default_provider_priority() -> u8 {
371	    0
372	}

381	    /// 启用工具循环自动恢复 (Tool Loop Recovery)

383	    pub enable_tool_loop_recovery: bool,
384	
385	    /// 启用跨模型兼容性检查 (Cross-Model Checks)
386	    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
387	    pub enable_cross_model_checks: bool,
388	
389	    /// 启用上下文用量缩放 (Context Usage Scaling)
390	    /// 激进模式: 缩放用量并激活自动压缩以突破 200k 限制
391	    /// 默认关闭以保持透明度,让客户端能触发原生压缩指令
392	    #[serde(default = "default_false")]

398

402	
403	    /// 上下文压缩阈值 L3 (Fork + Summary)
404	    #[serde(default = "default_threshold_l3")]
405	    pub context_compression_threshold_l3: f32,
406	}

811	/// 代理选择策略
812	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
813	#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
814	pub enum ProxySelectionStrategy {
815	    /// 轮询: 依次使用
816	    RoundRobin,
817	    /// 随机: 随机选择
818	    Random,
819	    /// 优先级: 按 priority 字段排序
820	    Priority,
821	    /// 最少连接: 选择当前使用最少的代理
822	    LeastConnections,
823	    /// 加权轮询: 根据健康状态和优先级
824	    WeightedRoundRobin,
825	}

827	#[cfg(test)]
828	mod tests {
829	    use super::*;
830	
831	    #[test]
832	    fn test_normalize_proxy_url() {
833	        // 测试已有协议
834	        assert_eq!(normalize_proxy_url("http://127.0.0.1:7890"), "http://127.0.0.1:7890");
835	        assert_eq!(normalize_proxy_url("https://proxy.com"), "https://proxy.com");
836	        assert_eq!(normalize_proxy_url("socks5://127.0.0.1:1080"), "socks5://127.0.0.1:1080");
837	        assert_eq!(normalize_proxy_url("socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080"), "socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080");
838	
839	        // 测试缺少协议（默认补全 http://）
840	        assert_eq!(normalize_proxy_url("127.0.0.1:7890"), "http://127.0.0.1:7890");
841	        assert_eq!(normalize_proxy_url("localhost:1082"), "http://localhost:1082");
842	
843	        // 测试边缘情况
844	        assert_eq!(normalize_proxy_url(""), "");
845	        assert_eq!(normalize_proxy_url("   "), "");

301	/// 获取反代服务状态
302	#[tauri::command]
303	pub async fn get_proxy_status(state: State<'_, ProxyServiceState>) -> Result<ProxyStatus, String> {
304	    // 优先检查启动标志，避免被写锁阻塞
305	    if state.starting.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
306	        return Ok(ProxyStatus {
307	            running: false, // 逻辑上还没运行
308	            port: 0,
309	            base_url: "starting".to_string(), // 给前端标识
310	            active_accounts: 0,
311	        });
312	    }
313	
314	    // 使用 try_read 避免在该命令中产生产生排队延迟
315	    let lock_res = state.instance.try_read();
316	
317	    match lock_res {
318	        Ok(instance_lock) => match instance_lock.as_ref() {
319	            Some(instance) => Ok(ProxyStatus {
320	                running: true,
321	                port: instance.config.port,
322	                base_url: format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}", instance.config.port),
323	                active_accounts: instance.token_manager.len(),
324	            }),
325	            None => Ok(ProxyStatus {
326	                running: false,
327	                port: 0,
328	                base_url: String::new(),
329	                active_accounts: 0,
330	            }),
331	        },
332	        Err(_) => {
333	            // 如果拿不到锁，说明正在进行写操作（可能是正在启动或停止中）
334	            Ok(ProxyStatus {
335	                running: false,
336	                port: 0,
337	                base_url: "busy".to_string(),
338	                active_accounts: 0,
339	            })
340	        }
341	    }
342	}

526	fn extract_model_ids(value: &serde_json::Value) -> Vec<String> {
527	    let mut out = Vec::new();
528	
529	    fn push_from_item(out: &mut Vec<String>, item: &serde_json::Value) {
530	        match item {
531	            serde_json::Value::String(s) => out.push(s.to_string()),
532	            serde_json::Value::Object(map) => {
533	                if let Some(id) = map.get("id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
534	                    out.push(id.to_string());
535	                } else if let Some(name) = map.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
536	                    out.push(name.to_string());
537	                }
538	            }
539	            _ => {}
540	        }
541	    }
542	
543	    match value {
544	        serde_json::Value::Array(arr) => {
545	            for item in arr {
546	                push_from_item(&mut out, item);
547	            }
548	        }
549	        serde_json::Value::Object(map) => {
550	            if let Some(data) = map.get("data") {
551	                if let serde_json::Value::Array(arr) = data {
552	                    for item in arr {
553	                        push_from_item(&mut out, item);
554	                    }
555	                }
556	            }
557	            if let Some(models) = map.get("models") {
558	                match models {
559	                    serde_json::Value::Array(arr) => {
560	                        for item in arr {
561	                            push_from_item(&mut out, item);
562	                        }
563	                    }
564	                    other => push_from_item(&mut out, other),
565	                }
566	            }
567	        }
568	        _ => {}
569	    }
570	
571	    out
572	}

574	/// Fetch available models from the configured z.ai Anthropic-compatible API (`/v1/models`).
575	#[tauri::command]
576	pub async fn fetch_zai_models(
577	    zai: crate::proxy::ZaiConfig,
578	    upstream_proxy: crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig,
579	    request_timeout: u64,
580	) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
581	    if zai.base_url.trim().is_empty() {
582	        return Err("z.ai base_url is empty".to_string());
583	    }
584	    if zai.api_key.trim().is_empty() {
585	        return Err("z.ai api_key is not set".to_string());
586	    }
587	
588	    let url = join_base_url(&zai.base_url, "/v1/models");
589	
590	    let mut builder =
591	        reqwest::Client::builder().timeout(Duration::from_secs(request_timeout.max(5)));
592	    if upstream_proxy.enabled && !upstream_proxy.url.is_empty() {
593	        let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&upstream_proxy.url)
594	            .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
595	        builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
596	    }
597	    let client = builder
598	        .build()
599	        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))?;
600	
601	    let resp = client
602	        .get(&url)
603	        .header("Authorization", format!("Bearer {}", zai.api_key))
604	        .header("x-api-key", zai.api_key)
605	        .header("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01")
606	        .header("accept", "application/json")
607	        .send()
608	        .await
609	        .map_err(|e| format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e))?;
610	
611	    let status = resp.status();
612	    let text = resp
613	        .text()
614	        .await
615	        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to read response: {}", e))?;
616	
617	    if !status.is_success() {
618	        let preview = if text.len() > 4000 {
619	            &text[..4000]
620	        } else {
621	            &text
622	        };
623	        return Err(format!("Upstream returned {}: {}", status, preview));
624	    }
625	
626	    let json: serde_json::Value =
627	        serde_json::from_str(&text).map_err(|e| format!("Invalid JSON response: {}", e))?;
628	    let mut models = extract_model_ids(&json);
629	    models.retain(|s| !s.trim().is_empty());
630	    models.sort();
631	    models.dedup();
632	    Ok(models)
633	}

711	        }
712

10	/// Load application configuration
11	pub fn load_app_config() -> Result<AppConfig, String> {
12	    let data_dir = get_data_dir()?;
13	    let config_path = data_dir.join(CONFIG_FILE);
14	    
15	    if !config_path.exists() {
16	        let config = AppConfig::new();
17	        // [FIX #1460] Persist initial config to prevent new API Key on every refresh
18	        let _ = save_app_config(&config);
19	        return Ok(config);
20	    }
21	    
22	    let content = fs::read_to_string(&config_path)
23	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_read_config_file: {}", e))?;
24	    
25	    let mut v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content)
26	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_parse_config_file: {}", e))?;
27	    
28	    let mut modified = false;
29	
30	    // Migration logic
31	    if let Some(proxy) = v.get_mut("proxy") {
32	        // [FIX #1738] Enhanced type checking for custom_mapping
33	        // Ensures the field is always parsed as an object, preventing type mismatch errors
34	        let mut custom_mapping = match proxy.get("custom_mapping") {
35	            Some(m) if m.is_object() => m.as_object().unwrap().clone(),
36	            Some(m) => {
37	                // If custom_mapping is not an object type (e.g., string), log warning and reset to empty
38	                tracing::warn!("Invalid custom_mapping type (expected object, got {:?}), resetting to empty", m);
39	                serde_json::Map::new()
40	            }
41	            None => serde_json::Map::new(),
42	        };
43	
44	        // Migrate Anthropic mapping
45	        if let Some(anthropic) = proxy.get_mut("anthropic_mapping").and_then(|m| m.as_object_mut()) {
46	            for (k, v) in anthropic.iter() {
47	                // Only move non-series fields, as series fields are now handled by Preset logic or builtin tables
48	                if !k.ends_with("-series") {
49	                    if !custom_mapping.contains_key(k) {
50	                        custom_mapping.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
51	                    }
52	                }
53	            }
54	            // Remove old field
55	            proxy.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("anthropic_mapping");
56	            modified = true;
57	        }
58	
59	        // Migrate OpenAI mapping
60	        if let Some(openai) = proxy.get_mut("openai_mapping").and_then(|m| m.as_object_mut()) {
61	            for (k, v) in openai.iter() {
62	                if !k.ends_with("-series") {
63	                    if !custom_mapping.contains_key(k) {
64	                        custom_mapping.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
65	                    }
66	                }
67	            }
68	            // Remove old field
69	            proxy.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("openai_mapping");
70	            modified = true;
71	        }
72	
73	        if modified {
74	            proxy.as_object_mut().unwrap().insert("custom_mapping".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(custom_mapping));
75	        }
76	    }
77	
78	    let config: AppConfig = serde_json::from_value(v)
79	        .map_err(|e| format!("failed_to_convert_config_after_migration: {}", e))?;
80	    
81	    // If migration occurred, auto-save once to clean up the file
82	    if modified {
83	        let _ = save_app_config(&config);
84	    }
85	
86	    Ok(config)
87	}

13	/// Build a URL for OpenAI-compatible API.
14	pub(crate) fn build_openai_compat_url_for_provider(base_url: &str, path: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
15	    let base = base_url.trim_end_matches('/');
16	    let path = if path.starts_with('/') {
17	        path.to_string()
18	    } else {
19	        format!("/{}", path)
20	    };
21	    Ok(format!("{}{}", base, path))
22	}
23	
24	/// Build a reqwest::Client for upstream OpenAI-compatible calls.
25	pub(crate) fn build_openai_compat_client_for_provider(
26	    upstream_proxy: Option<crate::proxy::config::UpstreamProxyConfig>,
27	    timeout_secs: u64,
28	) -> Result<reqwest::Client, String> {
29	    let mut builder = reqwest::Client::builder()
30	        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs.max(5)));
31	
32	    if let Some(config) = upstream_proxy {
33	        if config.enabled && !config.url.is_empty() {
34	            let url = crate::proxy::config::normalize_proxy_url(&config.url);
35	            let proxy = reqwest::Proxy::all(&url)
36	                .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid upstream proxy url: {}", e))?;
37	            builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
38	        }
39	    }
40	
41	    builder
42	        .tcp_nodelay(true)
43	        .build()
44	        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e))
45	}
46	
47	/// Forward a Claude Messages request through an OpenAI-Compatible provider.
48	/// Converts Claude → OpenAI request, then OpenAI response → Claude SSE/JSON.
49	pub async fn forward_claude_via_openai_compat(
50	    state: &AppState,
51	    provider: &UpstreamProvider,
52	    claude_req: &ClaudeRequest,
53	    headers: &axum::http::HeaderMap,
54	) -> Response {
55	    use crate::proxy::mappers::claude::request_bridge::claude_to_openai_body;
56	    use crate::proxy::mappers::claude::response_bridge::{
57	        create_claude_sse_from_openai_stream, openai_to_claude_response,
58	    };
59	
60	    let trace_id = format!(
61	        "req_{}",
62	        chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_subsec_millis()
63	    );
64	    let _trace_id = &trace_id;
65	
66	    // Map model name
67	    let mapped_model = crate::proxy::providers::router::map_model_for_provider(
68	        &claude_req.model,
69	        &provider.model_mapping,
70	        &provider.default_models,
71	    );
72	
73	    // Convert Claude request to OpenAI format
74	    let openai_body = claude_to_openai_body(claude_req);
75	    let client_wants_stream = claude_req.stream;
76	
77	    let url = match build_openai_compat_url_for_provider(&provider.base_url, "/v1/chat/completions") {
78	        Ok(u) => u,
79	        Err(e) => {
80	            return (
81	                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
82	                format!("Failed to build URL: {}", e),
83	            )
84	                .into_response();
85	        }
86	    };
87	
88	    let timeout_secs = provider
89	        .request_timeout_secs
90	        .unwrap_or(state.request_timeout.max(5));
91	
92	    let upstream_proxy = state.upstream_proxy.read().await.clone();
93	    let client = match build_openai_compat_client_for_provider(Some(upstream_proxy), timeout_secs) {
94	        Ok(c) => c,
95	        Err(e) => {
96	            return (
97	                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
98	                format!("Failed to build client: {}", e),
99	            )
100	                .into_response();
101	        }
102	    };
103	
104	    let body_bytes = match serde_json::to_vec(&openai_body) {
105	        Ok(b) => b,
106	        Err(e) => {
107	            return (
108	                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
109	                format!("Failed to serialize body: {}", e),
110	            )
111	                .into_response();
112	        }
113	    };
114	
115	    // Build request headers
116	    let mut req_headers = axum::http::HeaderMap::new();
117	    req_headers.insert(
118	        "content-type",
119	        HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"),
120	    );
121	    // Bearer token auth
122	    if let Ok(v) = HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {}", provider.api_key)) {
123	        req_headers.insert("authorization", v);
124	    }
125	    // Passthrough headers
126	    for (k, v) in headers.iter() {
127	        let key = k.as_str().to_ascii_lowercase();
128	        match key.as_str() {
129	            "accept" | "user-agent" | "accept-encoding" => {
130	                req_headers.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
131	            }
132	            _ => {}
133	        }
134	    }
135	
136	    let response = match client
137	        .post(&url)
138	        .headers(req_headers)
139	        .body(body_bytes)
140	        .send()
141	        .await
142	    {
143	        Ok(r) => r,
144	        Err(e) => {
145	            return (
146	                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
147	                format!("Upstream request failed: {}", e),
148	            )
149	                .into_response();
150	        }
151	    };
152	
153	    let status = response.status();
154	    if !status.is_success() {
155	        let error_body = response.bytes().await.unwrap_or_default();
156	        return (status, String::from_utf8_lossy(&error_body).to_string()).into_response();
157	    }
158	
159	    if client_wants_stream {
160	        // Stream: wrap OpenAI SSE through Claude SSE converter
161	        let openai_stream = response.bytes_stream();
162	        let claude_stream = create_claude_sse_from_openai_stream(
163	            Box::pin(openai_stream),
164	            mapped_model.clone(),
165	        );
166	
167	        Response::builder()
168	            .status(StatusCode::OK)
169	            .header("content-type", "text/event-stream")
170	            .header("cache-control", "no-cache")
171	            .header("connection", "keep-alive")
172	            .header("x-mapped-model", &mapped_model)
173	            .header("x-provider-name", &provider.name)
174	            .body(Body::from_stream(claude_stream))
175	            .unwrap()
176	    } else {
177	        // Non-streaming: collect JSON and convert
178	        let bytes = match response.bytes().await {
179	            Ok(b) => b,
180	            Err(e) => {
181	                return (
182	                    StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
183	                    format!("Failed to read response body: {}", e),
184	                )
185	                    .into_response();
186	            }
187	        };
188	
189	        let openai_value: Value = match serde_json::from_slice(&bytes) {
190	            Ok(v) => v,
191	            Err(e) => {
192	                return (
193	                    StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
194	                    format!("Failed to parse response JSON: {}", e),
195	                )
196	                    .into_response();
197	            }
198	        };
199	
200	        let claude_resp = match openai_to_claude_response(&openai_value, &mapped_model) {
201	            Ok(v) => v,
202	            Err(e) => {
203	                return (
204	                    StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
205	                    format!("Failed to convert response: {}", e),
206	                )
207	                    .into_response();
208	            }
209	        };
210	
211	        match serde_json::to_string(&claude_resp) {
212	            Ok(json) => Response::builder()
213	                .status(StatusCode::OK)
214	                .header("content-type", "application/json")
215	                .header("x-mapped-model", &mapped_model)
216	                .header("x-provider-name", &provider.name)
217	                .body(Body::from(json))
218	                .unwrap(),
219	            Err(e) => (
220	                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
221	                format!("Failed to serialize response: {}", e),
222	            )
223	                .into_response(),
224	        }
225	    }
226	}
227

5	use crate::proxy::config::{

9	
10	/// Result of provider selection, including the resolved model name
11	/// (with provider_id/ prefix stripped if applicable).
12	pub struct ProviderSelection<'a> {
13	    pub provider: &'a UpstreamProvider,
14	    /// The model name to use when forwarding (prefix stripped if provider_id routing was used).
15	    pub resolved_model: String,
16	}
17	
18	/// Routes incoming requests to the appropriate upstream provider.
19	pub struct ProviderRouter {
20	    providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>,
21	    rr_counter: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
22	    /// Index of provider_id -> provider index for O(1) lookups.
23	    provider_id_index: HashMap<String, usize>,
24	}
25	
26	impl ProviderRouter {
27	    /// Build from config. If `providers` is empty, optionally migrate from legacy z.ai config.
28	    pub fn new(providers: Vec<UpstreamProvider>, legacy_zai: Option<&ZaiConfig>) -> Self {
29	        let enabled: Vec<_> = providers.into_iter().filter(|p| p.enabled).collect();
30	
31	        if enabled.is_empty() {
32	            if let Some(zai) = legacy_zai {
33	                if zai.enabled && zai.dispatch_mode != crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off {
34	                    return Self::from_zai_config(zai);
35	                }
36	            }
37	        }
38	
39	        // Build provider_id index, validate format and uniqueness
40	        let mut provider_id_index: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
41	        let mut seen_ids: std::collections::HashSet<String> = std::collections::HashSet::new();
42	        for (i, p) in enabled.iter().enumerate() {
43	            if let Some(ref pid) = p.provider_id {
44	                if !is_valid_provider_id(pid) {
45	                    tracing::warn!(
46	                        "[ProviderRouter] Invalid provider_id format: '{}' (provider: '{}'). \
47	                         Must be 1-10 alphanumeric chars, starting with a letter.",
48	                        pid, p.name
49	                    );
50	                    continue;
51	                }
52	                if !seen_ids.insert(pid.clone()) {
53	                    tracing::error!(
54	                        "[ProviderRouter] Duplicate provider_id: '{}' (provider: '{}'). \
55	                         This provider will not be routable by provider_id.",
56	                        pid, p.name
57	                    );
58	                    provider_id_index.remove(pid);
59	                    continue;
60	                }
61	                provider_id_index.insert(pid.clone(), i);
62	            }
63	        }
64	
65	        Self {
66	            providers: enabled,
67	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
68	            provider_id_index,
69	        }
70	    }
71	
72	    /// Build a single-provider router from legacy z.ai configuration.
73	    fn from_zai_config(zai: &ZaiConfig) -> Self {
74	        let dispatch_mode = match zai.dispatch_mode {
75	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Off => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
76	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Exclusive => ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive,
77	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Pooled => ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled,
78	            crate::proxy::ZaiDispatchMode::Fallback => ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback,
79	        };
80	
81	        let provider = UpstreamProvider {
82	            name: "z.ai".to_string(),
83	            provider_id: None,
84	            enabled: true,
85	            base_url: zai.base_url.clone(),
86	            api_key: zai.api_key.clone(),
87	            protocol: ProviderProtocol::AnthropicPassthrough,
88	            dispatch_mode,
89	            priority: 0,
90	            model_prefixes: Vec::new(),
91	            model_mapping: zai.model_mapping.clone(),
92	            available_models: None,
93	            default_models: ProviderModelDefaults {
94	                opus: zai.models.opus.clone(),
95	                sonnet: zai.models.sonnet.clone(),
96	                haiku: zai.models.haiku.clone(),
97	            },
98	            request_timeout_secs: None,
99	        };
100	
101	        Self {
102	            providers: vec![provider],
103	            rr_counter: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
104	            provider_id_index: Default::default(),
105	        }
106	    }
107	
108	    /// If `model` starts with a registered `provider_id/`, return `(provider_id, rest)`.
109	    fn extract_provider_id_prefix<'a>(&self, model: &'a str) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {
110	        if let Some(slash_pos) = model.find('/') {
111	            let candidate = &model[..slash_pos];
112	            if self.provider_id_index.contains_key(candidate) {
113	                let rest = &model[slash_pos + 1..];
114	                if !rest.is_empty() {
115	                    return Some((candidate, rest));
116	                }
117	            }
118	        }
119	        None
120	    }
121	
122	    /// Select the next provider for the given model.
123	    /// `prev_failed` excludes a provider that just failed, triggering fallback.
124	    ///
125	    /// Routing priority:
126	    /// 1. If model starts with a registered `provider_id/`, route directly to that provider.
127	    /// 2. Match model name against provider `model_prefixes`:
128	    ///    - Providers with matching prefixes become candidates.
129	    ///    - Providers with empty `model_prefixes` are treated as wildcards (match any model).
130	    ///    - If specific prefix matches exist, only those providers are considered.
131	    ///    - If no specific prefix matches, wildcard providers are used.
132	    /// 3. Among candidates, select by dispatch mode:
133	    ///    - Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority, then config order)
134	    ///    - Pooled providers next (sorted by priority, then RR)
135	    ///    - Fallback providers last (sorted by priority, then config order)
136	    pub fn select(
137	        &self,
138	        model: &str,
139	        prev_failed: Option<&str>,
140	    ) -> ProviderSelection<'_> {
141	        // STEP 1: Check for provider_id/ prefix routing (highest priority)
142	        if let Some((pid, rest)) = self.extract_provider_id_prefix(model) {
143	            if let Some(&idx) = self.provider_id_index.get(pid) {
144	                let provider = &self.providers[idx];
145	                if prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| provider.name != pf) {
146	                    return ProviderSelection {
147	                        provider,
148	                        resolved_model: rest.to_string(),
149	                    };
150	                }
151	                // provider_id matched but provider failed; fall through to default selection
152	            }
153	        }
154	
155	        // STEP 2: Model matching via model_prefixes or available_models
156	        let model_lower = model.to_lowercase();
157	        let mut specific_matches: Vec<&UpstreamProvider> = Vec::new();
158	        let mut wildcard_matches: Vec<&UpstreamProvider> = Vec::new();
159	
160	        for p in &self.providers {
161	            if prev_failed.map_or(false, |pf| p.name == pf) {
162	                continue;
163	            }
164	
165	            let has_match = if !p.model_prefixes.is_empty() {
166	                // Check model_prefixes
167	                p.model_prefixes.iter().any(|prefix| {
168	                    model_lower.starts_with(prefix.to_lowercase().as_str())
169	                })
170	            } else if let Some(ref avail) = p.available_models {
171	                // Check available_models (comma-separated list)
172	                avail.split(',')
173	                    .map(|s| s.trim().to_lowercase())
174	                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
175	                    .any(|m| m == model_lower)
176	            } else {
177	                // No constraints = wildcard (matches any model)
178	                false
179	            };
180	
181	            if has_match {
182	                specific_matches.push(p);
183	            } else if p.model_prefixes.is_empty() && p.available_models.is_none() {
184	                // Truly unconstrained = wildcard
185	                wildcard_matches.push(p);
186	            }
187	        }
188	
189	        // Use specific matches if any, otherwise fall back to wildcards
190	        let prefix_candidates: Vec<&UpstreamProvider> = if !specific_matches.is_empty() {
191	            specific_matches
192	        } else {
193	            wildcard_matches
194	        };
195	
196	        // STEP 3: Dispatch mode selection among prefix-matched candidates
197	        let candidates: Vec<_> = if prefix_candidates.is_empty() {
198	            // No prefix match at all, use all providers as fallback
199	            self.providers
200	                .iter()
201	                .filter(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf))
202	                .collect()
203	        } else {
204	            prefix_candidates
205	        };
206	
207	        if candidates.is_empty() {
208	            return ProviderSelection {
209	                provider: &self.providers[0],
210	                resolved_model: model.to_string(),
211	            };
212	        }
213	
214	        // 1. Exclusive providers first (sorted by priority, stable sort preserves config order)
215	        let mut exclusive: Vec<_> = candidates
216	            .iter()
217	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Exclusive)
218	            .copied()
219	            .collect();
220	        exclusive.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
221	        if let Some(p) = exclusive.first() {
222	            return ProviderSelection {
223	                provider: p,
224	                resolved_model: model.to_string(),
225	            };
226	        }
227	
228	        // 2. Round-robin among pooled providers
229	        let mut pooled: Vec<_> = candidates
230	            .iter()
231	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Pooled)
232	            .copied()
233	            .collect();
234	        if !pooled.is_empty() {
235	            pooled.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
236	            // Group by priority, RR within same priority group
237	            let top_priority = pooled[0].priority;
238	            let same_priority: Vec<_> = pooled
239	                .into_iter()
240	                .filter(|p| p.priority == top_priority)
241	                .collect();
242	            let idx = self.rr_counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % same_priority.len();
243	            return ProviderSelection {
244	                provider: same_priority[idx],
245	                resolved_model: model.to_string(),
246	            };
247	        }
248	
249	        // 3. Fallback providers
250	        let mut fallback: Vec<_> = candidates
251	            .iter()
252	            .filter(|p| p.dispatch_mode == ProviderDispatchMode::Fallback)
253	            .copied()
254	            .collect();
255	        fallback.sort_by_key(|p| p.priority);
256	        let fallback_provider = fallback.first().copied().unwrap_or_else(|| {
257	            // No fallback provider, use the first available provider
258	            self.providers.iter().find(|p| prev_failed.map_or(true, |pf| p.name != pf)).unwrap_or(&self.providers[0])
259	        });
260	        ProviderSelection {
261	            provider: fallback_provider,
262	            resolved_model: model.to_string(),
263	        }
264	    }
265	
266	    /// Map incoming model name to the provider's native model ID.
267	    pub fn map_model(&self, provider: &UpstreamProvider, incoming: &str) -> String {
268	        // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
269	        if let Some(mapped) = provider.model_mapping.get(incoming) {
270	            return mapped.clone();
271	        }
272	        // 2. Prefix match in model_mapping
273	        let m = incoming.to_lowercase();
274	        if let Some((_, mapped)) = provider
275	            .model_mapping
276	            .iter()
277	            .find(|(k, _)| m.starts_with(k.as_str()))
278	        {
279	            return mapped.clone();
280	        }
281	        // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
282	        if m.starts_with("zai:") {
283	            return incoming[4..].to_string();
284	        }
285	        // 4. Pass through glm-* models
286	        if m.starts_with("glm-") {
287	            return incoming.to_string();
288	        }
289	        // 5. Family defaults for Claude models
290	        if m.starts_with("claude-") {
291	            if m.contains("opus") {
292	                return provider.default_models.opus.clone();
293	            }
294	            if m.contains("haiku") {
295	                return provider.default_models.haiku.clone();
296	            }
297	            return provider.default_models.sonnet.clone();
298	        }
299	        // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
300	        incoming.to_string()
301	    }
302	
303	    /// Check if the router has any enabled providers.
304	    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
305	        self.providers.is_empty()
306	    }
307	
308	    /// Find a provider by name.
309	    pub fn get_by_name(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&UpstreamProvider> {
310	        self.providers.iter().find(|p| p.name == name)
311	    }
312	}
313	
314	/// Map a model name to the provider's expected model name.
315	/// This is a free function so it can be used without holding a `ProviderRouter` lock.
316	pub fn map_model_for_provider(
317	    original: &str,
318	    model_mapping: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
319	    default_models: &ProviderModelDefaults,
320	) -> String {
321	    // 1. Exact match in model_mapping
322	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(original) {
323	        return mapped.clone();
324	    }
325	    // 2. Lowercase match
326	    let m = original.to_lowercase();
327	    if let Some(mapped) = model_mapping.get(&m) {
328	        return mapped.clone();
329	    }
330	    // 3. Strip `zai:` prefix
331	    if m.starts_with("zai:") {
332	        return original[4..].to_string();
333	    }
334	    // 4. Pass through glm-* models
335	    if m.starts_with("glm-") {
336	        return original.to_string();
337	    }
338	    // 5. Claude family defaults
339	    if m.starts_with("claude-") {
340	        if m.contains("opus") {
341	            return default_models.opus.clone();
342	        }
343	        if m.contains("haiku") {
344	            return default_models.haiku.clone();
345	        }
346	        return default_models.sonnet.clone();
347	    }
348	    // 6. Fallback: pass through as-is
349	    original.to_string()
350	}

167	export async function request<T>(cmd: string, args?: any): Promise<T> {
168	  // 1. Tauri 环境：直接使用 invoke ...
169	  if (isTauri) {
170	    try {
171	      const { invoke } = await import('@tauri-apps/api/core');
172	      return await invoke<T>(cmd, args);
173	    } catch (error) {
174	      console.error(`Tauri Invoke Error [${cmd}]:`, error);
175	      throw error;
176	    }
177	  }
178	
179	  // 2. Web 环境：映射到 HTTP API
180	  const mapping = COMMAND_MAPPING[cmd];
181	  if (!mapping) {
182	    console.error(`Command [${cmd}] is not yet mapped for Web mode. Failing.`);
183	    throw new Error(`Command [${cmd}] not supported in Web mode.`);
184	  }
185	
186	  let url = mapping.url;
187	  // [FIX] 创建 args 副本，用于移除已使用的路径参数
188	  let bodyArgs = args ? { ...args } : undefined;
189	
190	  // 通用路径参数处理：替换 :key 为 args[key]
191	  if (args) {
192	    Object.keys(args).forEach(key => {
193	      const placeholder = `:${key}`;
194	      if (url.includes(placeholder)) {
195	        url = url.replace(placeholder, encodeURIComponent(String(args[key])));
196	        // [FIX] 从 body 参数中移除已用于路径的参数
197	        if (bodyArgs) {
198	          delete bodyArgs[key];
199	        }
200	      }
201	    });
202	  }
203	
204	  const apiKey = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? sessionStorage.getItem('abv_admin_api_key') : null;
205	
206	  const options: RequestInit = {
207	    method: mapping.method,
208	    headers: {
209	      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
210	      ...(apiKey ? {
211	        'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
212	        'x-api-key': apiKey
213	      } : {}),
214	    },
215	  };
216	
217	  if ((mapping.method === 'GET' || mapping.method === 'DELETE') && args) {
218	    const params = new URLSearchParams();
219	    Object.entries(args).forEach(([key, value]) => {
220	      // [FIX] 跳过已用于路径替换的参数
221	      if (url.includes(encodeURIComponent(String(value)))) return;
222	      if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
223	        params.append(key, String(value));
224	      }
225	    });
226	    const qs = params.toString();
227	    if (qs) url += `?${qs}`;
228	  } else if ((mapping.method === 'POST' || mapping.method === 'PATCH') && bodyArgs) {
229	    // [FIX] 如果有 request 包装，提取其内容作为 body
230	    const body = bodyArgs.request !== undefined ? bodyArgs.request : bodyArgs;
231	    options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
232	  }
233	
234	  try {
235	    const response = await fetch(url, options);
236	    if (!response.ok) {
237	      if (!isTauri && response.status === 401) {
238	        // [FIX #1163] 增加防抖锁，避免重复事件导致 UI 抖动
239	        const now = Date.now();
240	        const lastAuthError = (window as any)._lastAuthErrorTime || 0;
241	        if (now - lastAuthError > 2000) {
242	          (window as any)._lastAuthErrorTime = now;
243	          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('abv-unauthorized'));
244	        }
245	      }
246	      const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
247	      throw errorData.error || `HTTP Error ${response.status}`;
248	    }
249	
250	    // 如果是 204 No Content，直接返回 null
251	    if (response.status === 204) {
252	      return null as unknown as T;
253	    }
254	
255	    const text = await response.text();
256	    if (!text) {
257	      return null as unknown as T;
258	    }
259	
260	    try {
261	      return JSON.parse(text) as T;
262	    } catch (e) {
263	      console.warn(`Failed to parse JSON response for [${cmd}]:`, text);
264	      return text as unknown as T; // Fallback for plain text responses
265	    }
266	  } catch (error) {
267	    console.error(`Web Fetch Error [${cmd}]:`, error);
268	    throw error;
269	  }
270	}
271

5	pub fn get_proxy_db_path() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
6	    let data_dir = crate::modules::account::get_data_dir()?;
7	    Ok(data_dir.join("proxy_logs.db"))
8	}
9	
10	fn connect_db() -> Result<Connection, String> {
11	    let db_path = get_proxy_db_path()?;
12	    let conn = Connection::open(db_path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
13	    
14	    // Enable WAL mode for better concurrency
15	    conn.pragma_update(None, "journal_mode", "WAL").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
16	    
17	    // Set busy timeout to 5000ms to avoid "database is locked" errors
18	    conn.pragma_update(None, "busy_timeout", 5000).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
19	    
20	    // Synchronous NORMAL is faster and safe enough for WAL
21	    conn.pragma_update(None, "synchronous", "NORMAL").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
22	    
23	    Ok(conn)
24	}

104	/// Get logs summary (without large request_body and response_body fields) with pagination
105	pub fn get_logs_summary(limit: usize, offset: usize) -> Result<Vec<ProxyRequestLog>, String> {
106	    let conn = connect_db()?;
107	
108	    let mut stmt = conn.prepare(
109	        "SELECT id, timestamp, method, url, status, duration, model, error,
110	                NULL as request_body, NULL as response_body,
111	                input_tokens, output_tokens, account_email, mapped_model, protocol, client_ip, username, provider_name
112	         FROM request_logs
113	         ORDER BY timestamp DESC
114	         LIMIT ?1 OFFSET ?2"
115	    ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
116	
117	    let logs_iter = stmt.query_map([limit, offset], |row| {
118	        Ok(ProxyRequestLog {
119	            id: row.get(0)?,
120	            timestamp: row.get(1)?,
121	            method: row.get(2)?,
122	            url: row.get(3)?,
123	            status: row.get(4)?,
124	            duration: row.get(5)?,
125	            model: row.get(6)?,
126	            mapped_model: row.get(13).unwrap_or(None),
127	            account_email: row.get(12).unwrap_or(None),
128	            error: row.get(7)?,
129	            request_body: None,  // Don't query large fields for list view
130	            response_body: None, // Don't query large fields for list view
131	            input_tokens: row.get(10).unwrap_or(None),
132	            output_tokens: row.get(11).unwrap_or(None),
133	            protocol: row.get(14).unwrap_or(None),
134	            client_ip: row.get(15).unwrap_or(None),
135	            username: row.get(16).unwrap_or(None),
136	            provider_name: row.get(17).unwrap_or(None),
137	        })
138	
139	    }).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
140	
141	    let mut logs = Vec::new();
142	    for log in logs_iter {
143	        logs.push(log.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?);
144	    }
145	    Ok(logs)
146	}

148	/// Get logs (backward compatible, calls get_logs_summary)
149	pub fn get_logs(limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<ProxyRequestLog>, String> {
150	    get_logs_summary(limit, 0)
151	}

153	pub fn get_stats() -> Result<crate::proxy::monitor::ProxyStats, String> {
154	    let conn = connect_db()?;
155	
156	    // Optimized: Use single query instead of three separate queries
157	    // Use COALESCE to handle NULL values when table is empty (SUM returns NULL for empty set)
158	    let (total_requests, success_count, error_count): (u64, u64, u64) = conn.query_row(
159	        "SELECT 
160	            COUNT(*) as total,
161	            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status >= 200 AND status < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as success,
162	            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status < 200 OR status >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as error
163	         FROM request_logs",

211	/// Cleanup old logs (keep last N days)
212	pub fn cleanup_old_logs(days: i64) -> Result<usize, String> {
213	    let conn = connect_db()?;
214	    
215	    let cutoff_timestamp = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp() - (days * 24 * 3600);
216	    
217	    let deleted = conn.execute(
218	        "DELETE FROM request_logs WHERE timestamp < ?1",
219	        [cutoff_timestamp],
220	    ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
221	    
222	    // Execute VACUUM to reclaim disk space
223	    conn.execute("VACUUM", []).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
224	    
225	    Ok(deleted)
226	}

269	/// errors_only: if true, only count logs with status < 200 or >= 400
270	pub fn get_logs_count_filtered(filter: &str, errors_only: bool) -> Result<u64, String> {
271	    let conn = connect_db()?;
272	    
273	    let filter_pattern = format!("%{}%", filter);
274	    
275	    let sql = if errors_only {
276	        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM request_logs WHERE (status < 200 OR status >= 400)"
277	    } else if filter.is_empty() {
278	        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM request_logs"
279	    } else {
280	        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM request_logs WHERE
281	            (url LIKE ?1 OR method LIKE ?1 OR model LIKE ?1 OR CAST(status AS TEXT) LIKE ?1 OR account_email LIKE ?1)"
282	    };
283	    
284	    let count: u64 = if filter.is_empty() && !errors_only {
285	        conn.query_row(sql, [], |row| row.get(0))
286	    } else if errors_only {
287	        conn.query_row(sql, [], |row| row.get(0))
288	    } else {
289	        conn.query_row(sql, [&filter_pattern], |row| row.get(0))
290	    }.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
291	    
292	    Ok(count)
293	}

354	    } else if errors_only {

356	        let logs_iter = stmt.query_map([limit, offset], |row| {
357	            Ok(ProxyRequestLog {

457	pub struct IpTokenStats {

466	/// Get token usage grouped by IP
467	pub fn get_token_usage_by_ip(limit: usize, hours: i64) -> Result<Vec<IpTokenStats>, String> {
468	    let conn = connect_db()?;
469	
470	    // Fix: Database stores timestamp in milliseconds, but we were calculating 'since' in seconds
471	    // Convert 'hours' to milliseconds
472	    let since = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_millis() - (hours * 3600 * 1000);
473	
474	    // [FIX] 不再从 request_logs 表获取 username，因为该字段可能为空
475	    // 先获取 IP 统计数据，然后再单独查询每个 IP 的用户名
476	    let mut stmt = conn.prepare(
477	        "SELECT
478	            client_ip,
479	            COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) as total,
480	            COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) as input,
481	            COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) as output,
482	            COUNT(*) as cnt
483	         FROM request_logs
484	         WHERE timestamp >= ?1 AND client_ip IS NOT NULL AND client_ip != ''
485	         GROUP BY client_ip
486	         ORDER BY total DESC
487	         LIMIT ?2"
488	    ).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
489	
490	    let rows = stmt.query_map(params![since, limit], |row| {
491	        Ok((
492	            row.get::<_, String>(0)?,
493	            row.get::<_, i64>(1)?,
494	            row.get::<_, i64>(2)?,
495	            row.get::<_, i64>(3)?,
496	            row.get::<_, i64>(4)?,
497	        ))
498	    }).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
499	
500	    let mut stats = Vec::new();
501	    for row in rows {
502	        let (client_ip, total_tokens, input_tokens, output_tokens, request_count) = row.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
503	        
504	        // 从 user_token_db 获取该 IP 关联的用户名
505	        // 这比从 request_logs 获取更可靠，因为 token_ip_bindings 表在每次 User Token 使用时都会更新
506	        let username = crate::modules::user_token_db::get_username_for_ip(&client_ip).unwrap_or(None);
507	        
508	        stats.push(IpTokenStats {
509	            client_ip,
510	            total_tokens,
511	            input_tokens,
512	            output_tokens,
513	            request_count,
514	            username,
515	        });
516	    }
517	
518	    Ok(stats)
519	}

50	            throw error;
51	        }

54	    updateTheme: async (theme: string) => {
55	        const { config } = get();
56	        if (!config || config.theme === theme) return;
57	
58	        const newConfig = { ...config, theme };
59	        await get().saveConfig(newConfig, true);
60	    },
61	
62	    updateLanguage: async (language: string) => {
63	        const { config } = get();
64	        if (!config || config.language === language) return;
65	
66	        const newConfig = { ...config, language };
67	        await get().saveConfig(newConfig, true);
68	    },
69	
70	    toggleShowAllQuotas: () => {
71	        const current = get().showAllQuotas;
72	        const next = !current;
73	        localStorage.setItem('antigravity_show_all_quotas', String(next));
74	        set({ showAllQuotas: next });
75	    },
76	
77	    toggleMenuItem: async (path: string) => {
78	        const { config } = get();
79	        if (!config) return;
80	
81	        const hiddenItems = config.hidden_menu_items || [];
82	        const isHidden = hiddenItems.includes(path);
83	
84	        const newHiddenItems = isHidden
85	            ? hiddenItems.filter(item => item !== path)
86	            : [...hiddenItems, path];
87	
88	        const newConfig = { ...config, hidden_menu_items: newHiddenItems };
89	        await get().saveConfig(newConfig, true);
90	    },
91	
92	    isMenuItemHidden: (path: string) => {
93	        const { config } = get();
94	        if (!config) return false;
95	        return (config.hidden_menu_items || []).includes(path);
96	    },
97	}));

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn save_config(
    app: tauri::AppHandle,
    proxy_state: State<'_, ProxyServiceState>,
    config: AppConfig,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    modules::save_app_config(&config)?;  // Persist to disk
    app.emit("config://updated", ());     // Notify tray

    // Hot-update running service
    let instance_lock = proxy_state.instance.read().await;
    if let Some(instance) = instance_lock.as_ref() {
